# EFFECTS_INDEX
| `KioraSovereignOfTheDeepTriggerEffect` / `KioraSovereignOfTheDeepRevealAndCastEffect` | `()` / `(int spellManaValue)` | Trigger only for a qualifying Kraken, Leviathan, Octopus, or Serpent spell cast from hand. Privately looks at the top `spellManaValue` cards, offers one nonland spell with strictly lower mana value for a free cast, and puts the rest on the bottom in random order. Reuses the `CAST_WITHOUT_PAYING` library-search flow. |
| `RecordLastDiscardedCardTypeEffect` | `(CardType cardType)` | records `1` when the most recently resolved discard matches the type and `0` otherwise; pair with `ConditionalEffect(new EventValueAtLeast(1), ...)` for "if a [type] card was discarded this way". Used by Reckless Handling (MAT 19) |
| `ExileTargetCardFromGraveyardPutCounterOnSourceEffect` | `()` | atomically exiles target card from any graveyard, tracks it with the source, and puts a +1/+1 counter on the source only when the exile succeeds |
| `GainKeywordsOfCardsExiledWithSourceEffect` | `()` | static self-effect granting the source the watched keywords found on cards exiled with it |
| `ChoosePlaneswalkerTypeOnEnterEffect` | `()` | as-enters subtype choice restricted to planeswalker types; stores the selected subtype on the permanent through the shared subtype-choice interaction |
| `GrantHexproofToChosenPlaneswalkerTypeEffect` | `()` | static layer effect granting hexproof to matching planeswalkers controlled by the source's controller |
| `PreserveOneLoyaltyCounterForChosenPlaneswalkerTypeEffect` | `()` | damage-to-loyalty replacement that leaves one loyalty counter on a matching planeswalker when its controller controls a creature and the damage would remove all loyalty; actual damage remains recorded and triggers normally |
| `CopyTargetActivatedOrTriggeredAbilityEffect` | `()` | copy target activated or triggered ability on the stack. Spec `SPELL_ON_STACK`; pair with a `StackEntryPredicateTargetFilter` admitting `ACTIVATED_ABILITY` or `TRIGGERED_ABILITY` plus `StackEntryControlledByPredicate`. Puts a copy on the stack with the same source; single-target copies queue `CopyTriggeredAbilityRetargetEffect`. Used by Peter Parker's Camera |
| `GrantColorEffect` | `(CardColor color, GrantScope.TARGET, true)` | resolving targeted ability form: permanently replaces the target's colors; the normal handler stores it as a floating layer-5 effect |
| `GrantSubtypeEffect` | `(CardSubtype subtype, GrantScope.TARGET, true)` | resolving targeted ability form: permanently replaces the target's creature subtypes; the normal handler stores it as a floating layer-4 effect |
| `SuspectTargetCreatureEffect` | `()` | TARGET / ON_ENTER_BATTLEFIELD: gives the target creature the persistent suspected designation; the designation is represented by a floating `SuspectedEffect` and supplies menace plus can't block while the target permanent remains on the battlefield |
| `PutCounterOnTargetForEachLeavingSourceCounterEffect` | `(CounterType)` / `(CounterType, PermanentPredicate)` / `(CounterType, int count, PermanentPredicate)` | leaves-the-battlefield trigger: snapshots the named counter type on the leaving source and puts that many counters of the same type on the target creature; the trigger remains targetable when the snapshot count is zero |
| `EmblemTriggerStep.OPPONENT_DRAW_STEP` | enum value | opponent-draw-step relation for `EmblemStepTriggerEffect`; the emblem controller's effects trigger during each other player's draw step |
| `AwardAnyColorManaEffect` restriction `SOURCE_PERMANENT_COLORS` | `(int, ManaSpendRestriction)` | chooses one mana color from the source permanent's current colors; a colorless source produces no mana. Used by Katilda, Dawnhart Prime. |
| `EventStat.BASIC_LAND_SEARCH_COUNT` | `DestroyTargetPermanentThenEffect` snapshot | records two when the targeted permanent is a land and destruction succeeds, otherwise one; used as `SearchLibraryEffect(EventValue(), basicLand(), BATTLEFIELD_TAPPED)` by Dire-Strain Rampage |
- `MayPayLifeAndDrawEqualToDyingPowerEffect` | `()` | `ON_EQUIPPED_CREATURE_DIES` marker: snapshots the equipped creature's last-known effective power and materializes `MayPayLifeEffect(power, DrawCardEffect(power))`. The controller may accept or decline the resolution-time life payment; power is clamped to zero. Used by Mask of Griselbrand; consumed by the death collector.
- `NoteControllerLifeTotalEffect` — `()` — stores the source permanent controller's current life total in the permanent's existing note state. Used by Sigarda's Splendor as it enters and after its upkeep check.
- `DrawCardIfControllerLifeTotalAtLeastNotedEffect` — `()` — `UPKEEP_TRIGGERED`: draws one card if the source permanent controller's current life total is at least the source's noted total, then updates that note. Used by Sigarda's Splendor.
| `EnduringAngelLifeTotalReplacementEffect` | `()` | static replacement: when its controller's life total would be reduced to 0 or less, the loss path transforms the source permanent to its back face and sets that player's life total to 3; if the source cannot transform, the ordinary life-loss outcome applies |
| `AnyPlayerMayTakeDamageOrTargetPlayerDrawEffect` | `(int damage, int drawCount)` | SPELL punisher (`DamageDealingEffect`, player target): players choose in APNAP order whether to have the spell deal `damage` to them; the first acceptance deals the damage and ends the choice sequence. If all decline, the targeted player draws `drawCount` cards. Resolution state carries the remaining player queue and target player. Handler: `AnyPlayerMayTakeDamageOrTargetPlayerDrawEffectHandler` + `mayfx/AnyPlayerMayTakeDamageOrTargetPlayerDrawHandler`. Used by Browbeat (5, 3) |

| `GrantAllCreatureTypesToOwnCreaturesEffect` | `(GrantScope scope)` / no-arg = `OWN_CREATURES` / `.toSelf()` | static layer-4 grant making creatures in the selected scope every creature type. The default own-creatures form also grants all creature subtypes to owned creature cards and spells outside the battlefield; `.toSelf()` is a characteristic-defining all-zones grant for cards such as Mistform Ultimus. |

`DealDamageToTargetCreatureDamagedPlayerControlsEffect(DynamicAmount, boolean)` uses the damaged player (or a targeted planeswalker's controller) as the chooser when the boolean is true; Flaming Gambit combines it with `MayEffect` and `ConditionalReplacementEffect` for its optional redirection.
| `AnyPlayerMayExileCardFromGraveyardAndAssignNoCombatDamageEffect` | `()` / `(int cardsToExile)` | `ON_ATTACK` / `ON_BLOCK`: offers each player with enough cards in their graveyard the option to exile exactly `cardsToExile` cards; an accepted choice makes the source assign no combat damage this turn. The no-arg form is Carrion Rats; `(3)` is Carrion Wurm |
| `ReduceCastCostForSameNameCardsInGraveyardEffect` | `()` | static battlefield effect; each spell cast by the source controller costs one less generic mana for each matching non-token card in that player's graveyard, excluding the spell itself by card id. Locket of Yesterdays |
| `SearchLibraryForDragonToGraveyardAndBecomeCopyUntilEndOfTurnEffect` | `()` | search for a Dragon permanent card, put it into the graveyard, then copy that exact card until end of turn. The library-choice continuation captures the selected card ID before resuming the parked stack entry. Used by Scion of the Ur-Dragon |
| `BecomeCopyOfCardInGraveyardUntilEndOfTurnEffect` | `(UUID cardId)` | continuation effect that copies a card still present in a graveyard until end of turn and registers the temporary copy expiry. Used by Scion of the Ur-Dragon |
| `TargetPowerPlusToughness` | `()` | target permanent's effective power plus toughness at resolution, preserving negative values; use with `Max(Fixed(0), ...)` for Phthisis |
| `RevealTopCardsAndSeparateEffect` (Truth or Tale disposition) | `(5, CardPileDisposition.ONE_FROM_CHOSEN_HAND_AND_BOTTOM, true)` | controller separates the top five cards, an opponent chooses a pile, the controller chooses one card from it for hand, and all other revealed cards are ordered onto the library bottom via `PendingTruthOrTaleCardChoice` and `LibraryReorder` |
| `SkipNextEffect` with `SkipRecipient.EACH_OPPONENT` | `(SkipKind)` | non-targeting one-shot skip queued for every player other than the resolving controller; used by Brine Elemental (`TSP`) |
| `PutTargetCardFromExileIntoOwnersGraveyardEffect` | `()` | SPELL: moves a targeted face-up card from exile to its owner's graveyard; the target is validated against the face-up exile zone at cast time and again at resolution. Used by Pull from Eternity (`TSP`) |
| `PreventFixedDamageFromSpellsEffect` | `(int amount)` | static prevention: prevents `amount` damage from each spell damage event to each permanent or player (Plated Pegasus). Global across controllers and spell types; combat, abilities, and permanent-sourced fight/bite damage are unaffected. Gated on `isDamagePreventable`; multiple instances stack. Queried by `GameQueryService.getSpellDamagePrevention` from the creature, planeswalker, and player damage paths |
| `RemoveTimeCounterFromExiledCardEffect` | `(UUID cardId)` | suspend upkeep trigger: removes one time counter from the owner's suspended exiled card; on the last counter, queues an optional free cast through `MayPlayExiledCardWithoutPayingManaCostEffect`, granting haste to a creature cast this way. Used by Duskrider Peregrine |
| `PutTimeCountersOnSuspendedCardEffect` | `(int amount)` | contingent follow-up for a suspended-card upkeep ability: after the active player actually sacrifices a permanent, adds `amount` time counters to the still-suspended source card. Used by Curse of the Cabal |
| `SourceCardSuspended` | `()` | intervening condition for a suspended-card trigger; true only while the source card remains in exile with a positive time-counter entry. Used by Curse of the Cabal |
| `RemoveTimeCounterWhenOpponentCastsSpellEffect` | `()` | suspended-card `ON_OPPONENT_CASTS_SPELL` trigger descriptor: queues `RemoveTimeCounterFromExiledCardEffect` for the source card when an opponent casts a spell; the exiled-card trigger scan requires a positive time-counter entry. Used by Deep-Sea Kraken |
| `ExileTargetCreatureDrawPowerReturnAtControllerUpkeepDiscardToughnessEffect` | `()` | SPELL: captures the target creature's effective power before exiling it, draws that many cards, and schedules the exiled card to return under its owner's control at the spell controller's next upkeep. If the primary card returns as a creature, it queues a controller discard equal to that returned permanent's effective toughness; tokens and noncreatures returning cause no discard. Used by Vanish into Memory |
| `BalduvianWarlordEffect` | `()` | removes a target blocking creature from combat, updates its former attackers' blocked state using the current-combat block history, then prompts the ability controller to choose a legal attacking creature for the blocker to block again; the new block uses the normal block-trigger pipeline |
| `SacrificeTargetArtifactCreatureThenMaySearchLibraryForNoncreatureArtifactEffect` | `()` | targets an artifact creature; its controller sacrifices it, then that player may search their own library for a noncreature artifact card and put it onto the battlefield. The handler snapshots the target controller before sacrifice, queues a `PendingMayAbility` for that player, and lets the accepted branch resolve a filtered `SearchLibraryEffect`. Used by Arcum Dagsson |
`GuidedPassageEffect` — reveal the controller's entire library, then an opponent chooses one available creature card, land card, and noncreature, nonland card; the selected cards go to hand and the library is shuffled. Multiplayer opponent selection uses `PermanentChoiceContext.GuidedPassageOpponentChoice`, followed by `PendingInteraction.GuidedPassageChoice`.
| `ReturnTargetCreatureToHandThenCreateTokensEqualToManaValueEffect` | `(CreateTokenEffect tokenTemplate)` | return target creature to its owner's hand, snapshot its mana value before the bounce, then create that many copies of the token template under the spell controller's control. Used by Aether Mutation |
| `DestroyTwoTargetCreaturesIfSameColorsEffect` | `()` | destroys two target creatures without allowing regeneration when their effective color sets exactly match; a color mismatch or a missing target makes the effect do nothing. Used by Dead Ringers |
| `CounterUnlessOtherPlayerPaysManaCostOnSpellCastEffect` | `()` | trigger descriptor: whenever any player casts a spell, another player may pay that spell's printed mana cost, with the cast-time value of X substituted, to counter it. The spell-cast collector queues a targeted `MayPayManaEffect` with `MayPayPayer.ANY_OTHER_PLAYER`. Used by Ice Cave |
| `DestroyTargetPermanentThenDealManaValueDamageToTargetCreatureEffect` | `(int damageTargetGroup)` | destroy the primary target, then deal damage equal to its mana value to the creature in the separate target group; captures the mana value before destruction and uses the resolving spell as the damage source. Used by Orim's Thunder |
| `GrantStaticEffectToSourceEffect` | `(CardEffect staticEffect)` or `(CardEffect staticEffect, EffectDuration duration)` | resolution-time effect that makes the source permanent carry a layer-6 static effect for the chosen source-linked duration; use when an Aura gains a static ability that follows its current attachment (Earthbind) |
`DamageDealtToControllerByArtifactsThisTurn()` — dynamic amount for the total damage dealt to the
effect's controller by artifact sources this turn; Reverse Polarity scales it with `Scaled(..., 2)`.
- `OpponentsCantSearchLibrariesEffect` — `()`; spells and abilities controlled by this permanent's opponents can't cause their controller to search that controller's library (Ashiok, Dream Render). Passive rules-modifier checked at search initiation using the resolving spell or ability controller; searches of another player's library are not affected
| `ChooseNonlandCardNameRevealTopCardsToHandRestToGraveyardEffect` | `(int count)` | controller names a nonland card, then reveals the top `count` cards of their library; every revealed card with the chosen name goes to hand, all other cards go to the graveyard. Used by Tamiyo, Collector of Tales (`4`) |
| `OpponentEffectsCantCauseDiscardEffect` | `()` | static effect: spells and abilities controlled by the controller's opponents can't cause the controller to discard cards. The controller's own effects and discard costs are unaffected. Used by Tamiyo, Collector of Tales |
| `EachOpponentWithoutLegendaryCreatureOrPlaneswalkerLosesGameEffect` | `()` | each opponent who controls neither a legendary creature nor a planeswalker loses through the central loss-outcome gate. Nicol Bolas, Dragon-God |
| `GainLoyaltyAbilitiesOfOtherPlaneswalkersEffect` | `()` | this permanent gains the loyalty abilities of other planeswalkers on the battlefield (static, selfOnly); non-loyalty activated abilities and static/triggered abilities are not copied. Used by Nicol Bolas, Dragon-God |
| `AllowCastFromTopOfLibraryByPayingLifeEqualToManaValueEffect` | `()` | static marker: permits the controller to cast nonland spells from the top of their library by paying life equal to the spell's mana value instead of its mana cost. Normal timing and additional-cost rules still apply. Used by Bolas's Citadel |
| `ExileTopCardsRepeatIfLastNonlandCreateTokensEffect` | `(int cardsPerIteration, CreateTokenEffect tokenTemplate)` | exile full groups from the controller's library, repeat if the last card in a full group is nonland, then create one token per nonland card exiled; a short final group does not repeat |
| `PainsRewardEffect` | `()` | SPELL: the controller chooses the opening life bid, then players may top the high bid in turn order via a `PainsRewardBidChoice` awaiting-input record (reuses the numeric `X_VALUE_CHOICE` wire message). The high bidder loses life equal to the high bid and draws four cards; bids are not limited by life total. Resolved by `PainsRewardEffectHandler`, re-run each bid via `rerunCurrentEffectAfterInteraction`; progress uses `GameData.illicitAuction`. Used by Pain's Reward |
| `SetSelfBasePowerToughnessFromCombatOpponentEffect` | `()` | combat-trigger effect: reads the combat opponent's current effective power and toughness at resolution and sets the source's base P/T to those values until end of turn. It implements `CombatOpponentReferencingEffect`, so the trigger carries the opponent as a non-targeting target. Use on `ON_BLOCK` and `ON_BECOMES_BLOCKED` (`PER_BLOCKER`) for Shape Stealer. |

| `CombatTapCostEffect` | `CardEffect` | Descriptive capability for a static combat cost paid by tapping untapped creatures that were not declared as attackers or blockers in the combat. `tapCount()` gives the number of payers; `CombatTapCostService` validates the full declaration, chooses eligible creatures in battlefield order, and fires normal tap triggers. Implemented by `CantAttackOrBlockUnlessTapEffect` (Hollow Warrior). |

| `ExileTokensWithSameNameAsLeavingCreatureEffect` | `()` / `(String creatureName)` | `ON_ANOTHER_CREATURE_LEAVES_BATTLEFIELD`: snapshots a leaving nontoken creature's name and exiles every token with that name across all battlefields. Dual Nature |

| `MillActivePlayerAndCreateTokensByManaValueEffect` | `(CreateTokenEffect tokenTemplate)` | active player mills 1 card, then creates that card's mana value in copies of the supplied token blueprint under their control. Untargeted. Uses the active-player snapshot on an each-upkeep trigger entry and creates nothing when the library is empty, the card is diverted by a replacement effect, or its mana value is 0. Used by Infernal Genesis |

| `ChooseCardsFromTargetHandEffect` | `(int count, List<CardType> excludedTypes, List<CardType> includedTypes, HandChoiceDestination destination, boolean returnOnSourceLeave, CardPredicate filter, boolean grantPlayPermission, boolean returnAtNextEndStep)` | EXILE choices can grant the chooser normal-cost cast permission and return an uncast card to its owner's hand at the next end step. Used by Psychic Theft (PCY) |

| `DealDamageToEnchantedPermanentControllerEffect` | `(DynamicAmount amount)`; `(int damage)` | `DamageDealingEffect` for non-targeted Aura damage to the current controller of the permanent attached to the source Aura. Used by Gremlin Infestation |

| `ExileTargetNonlandCardFromGraveyardAndSearchSameNameEffect` | `()` | target a nonland card in your graveyard; exile it, then search your library for any number of cards with the same name, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle. Reuses the restricted `SearchLibraryEffect` interaction. Used by Secret Salvage |

| `CreateTokenCopyOfEnchantedPermanentEffect` | `()` | creates a token copy of the permanent attached to the source Aura; uses the attachment and its last-known snapshot at resolution. Used by Mechanized Production |

| `DiscardIfPlayerDealtDamageThisWayEffect` | `()` | same-resolution rider: each player actually dealt damage by an earlier effect in the stack entry discards one card; fully prevented damage and damage to permanents do not qualify |

| `ScryIfPlayerDealtDamageThisWayEffect` | `()` | same-resolution rider: queues `ScryEffect(1)` when an earlier effect in the stack entry actually dealt damage to a player; fully prevented damage and damage to permanents do not qualify |

| `EndureEffect` | `(int amount)` / `(DynamicAmount amount)` | resolution-time keyword action: the controller chooses between putting `amount` +1/+1 counters on the instructed permanent and creating one `amount`/`amount` white Spirit creature token. The default target is the source; `EndureEffect.forTriggeringPermanent(DynamicAmount)` instructs the permanent captured by an enter trigger. If the instructed permanent has left the battlefield or cannot have +1/+1 counters, token creation is automatic. `new XValue()` uses an ability's announced X. Used by Anafenza, Unyielding Lineage, Krumar Initiate, and Warden of the Grove. |

| `CastSameNameCardFromGraveyardOnSpellCastEffect` | `()` | trigger descriptor for an instant or sorcery cast from hand: snapshots the cast spell's name, chooses a matching instant or sorcery card from the controller's graveyard as the trigger is queued, then offers to cast it for its normal cost. Uses `ON_CONTROLLER_CASTS_SPELL`; see Harness the Storm |
| `SearchSameNameCardToBattlefieldOnArtifactSpellCastEffect` | `()` | trigger descriptor for Mishra, Artificer Prodigy: when its controller casts an artifact spell, snapshots that spell's name and offers a may search using `SearchZonesForCardNamedToBattlefieldEffect` |

| `TargetPlayerSacrificesCreatureAndPlaneswalkerEffect` | `()` | target player sacrifices a creature object and a planeswalker object when possible. The handler requires two distinct permanents when a valid pair exists, so a creature/planeswalker hybrid cannot be selected twice; the selected permanents are sacrificed simultaneously. Used by To the Slaughter's delirium branch |
| `EachOpponentSacrificesArtifactAndNonartifactCreatureEffect` | `()` | each opponent chooses an artifact creature and a nonartifact creature when possible; if only one category is present, only one creature is sacrificed. Choices are made in APNAP order and all selected creatures are sacrificed simultaneously. Used by Perilous Predicament |

`ReturnToHandEffect.self()` supplies `SOURCE_SELF` combat-trigger context when used in `ON_COMBAT_DAMAGE_TO_PLAYER`, so self-bounce effects retain the source permanent while remaining player-only triggers.
| `ManaRestriction.ColorlessSubtypeSpellsOrAbilities` | `(CardSubtype subtype)` | fixed colorless mana restriction usable only for colorless spells or activated abilities of the subtype; routes to a dedicated bucket (Eldrazi Temple) |

| `ControlledCreaturesDealPowerDamageToTargetPlayerOrPlaneswalkerEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate filter)` | each creature the controller controls matching `filter` deals damage equal to its power to target player or planeswalker; each matching creature is its own damage source. `targetSpec()` = harmful PLAYER_OR_PLANESWALKER. Used by Sarkhan the Mad |
| `SacrificeTargetCreatureThenCreateTokenEffect` | `(CreateTokenEffect tokenTemplate)` | targets a creature; its controller sacrifices it, then creates the fixed token template. Fizzles if the target is no longer a legal creature. Used by Sarkhan the Mad |
| `RevealTopCardPutIntoHandAndDealDamageToSelfEffect` | `()` | reveal the top card of the controller's library, put it into hand, then have the source permanent deal damage to itself equal to that card's mana value. Used by Sarkhan the Mad |

`CreateTokenCopyOfSourceEffect` also supports the plain-copy form `(removeLegendary, amount, grantHaste, exileAtEndStep)` for source abilities that create a hasty copy and exile it at the beginning of the next end step (Splinter Twin).

Used by Suffer the Past |

Uses `ON_ANY_PLAYER_CASTS_SPELL`; the collector presets the caster as the life-loss target. See Curse of Wizardry |
| `ChooseCreatureTypeCost` | `()` | SPELL-slot additional cast cost that records a chosen creature subtype without consuming a resource. The choice rides on `PlayCardRequest.beholdCreatureType` and is stored on the entering permanent for source-relative effects (Caller of the Hunt) |
| `GrantKeywordToBlockingCreaturesUnlessAttackerPaysEffect` | `(Keyword keyword, PermanentPredicate attackerFilter, String manaCost)` | For each matching attacking creature, its controller independently pays `manaCost`; if unpaid, the configured keyword is granted until end of turn to creatures controlled by the ability's controller blocking that attacker. Used by Tidal Flats |

| `PreventCombatDamageFromAttackingCreaturesUnlessPaysEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate attackerFilter, String manaCost)` | For each matching attacking creature, its controller independently pays `manaCost` or all combat damage that creature would deal this turn is prevented. The normal handler snapshots matching attackers and queues one may-payment choice per creature; the may handler writes `GameData.creaturesPreventedFromDealingCombatDamage` when payment is declined or unavailable. | `FirstMulticoloredSpellCastTriggerEffect` | `(List<CardEffect> resolvedEffects)` | trigger descriptor: when any player casts their first multicolored spell of the turn, put the resolved effects on the stack. The first-multicolored count is tracked independently per casting player in `ON_ANY_PLAYER_CASTS_SPELL`; the collector then reuses the generic spell-cast trigger plumbing. Zenith Chronicler uses it with `DrawCardsForEachOpponentOfTriggeringPlayerEffect(1)`. |

| `EnteringCreatureHasCountersConditionalEffect` | `(CounterType counterType, CardEffect wrapped)` | Gates an ally-creature-enters trigger on the entering permanent having one or more counters of the specified type; use with `PutCountersOnEnteringCreatureEffect` for counter-based intervening-if triggers such as Ichorplate Golem |
| `PutCountersOnEnteringCreatureEffect` | `(CounterType counterType, int count, boolean optional[, CounterType requiredCounterType])` | Ally-creature-enter marker that places counters of the specified type on the entering permanent; the optional required counter type re-checks the condition at resolution |

| `MustAttackPlayerEffect` | `()` | static marker for a creature that must attack a player each combat if able; applied by a temporary floating effect |
| `TargetCreatureMustAttackPlayerUntilNextTurnEffect` | `()` | targets up to one creature and grants a temporary player-only must-attack requirement through the ability controller's next turn; a creature attacking a planeswalker does not satisfy it |

`SacrificeOtherCreatureThenRevealUntilLowerManaValueEffect(CardPredicate)` resolves the optional
"sacrifice another creature, then reveal until a matching creature with lesser mana value" pattern.
It carries the predicate through a permanent-choice prompt, snapshots the sacrificed card's mana
value before moving it to the graveyard, and delegates the reveal/bottom-randomly behavior to
`RevealUntilCardPredicateRestOnBottomRandomEffect`. Used by Kethek, Crucible Goliath.

`SacrificeAnotherCreatureDrawAndMayPutPermanentEffect()` resolves the optional attack-trigger
pattern that sacrifices another creature, draws cards equal to its mana value, and then offers a
permanent card with mana value up to that value from hand onto the battlefield. It carries the
effect through the permanent-choice prompt and inserts the draw and optional hand-to-battlefield
steps after the sacrifice. Used by Venom, Lethal Protector.

`ReduceActivatedAbilityCostForTargetingSourceEffect(int)` reduces the generic cost of activated
abilities of Equipment controlled by the source's controller when they target the source
permanent. It is target-aware and is used by Bladegraft Aspirant.

| `GrantTargetCreatureHexproofFromChosenColorAndCantBeBlockedByItUntilEndOfTurnEffect` | `()` or `(boolean selfTargeting)` | resolution-time color choice; the default targets a creature, while `selfTargeting=true` applies to the source permanent without a target. Stores temporary hexproof-from-color in `GameData` and a `CanBeBlockedOnlyByFilterEffect` allowing only blockers that do not have the chosen color. Used by Skrelv, Defector Mite and Sungold Sentinel |

| `SkipDrawReplacementEffect` | `CardEffect` | capability for a global static replacement that skips every card draw |
| `PossessedPortalDrawReplacementEffect` | `()` | static marker: every player's draw is replaced by skipping that draw |
| `EachPlayerSacrificesPermanentUnlessDiscardEffect` | `()` | END_STEP_TRIGGERED: each player in APNAP order sacrifices a permanent unless they discard a card; a single available action resolves automatically, while both actions open a choice |
| `CreepingDreadEffect` | `()` | UPKEEP_TRIGGERED: each player discards one card in APNAP order; after all choices complete, each opponent whose discarded card shares a card type with the controller's discarded card loses 3 life. Uses `GameData.creepingDread` and the central last-discarded-card-type snapshot |
| `EachPlayerSacrificesPermanentOrDiscardsEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate filter)` | APNAP each-player choice: each player chooses one matching permanent; all chosen permanents are sacrificed simultaneously, then players who could not choose one choose cards to discard in APNAP order and those cards are discarded simultaneously. Plaguecrafter uses a creature-or-planeswalker filter |
- `ExileTargetCreatureCardCreateTokenForOwnerEffect` | `(CreateTokenEffect tokenTemplate)` | activated ability targeting a creature card in any graveyard. At resolution exiles the target card and creates one `tokenTemplate` under that card's owner's control; if the target left the graveyard, no token is created. Used by Pharika, God of Affliction |

| `RevealFirstDrawEffect` | `(CardEffect onLand, CardEffect onNonland)` | controller-draw marker: reveal the controller's first card drawn on each of their turns, then route the land or nonland branch through the ordinary draw-trigger pipeline. Used by Keranos, God of Storms |
| `RevealFirstDrawInstantOrSorceryEffect` | `()` | first-draw marker: offers to reveal the controller's first card drawn on their turn and, if the revealed card is an instant or sorcery, returns `CopyDrawnInstantOrSorceryAndMayCastCopyEffect` |

| `RevealTopCardDrawManaValueEffect` | `()` | reveal top card of controller's library; draw cards equal to its mana value. The card stays on top until the draws resolve, so it is the first card drawn when the mana value is greater than zero. Non-targeting; the amount is unknown until resolution. Used by Interpret the Signs after `ScryEffect(3)` on `SPELL` |

| `TopCardOfLibraryManaValue` | `()` | `DynamicAmount` returning the mana value of the controller's current top library card, or zero for an empty library. Use after `RevealTopCardOfLibraryEffect` when a revealed card's mana value feeds a later effect, such as Stormchaser Chimera's self-boost |
| `TargetCardsManaValueSum` | `()` | `DynamicAmount` summing the mana values of graveyard cards named by the resolving stack entry's target list; used when an amount depends on all chosen graveyard cards, such as Command the Dreadhorde |

| `PreventAllDamageToSelfFromTargetCreatureEffect` | `()` | activated ability: prevent all damage that would be dealt to the ability's source permanent by the target creature this turn (Stonewise Fortifier). Uses the existing target/source prevention shield with an unlimited turn scope; damage from that creature to other recipients and damage from other sources are unaffected. |
| `BoostReferencedPermanentEffect` | `(PermanentReference, DynamicAmount, DynamicAmount)` / `(PermanentReference, int powerBoost, int toughnessBoost)` | gives the referenced permanent +X/+Y until end of turn without targeting. `TRIGGERING` reads `StackEntry.triggeringPermanentId` for event-fixed subjects such as the Vehicle in Veteran Motorist's crew trigger; `ATTACHED` re-derives an Aura or Equipment host and `SOURCE` reads the ability's source permanent |

`ChooseCardNameAndExileFromZonesEffect` accepts `drawForHandExiled=true` for Lost Legacy; after
the any-number exile selection, the target player draws one card for each selected card exiled
from their hand.

`CastTargetInstantOrSorceryFromGraveyardEffect` accepts an optional `CardPredicate` after its
scope, free-cast, and exile flags to narrow the instant-or-sorcery choice further (for example,
`CardTypePredicate(INSTANT)` for Torrential Gearhulk).

| `PayEnergyToGainControlOfTargetEffect` | `(DynamicAmount energyAmount)` | pays the resolved energy amount and, when payment succeeds, gains permanent control of the targeted permanent; wraps the existing permanent control machinery. Use with `MayEffect` for optional payments (Confiscation Coup) |

Uses two `target(...)` groups: `GraveyardCardPredicateTargetFilter(CardTypePredicate(CREATURE), CONTROLLERS_GRAVEYARD)` and a creature group. The targets resolve independently: a missing graveyard card prevents the move and damage, while a missing creature still allows the library move. Used by Dead Reckoning (`WWK`) |

The card remains exiled if it is a land, declined, or cannot be cast. Used by Mind's Dilation |

Used by Over the Top |
| `RevealUntilCountMatchingCardsForDestroyedPermanentControllersEffect` | `(Set<CardType> cardTypes)` | for each controller recorded by a preceding destroy effect, reveal until that many matching cards are found, exile the matches, put all found cards onto the battlefield simultaneously, and shuffle the other revealed cards back. `RegisterEchoAtNextUpkeepEffect(String manaCost)` registers an `EchoAtNextUpkeep` delayed action for the source permanent. At the next upkeep of its current controller, `StepTriggerService` pushes a one-shot pay-or-sacrifice trigger; the action is discarded if the permanent has left the battlefield. Used by Keldon Champion.
`PayEchoCost(String echoCost)` is the internal forced-cost descriptor for echo; its resolution selects an applicable `AlternativeEchoCostEffect` or falls back to the printed echo cost.
`AlternativeEchoCostEffect(String manaCost)` is a static capability that lets its controller pay the supplied alternative mana cost instead of echo costs for permanents they control. Thick-Skinned Goblin uses `"{0}"`.

The controller chooses a creature, its effective power is captured before removal, then the handler reuses `MassDamageEffect(Fixed(power), true, false, Not(HasKeyword(FLYING)))`. With no controlled creatures, nothing happens. Uses `PermanentChoiceContext.SacrificeCreatureThenMassDamageEqualToPower` |

| `GoblinGameEffect` | `()` | Goblin Game: each player makes a private positive item-count choice; after all counts are revealed, each player loses life equal to their count, then every player tied for fewest loses half their current life rounded up. Uses private `XValueChoice` prompts and `GameData.goblinGame` progress state |

Purpose: cut token usage when implementing cards by quickly mapping "card text intent" to existing reusable effects and their constructor signatures.

`BoostAllOwnCreaturesEffect` accepts an optional `GrantDuration`; the default is end of turn, while `GrantDuration.UNTIL_YOUR_NEXT_TURN` is represented by floating layer effects on the creatures present when the effect resolves.

`MoveCountersFromAllCreaturesToSourceEffect(CounterType)` is an untargeted effect that moves all counters of the given kind from every creature on every battlefield onto the source permanent, including the source when it is a creature. The source must still be on the battlefield; the handler uses shared counter placement for counter locks, replacement effects, and counter triggers. Spike Cannibal uses `PLUS_ONE_PLUS_ONE`.
`CantAttackUnlessReturnToHandEffect` is a STATIC additional attack cost read directly by `AttackReturnToHandCostService`; pair it with a `CantAttackUnlessEffect(ControlsPermanentCount(count, filter), …)` legality gate.
Thought Prison combines the hand-reveal imprint overload of `ChooseCardsFromTargetHandEffect` with `StackEntrySharesColorOrManaValueWithImprintedCardPredicate` in an `ON_ANY_PLAYER_CASTS_SPELL` trigger.

| `KrarksThumbEffect` | `()` | Static replacement effect for Krark's Thumb: each logical coin flip made by its controller flips two coins and ignores one result. Multiple copies apply once each to the same logical flip. |

`DistributeCountersAmongTargetsEffect.chosenAmongTargetCreaturesEtb(CounterType, int)` is the fixed chosen counter-distribution form for ETB abilities; it reads target-to-counter assignments from the shared ETB assignment buffer and skips targets that are gone or no longer creatures (Wurmskin Forger).

Resolution is handled by `EachPlayerChoosesLandOfEachBasicTypeThenSacrificeRestEffectHandler`. Used by Global Ruin |
| `EachPlayerChoosesLandOfEachBasicTypeThenReturnToHandEffect` | `()` | Each player chooses from lands they control a land with each effective basic land type in active-player order. A land with multiple basic land types can satisfy multiple choices; all chosen lands return to their owners' hands after all players choose. Resolution is handled by `EachPlayerChoosesLandOfEachBasicTypeThenReturnToHandEffectHandler`. Used by Planar Overlay |
| `ChooseLandOfEachBasicTypeThenDestroyEffect` | `()` | The controller chooses one land with each effective basic land type from among all battlefields. A land with multiple basic land types can satisfy multiple choices but is destroyed only once; selected lands are destroyed simultaneously with normal regeneration and indestructible rules. Resolution is handled by `ChooseLandOfEachBasicTypeThenDestroyEffectHandler`. Used by Sundering Titan |
| `EachPlayerChoosesLandsThenDestroyRestEffect` | `(int landsToKeep)` | Each player chooses up to `landsToKeep` lands they control in active-player order; a player with fewer lands keeps all of them, and every other permanent is destroyed together after all choices. Resolution is handled by `EachPlayerChoosesLandsThenDestroyRestEffectHandler`. Used by Urza's Sylex |
| `RaidingPartyEffect` | `()` | Each player chooses any number of untapped white creatures they control to tap, then chooses up to two Plains per creature tapped; every unchosen Plains is destroyed after all choices. Resolution is handled by `RaidingPartyEffectHandler`. Used by Raiding Party |
| `SelfExiledFromBattlefieldEffect` | `(CardEffect wrapped)` | Trigger descriptor for `ON_SELF_LEAVES_BATTLEFIELD` that dispatches `wrapped` only when the source permanent's destination is exile. Used by Urza's Sylex's "put into exile from the battlefield" trigger |
| `BendOrBreakEffect` | `()` | Each player separates their nontoken lands into two piles in active-player order, chooses an opponent, and that opponent chooses one pile. All lands in chosen piles are destroyed, then all lands in the other piles are tapped. The queued `PendingBendOrBreak` flow carries each player's piles and choices through multi-permanent, player, and may prompts. Resolved by `BendOrBreakEffectHandler`. Used by Bend or Break |

`ProtectionFromMulticoloredEffect(GrantScope scope)` grants protection from sources with two or more
colors. Use `GrantScope.ENCHANTED_CREATURE` for an Aura that protects its host.
`ProtectionFromColoredSpellsEffect()` grants protection specifically from colored spells, not from
colored permanents or abilities of colored permanents.

## How to use this index
- `GainActivatedAbilitiesOfTargetCreatureUntilEndOfTurnEffect()` — on resolution, the source gains the target creature's currently effective activated abilities until end of turn; benign CREATURE target, stored in `Permanent.temporaryActivatedAbilities` (Quicksilver Elemental)
- `SpendBlueManaAsAnyColorForActivatedAbilitiesEffect()` — STATIC, source-scoped permission allowing blue mana to pay colored requirements in this permanent's activated ability costs; enabled only during that ability's check and payment (Quicksilver Elemental)

| `ChooseOpponentGainsControlOfSourceEffect` | `()` | non-targeting (`ControlStealingEffect`): the ability controller chooses one opponent; that player gains permanent control of the source permanent. One opponent is automatic; multiple opponents use a player choice. Handler `ChooseOpponentGainsControlOfSourceEffectHandler`. Used by Goblin Festival |

`PutAttackingCreaturesOnTopOrBottomOfLibraryEffect()` puts each attacking creature on the top or bottom of its owner's library after a resolution-time choice by that creature's owner. It is non-targeting and is used by Aetherspouts.

1. Parse card text into primitive actions (damage, draw, bounce, etc.).
2. Find each primitive below in the categorized sections and reuse existing effects.
3. Only add new effect records when no existing effect can express the behavior.
4. If you add a new effect record, create a `<EffectName>EffectHandler` `@Component` implementing `NormalEffectHandlerBean` in `service/effect/normalfx/`. `GameEngineConfig` auto-registers `@Component` handlers for production, card tests (`GameTestEngineContext`), and headless simulation (`HeadlessSimulationContext`). See provider map at bottom.
5. If your new effect targets something, override `targetSpec()` on the effect record to return a non-NONE `TargetSpec` (category + harmful flag + optional predicate � see targeting section below). The engine's declarative interpreter offers and type-checks the target from the spec; you do NOT add a validator for ordinary structural targeting.
6. If the new effect's `targetSpec()` includes permanents and it goes in the SPELL or ON_ENTER_BATTLEFIELD slot, the AI must know which board to aim it at: add a rule or map entry to `TargetPolarityClassifier` (`magical-vibes-ai`). `TargetPolarityGuardTest` scans the whole card pool and fails the build if the shape is unclassified � its failure message explains the polarity choices.
7. Only if legal targeting depends on a NON-structural rule the spec cannot express (opponent-relation, controller/owner compare, chosen-source, null-target tolerance) add a `@ValidatesTarget`-annotated method in the appropriate validator class under `service/validate/` � AND still declare the structural `targetSpec()` (see target validator map at bottom).

Implementation note: `ExileTargetPermanentUntilSourceLeavesEffect` accepts an optional `PermanentPredicate` for a narrowed harmful permanent target. `GrantTriggeredAbilityEffect` grants `ON_ENTER_BATTLEFIELD` abilities to an entering permanent through the normal ETB collection path, alongside native ETB effects.

### Permanent type changes

`BecomeCreatureEffect(int power, int toughness, List<CardSubtype> subtypes[, Set<Keyword> keywords[, Set<CardColor> protectionFromColors]])` is a non-targeting source effect that permanently replaces the source card with a runtime copy whose only card type is creature and whose base power, toughness, creature subtypes, and optional keywords are supplied by the effect. Optional protection colors are installed as permanent floating protection. Use it for permanent self-changes that remove an enchantment or other noncreature card type.

`BecomeEnchantmentEffect()` is a non-targeting source effect that restores the source permanent's original card form, including its enchantment type and abilities. Use it to reverse a permanent self-change created by `BecomeCreatureEffect`.

`GrantProtectionFromTriggeringSpellColorsEffect()` is a non-targeting source effect for spell-cast triggers. It reads the triggering spell still on the stack at resolution and adds a permanent floating `ProtectionFromColorsEffect` to the source.

| Interface | Extends | Purpose |
|-----------|---------|---------|
| `CostEffect` | `CardEffect` | Marks effects that represent additional costs (sacrifice, discard, exile, counter removal, tap creature). Cost effects are filtered out during effect snapshotting and excluded from mana ability detection. Implement this instead of `CardEffect` for new cost effects. Also carries DESCRIPTIVE AI cost-valuation facets (all default to neutral): `consumedPermanentFilter()` (`PermanentPredicate` for a payer-chosen sacrifice/return/counter-placement target; mandatory for any spell cost paid via `PlayCardRequest.sacrificePermanentId`), `consumesSourcePermanent()`, `sacrificesChosenCreature()`, `lifePaid(int)`, `sourceCountersRemoved()`, `consumedGraveyardCardCount()`, `consumedGraveyardCardType()`, and `tracksSacrificedCard()` for effects that need the sacrificed card on the activated ability's stack entry. Let `GameSimulator` (payment-planning) and `HardAiDecisionEngine` (cost scoring) read what a cost consumes without `instanceof`-ing each concrete record. Overridden by `SacrificeCreatureCost`, `SacrificePermanentCost`, `SacrificeCreatureOrPayManaCost`, `ReturnCreatureToHandCost`, `PutCounterOnControlledCreatureCost`, `SacrificeSelfCost`, `PayLifeCost`, `RemoveCounterFromSourceCost`, `ExileNCardsFromGraveyardCost`, `ExileNCardsFromSingleGraveyardCost`; other cost records inherit defaults. Payment execution stays concrete in `AbilityActivationService`. |

Lets AI evaluators score burn without `instanceof`-ing each concrete type. Not for split/mass damage (`DealDividedDamageEffect`, `MassDamageEffect`) or amount-less X burn. |

Attack-side counterpart of `BlockCostEffect`; the attack is legal, only the cost gates it. Implemented by `CantAttackUnlessPaysPerCounterEffect` (Phyrexian Marauder). |

Implemented by `MatchingCreaturesCantBlockMatchingCreaturesUnlessPaysLifeEffect` (Heat Wave). |
| `DefendingPlayerAssignsCombatDamageEffect` | `CardEffect` | Descriptive capability for a static effect that makes the defending player assign an attacking creature's combat damage instead of the attacking player. The descriptive interfaces above let the AI (and engine query layer) read a FACT about an effect
instead of `instanceof`-ing the concrete type; implement the matching one when adding an effect to
that family (see `EFFECTS_QUICK_REFERENCE.md`). `CostEffect` is both a marker (cost snapshotting /
mana-ability exclusion) and a descriptive capability (its AI cost-valuation facets). Keep new
concrete-effect `instanceof` out of files outside `service/effect/**` / `service/validate/**` � no
build check enforces that any more, it is a convention the author has to honour.

### Target predicate � the `TargetSpec.predicate()` field

Effects that target permanents can optionally restrict valid targets by putting a `PermanentPredicate` in their `targetSpec()`'s `predicate` field (`benign(TargetPredicates.creature(), predicate)` / `harmful(TargetPredicates.permanent(), predicate)`). The declarative interpreter enforces it at cast, and saga-chapter / end-step targeting pipelines read it through `EffectResolution.targetPredicateOf(effect)`. Absent = `null` (no restriction).

Dual note: `PutCounterOnTargetPermanentEffect.withTargetRestriction(CounterType, int count, PermanentPredicate)` keeps the predicate on a dedicated record COMPONENT (its `targetSpec()` carries a `null` predicate, so there is no cast-time gate); it is honoured only by the saga/end-step pipelines via `EffectResolution.targetPredicateOf`. `GrantKeywordEffect` carries its `filter` in the spec's predicate when `scope == TARGET`.

### Self-targeting � the `TargetSpec.selfTargeting()` field

Effects that implicitly target their source permanent (boost-self, animate-self, regenerate-self, etc.) set `selfTargeting = true` in their `targetSpec()` — written `new TargetSpec(null, false, null, true, 1)`. `ActivatedAbilityExecutionService` reads `targetSpec().selfTargeting()` to auto-assign the source as the target when no explicit target is provided.

Effects doing so: `BoostSelfEffect`, `DoubleSelfPowerToughnessEffect`, `TapPermanentsEffect`/`UntapPermanentsEffect` (only when `scope == TapUntapScope.SELF`), `AnimatePermanentsEffect`/`SetCardTypesUntilEndOfTurnEffect` (only when `scope == GrantScope.SELF`), `SetCardTypesUntilYourNextTurnEffect`, `PutCountersOnSelfEffect`, `PutSlimeCounterAndCreateOozeTokenEffect`, `RegenerateEffect` (when `!targetsPermanent()`), `GrantKeywordEffect` (when `scope == SELF`).

### `isPowerToughnessDefining()` default method on `CardEffect`

Effects that are characteristic-defining abilities (CDAs) for power/toughness (`*/*` effects) override `isPowerToughnessDefining()` to return `true`. Per CR 707.9d, when a copy effect provides specific P/T values (e.g. "except it's 7/7"), CDAs that define P/T are not copied. Used by `CopyPermanentOnEnterEffect` with `powerOverride`/`toughnessOverride`.

Effects returning `true`: `SetPowerToughnessToAmountEffect` (the single CDA record that replaced the entire `PowerToughnessEqualTo*` family and the ooze-token `BoostSelfBySlimeCountersOnLinkedPermanentEffect`).

---
| `TappedBlockPermissionEffect` | `CardEffect` | `tappedBlockMatcher()` returns a `PermanentPredicate` selecting creatures that may block while tapped, or `null` (the default). `BlockLegalityService` evaluates the matcher relative to the permanent carrying the effect, so a controller-relative permission stays correct after control changes. Implemented by `ControlledCreaturesCanBlockAsThoughUntappedEffect` (Masako the Humorless). |

## Effect targeting declarations
- `TargetingRestrictionEffect.hexproofFromMonocolored()` is the static factory for "hexproof from
  monocolored"; use `GrantEffectEffect(..., GrantScope.EQUIPPED_CREATURE)` when an Equipment grants it.

An effect declares what it targets by overriding the single `targetSpec()` method on `CardEffect` to
return a `TargetSpec` (a `TargetPredicate` + a `harmful` flag + an optional `PermanentPredicate` + the
`selfTargeting` / `playerTargetCount` fields). The eleven legacy `canTarget*` / `isSelfTargeting` /
`isDamageOrDestruction` / `targetPredicate` / `requiredPlayerTargetCount` booleans were DELETED
(TargetSpec migration, July 2026) � `targetSpec()` is now the ONE source of truth, and everything
(`EffectResolution.needsTarget(card)` / `needsSpellTarget(card)`, the AI, the trigger collectors, the
`TargetValidationService` interpreter) derives from it. Never call
`setNeedsTarget`/`setNeedsSpellTarget`. For kicker/modal spells use
`EffectResolution.resolveEffects(effects, kicked, modeIndex)` first to get the resolved effect list.

**Modal triggered abilities** (e.g. a "choose one" upkeep trigger, Etherwrought Page): spells/ETB
pick their `ChooseOneEffect` mode at cast time and never reach the stack as a raw ChooseOneEffect; a
triggered ability has no cast, so put the `ChooseOneEffect` directly in the trigger slot and the mode
is picked as the ability resolves. `ChooseOneEffectHandler` (normalfx, handles `ChooseOneEffect.class`)
opens a `ChoiceContext.ChooseModeChoice` list pick; `ChoiceHandlerService.handleChooseModeChoice`
splices the chosen mode's effects into the paused resolution so they resolve in card-text order
(gain/lose life resolve immediately; a surveil mode still queues its "may" prompt). Non-targeting modes
only � a targeted mode would need per-mode trigger-time target selection (cf. RelicBindModeChoice).

**Modal triggered abilities with targets** ("choose one that hasn't been chosen", Demonic Pact): use `ChooseModeNotYetChosenEffect(List<ChooseOneOption>)` in `UPKEEP_TRIGGERED`. `StepTriggerService` queues a `PermanentChoiceContext.UpkeepModalTrigger`, drained BEFORE any targeting, which opens the mode pick with `beginChooseModeChoice(..., triggerTime=true, permanentId)`. `ChoiceHandlerService.handleTriggerTimeModeChoice` records the label on `Permanent.chosenModeLabels` (so a mode is offered once per object) and calls `StepTriggerService.queueChosenModeUpkeepTrigger`, which routes the chosen mode into the ordinary any-target / player-target / non-targeting upkeep pipelines. The mode's own `ChooseOneOption.targetFilter` rides on `UpkeepAnyTargetTrigger` / `UpkeepPlayerTargetTrigger` and overrides the card's filter.

**Factories** (all on `TargetSpec`): `harmful(target)` / `benign(target)` and the predicate-carrying
`harmful(target, predicate)` / `benign(target, predicate)`, where `target` comes from a
`TargetPredicates` factory; plus `TargetSpec.NONE` (targets nothing). Use the full canonical
constructor for self-targeting or a two-player count:
`new TargetSpec(null, false, null, /*selfTargeting*/ true, 1)`,
`new TargetSpec(TargetPredicates.player(), false, null, false, /*playerTargetCount*/ 2)`.

**`harmful`** = true exactly when the effect damages / fights / destroys / exiles / sacrifices its
target (i.e. the target must survive a `checkProtection` test � protection means "can't be
targeted"). Counters, bounces, control-changes, boosts, taps, text changes are `benign`.

`TargetPredicates` factories and what each offers/type-checks. **Build the declared target from one
of these**: the named values are interned, so a spec compares and hashes cheaply and the readers that
mean one specific declaration (`TargetSpec.declares(...)`) match by value. A hand-composed
`TargetPredicate` is legal where no factory fits — a cross-kind target is an `anyOf` of at most one
leaf per kind — but prefer adding a named factory when a second card wants the same shape:

| Factory | Legal target |
|---------|--------------|
| `null` / `TargetSpec.NONE` | nothing (default) |
| `TargetPredicates.player()` | a player |
| `TargetPredicates.playerOrPermanent()` | a player or any permanent — declares **no** restriction; see the warning below |
| `TargetPredicates.permanent()` | any permanent |
| `TargetPredicates.creature()` | a creature (layer-aware) |
| `TargetPredicates.land()` | a land (layer-aware) |
| `TargetPredicates.creatureOrPlaneswalker()` | a creature or planeswalker (layer-aware) |
| `TargetPredicates.playerOrPlaneswalker()` | a player or planeswalker (layer-aware) |
| `TargetPredicates.anyTarget()` | any target (player / creature / planeswalker / battle — CR 115.4), layer-aware |
| `TargetPredicates.spellOnStack()` | a spell on the stack (validated on the stack path) |
| `TargetPredicates.graveyardCard(scope)` | a card in a graveyard — `scope` is a `GraveyardSearchScope` (`CONTROLLERS_GRAVEYARD` / `OPPONENT_GRAVEYARD` / `ALL_GRAVEYARDS`) |
| `TargetPredicates.exileCard()` | a card in exile |

> **The graveyard scope is a declaration, not a hint.** Every enumeration and validation path reads
> it through `TargetSpec.graveyardScope()` and expands it with
> `GraveyardSearchScope.graveyardOwners(orderedPlayerIds, controllerId)` — there is no second place
> that decides which graveyards to search. Declare exactly what the oracle text names: "from your
> graveyard" is `CONTROLLERS_GRAVEYARD`, "from an opponent's graveyard" is `OPPONENT_GRAVEYARD`,
> "from a graveyard" is `ALL_GRAVEYARDS`. An effect whose scope varies per card carries a
> `GraveyardSearchScope` component and passes it straight through
> (`ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.source`, `CastTargetInstantOrSorceryFromGraveyardEffect.scope`,
> `ExileTargetCardFromGraveyardAndImprintOnSourceEffect.scope`); never hard-code one scope in
> `targetSpec()` and rely on a `@ValidatesTarget` validator to catch the difference.

Fine-grained narrowing (artifact-only, nonland, a subtype) is the spec's `PermanentPredicate` field,
NOT a new category. Conditional effects (a `scope` / `recipient` that sometimes targets nothing)
compute a per-instance spec, e.g. `recipient == TARGET_PLAYER ? benign(player()) : NONE`.

> **`playerOrPermanent()` restricts nothing — never reach for it to buy tolerance.** It is the
> honest spelling for a multi-target effect whose per-position `TargetFilter`s carry the real
> restriction (Fight, Brass Squire, the fight/attach/move-counter families). It is NOT a way to make
> the spec interpreter leave an effect alone: an effect whose targets ride on
> `StackEntry.damageAssignments` gets its null-`targetId` tolerance from
> `EffectResolution.distributesAmountsAmongTargets` and still declares what it really targets
> (`DealDividedDamageEffect`, `DistributeCountersAmongTargetsEffect`, `PreventDividedDamageEffect`).
> Declaring `playerOrPermanent()` on a slot with no `TargetFilter` means every permanent — lands,
> artifacts, enchantments — is a legal target of that slot.

**A target slot with no `TargetFilter` is restricted by what its effects declare.** For a spell or
ability position that carries neither a card/ability-level `TargetFilter` nor a per-position one,
`EffectResolution.declaredPermanentRestriction` conjoins every permanent restriction the slot's
effects declare, and both target enumeration (`ValidTargetService`) and cast/activation validation
(`TargetLegalityService`) evaluate it. "Any target" (CR 115.4 — a creature, player or planeswalker)
is therefore a declaration, not something inferred from an effect also accepting players. A slot no
effect restricts keeps the legacy creature-only default when it is multi-target.

"Layer-aware" means the type test is `GameQueryService.isCreature` / `isLand` / `isPlaneswalker`
after the CR 613 pass, never the printed type line: an animated land is a legal "target creature",
a creature a type-**replacing** effect turned into a land is a legal "target land", and a
planeswalker that stopped being one is not a legal "any target" (CR 613.1d, CR 115.4). The
interpreter reaches all of them through one composed `PermanentPredicate` — the declared target's
own restriction and the spec's narrowing predicate folded together by `TargetSpec.targetPredicate()`.

**How to ask a spec a question.** There is no target-category enum any more; `TargetSpec` exposes
three readers and each answers a different question:

| Reader | Question | Use it for |
|---|---|---|
| `admits(TargetPredicate.Kind.X)` | can a target of this kind ever be legal? | the trigger collectors, `StepTriggerService`, the AI, "does this need a permanent target at all" |
| `declares(TargetPredicates.x())` | is this *exactly* that declaration? | when one specific declaration is meant — `anyTarget()` vs `playerOrPermanent()` |
| `declaredTarget() == null` | does it target nothing? | the successor to the old `NONE` comparison |

`admits(PLAYER) && admits(PERMANENT)` is **not** a test for "any target": `playerOrPermanent()`
answers it too, and the two mean very different things. That lossy inference is the defect the
targeting model was rebuilt to remove — use `declares(TargetPredicates.anyTarget())`.
`PREDICATES_REFERENCE.md` documents the type; `agent-docs/TARGET_PREDICATE_PLAN.md` has the history.

### Worked example � a new "deal N damage to target creature" effect

```java
public record ZapTargetCreatureEffect(int damage) implements CardEffect {
    @Override
    public TargetSpec targetSpec() {
        return TargetSpec.harmful(TargetPredicates.creature()); // damage → harmful; creatures only
    }
}
```

That is the WHOLE targeting declaration: the interpreter in `TargetValidationService` offers only
creatures, rejects a creature with protection from the source (because `harmful`), and needs no
`@ValidatesTarget` validator (the declared target is purely structural). To restrict further — say
"target artifact creature" — pass a predicate: `TargetSpec.harmful(TargetPredicates.creature(), new
PermanentIsArtifactPredicate())`.

Add a `@ValidatesTarget` validator ONLY when legality depends on a rule the declared target + predicate
cannot express (opponent-relation, controller/owner compare, chosen-source, null-target tolerance) �
and such an effect STILL declares its structural `targetSpec()` (the `TargetSpecRatchetTest` guard
enforces this). See the target validator map at the bottom.

### Multi-target group binding (spells with several distinct targets)

A spell like "Target creature gets +1/+1 � Another target creature gets -1/-1" declares one
`target(filter)` group per distinct target and binds an ordinary, position-agnostic effect to
each group:

```java
target(creatureFilter).addEffect(EffectSlot.SPELL, new BoostTargetCreatureEffect(1, 1));
target(creatureFilter).addEffect(EffectSlot.SPELL, new BoostTargetCreatureEffect(-1, -1));
```

At resolution, an effect bound to a group applies to **all targets chosen for that group**
(`StackEntry.targetsForEffect` slices the flat target list by the card's declarations;
`EffectResolutionService` also remaps `entry.targetId` to the group's first target for
single-target handlers). An unbound effect (plain `addEffect`) keeps the legacy semantics �
the whole flat target list. **Never create position-named effect classes**
(`XxxFirstTargetEffect`/`XxxSecondTargetEffect`); reuse the generic effect and bind it to the
right group. Wrapper effects (`ConditionalEffect`, `MayEffect`, �) propagate the binding to
their inner effect automatically.

Rules of thumb:
- Per CR 608.2b the spell resolves partially: a group whose targets are all gone simply does
  nothing; the spell fizzles only when ALL chosen targets are illegal.
- Graveyard target groups declare their scope in the group's filter
  (`GraveyardCardPredicateTargetFilter(cardPredicate, GraveyardSearchScope)`), which is how a spell
  takes two graveyard targets from different graveyards (Spelltwine). Enumeration, cast-time
  validation and the CR 608.2b recheck are all per-position off that filter; the effect that consumes
  them stays **unbound** so it sees every chosen card.
- A variable-count group ("up to N": `target(filter, 0, N)`) must be the **last** declared
  group � the flat wire format fills groups in declaration order, so an earlier variable group
  would be ambiguous.
- The only effects that inherently read two targets carry their group indices as record DATA:
  `FightTargetsEffect(firstGroup, secondGroup)` and
  `TargetDealsPowerDamageToTargetEffect(sourceGroup, victimGroup)` (both default to `(0, 1)`).
  For activated abilities (which declare targets via `multiTargetFilters`, not `target()`),
  these indices address flat target positions instead.

### Per-blocker trigger mode

Effects in the `ON_BECOMES_BLOCKED` slot can be registered with `TriggerMode.PER_BLOCKER` via `addEffect(slot, effect, TriggerMode.PER_BLOCKER)`, causing CombatService to create one stack entry per blocking creature (e.g. "whenever this creature becomes blocked **by a creature**"). Cards using this: `SylvanBasilisk`, `EngulfingSlagwurm` (ON_BECOMES_BLOCKED only), `InfiltrationLens`.

`ON_BECOMES_BLOCKED` fires only for *this* creature. For "whenever **a creature you control** becomes blocked" (any of your creatures), use `ON_ALLY_CREATURE_BECOMES_BLOCKED` � fires once per blocked attacker on every permanent with the slot on the blocked creature's controller's battlefield. Non-targeting effects use the blocked creature as the non-targeting `sourcePermanentId` so `BoostSelfEffect` applies to "it"; permanent/player-targeting effects use the shared `AttackTriggerTarget` pipeline and the watching permanent as `sourcePermanentId`. Used by `UnstoppableAsh` and `CloseQuarters`.

For "whenever **a creature** blocks" with no controller restriction, use `ON_ANY_CREATURE_BLOCKS` — fires once per blocking creature during declare blockers on every permanent with the slot across all battlefields, with the blocker as the stack entry's non-targeting `targetId`. Used by `CarnageGladiator` (`LoseLifeEffect(1, TARGET_PERMANENT_CONTROLLER)`).

For "whenever **a creature** becomes blocked" with no controller restriction at all (a global watcher on an enchantment), use `ON_ANY_CREATURE_BECOMES_BLOCKED` — fires once per attacker/blocker pair on every permanent with the slot across all battlefields. Its effects must implement `BlockPairConditionalEffect`, whose `firesForPair(attackerPower, blockerPower)` is evaluated as a trigger *condition* when blockers are declared (never re-checked on resolution) and whose `actsOn()` participant becomes the stack entry's non-targeting `targetId`. Used by `NoQuarter`.

For a card-subtype-qualified form that should fire once per matching blocked attacker, wrap the effect in `TriggeringCardConditionalEffect`; the combat collector evaluates the card predicate globally and queues the wrapped effect with the blocked attacker as both source and non-targeting target. Spined Sliver uses this with `CardSubtypePredicate(SLIVER)` and `BoostSelfEffect(CreaturesBlockingSource(), CreaturesBlockingSource())`.

### Becomes-target-of-spell trigger

Effects in the `ON_BECOMES_TARGET_OF_SPELL` slot fire when the permanent (or the creature an equipment is attached to) becomes the target of a spell (spells only � not abilities). Two kinds of effect are supported, split by `targetSpec()`:
- **Targeting effects** (non-`NONE` category, e.g. `DealDamageToAnyTargetEffect`) route through the shared "choose any target" interaction � "deal 2 damage to any target" when the equipped creature becomes targeted (`LivewireLash`).
- **`TriggeringSpellReferencingEffect`s** (e.g. `TargetSpellControllerLosesLifeEffect`) go onto the stack as a `TRIGGERED_ABILITY` pointed at the *triggering spell's* card in the `STACK` zone, so "whenever this becomes the target of a spell, that spell's controller loses 5 life" reuses the counterspell-companion effects with no new record (`ForsakenWastes`). Checked before the two buckets below.
- The same triggering-object reference path is available to `ON_BECOMES_TARGET_OF_SPELL_OR_ABILITY`; the queued ability carries the triggering spell or activated ability in the `STACK` zone and preserves the source Aura id. `TriggeringObjectControllerGainsControlOfEnchantedPermanentEffect` uses both references for Fractured Loyalty.
- **Non-targeting effects** (`TargetSpec.NONE`, e.g. `SacrificeSelfEffect`) go straight onto the stack as a `TRIGGERED_ABILITY` with `sourcePermanentId` set to the source � "When this creature becomes the target of a spell, sacrifice it" (`LabyrinthGuardian`; `JaceCunningCastaway`'s Illusion tokens). The any-target interaction never records a source, so a self-referential effect must take this path or it would no-op.

An **attached** permanent (Aura/Equipment) with this slot monitors only its host: the trigger fires when the enchanted/equipped creature is targeted, never when the attachment itself is targeted, and the resulting ability is controlled by the attachment's controller (CR 603.3a) even when the host belongs to an opponent. `SpectralPrison` = `DoesntUntapEffect.enchanted()` (STATIC) + `SacrificeSelfEffect` in this slot.

### Becomes-target-of-Aura-spell trigger

Effects in the `ON_BECOMES_TARGET_OF_AURA_SPELL` slot fire when the permanent itself becomes the target of an **Aura spell** (`Card.isAura()` on the triggering stack entry). Spells only, no controller restriction — an opponent's Aura and the controller's own Aura both trigger it. The ability goes straight onto the stack as a `TRIGGERED_ABILITY` with `sourcePermanentId` set, controlled by the targeted permanent's controller. Unlike `ON_BECOMES_TARGET_OF_SPELL`, attached permanents are not scanned for this slot. Cards using this: `FugitiveDruid` (`DrawCardEffect`).

### Becomes-target-of-spell-or-ability trigger

Effects in the `ON_BECOMES_TARGET_OF_SPELL_OR_ABILITY` slot fire when the permanent (or a permanent it is attached to) becomes the target of any spell or activated ability. The triggered ability goes directly on the stack with `sourcePermanentId` set to the source permanent. Cards using this: `IceCage`. The slot also picks up abilities granted continuously via `GrantTriggeredAbilityEffect(ON_BECOMES_TARGET_OF_SPELL_OR_ABILITY, ...)` (Dismiss into Dream).

Special case � "counter that spell or ability for the first time each turn" (`GlyphKeeper`): put a `CounterSpellEffect` (any `CounterSpellingEffect`) in this slot. `TriggerCollectionService` recognizes the counterspelling effect, fires the trigger **at most once per turn per permanent** (gated by `Permanent.becomeTargetCounterUsedThisTurn`, reset at turn start), and sets the trigger's `targetId`/`targetZone` to the triggering spell/ability's card in the STACK zone so the counter finds the object that targeted it. No controller restriction � it counters the controller's own spells too.

### Ally creature becomes target of opponent spell or ability trigger

Effects in the `ON_ALLY_CREATURE_BECOMES_TARGET_OF_OPPONENT_SPELL_OR_ABILITY` slot fire on ALL permanents with this slot on the creature's controller's battlefield whenever a creature that player controls becomes the target of a spell or ability controlled by an opponent. Unlike the `ON_BECOMES_TARGET_*` slots (which fire on the targeted permanent itself), this slot fires on a separate permanent that monitors the event globally. Cards using this: `ShapersSanctuary`.

The `ON_ALLY_CREATURE_OR_CREATURE_SPELL_BECOMES_TARGET_OF_OPPONENT_SPELL_OR_ABILITY` slot is the corresponding watcher for cards whose text explicitly includes both a creature and a creature spell. It also fires when a creature spell on the stack controlled by that player becomes the target of an opponent's spell or ability. Cards using this: `SurrakElusiveHunter`.

### Any creature becomes target of spell or ability trigger

Effects in the `ON_ANY_CREATURE_BECOMES_TARGET_OF_SPELL_OR_ABILITY` slot fire on ALL permanents with this slot across every battlefield whenever ANY creature (any controller) becomes the target of ANY spell or ability. Broader than `ON_ALLY_CREATURE_BECOMES_TARGET_OF_OPPONENT_SPELL_OR_ABILITY` (no controller/opponent restriction). The targeted creature is set as the non-targeting `targetId` so the resolved effect can act on it � pair with `ReturnToHandEffect.target()` for "return that creature to its owner's hand". Cards using this: `Cowardice`.

### Opponent creature becomes target of your spell or ability trigger

Effects in the `ON_OPPONENT_CREATURE_BECOMES_TARGET_OF_YOUR_SPELL_OR_ABILITY` slot fire on ALL permanents with this slot on the *spell/ability controller's* battlefield whenever a creature an opponent of theirs controls becomes the target of that spell or ability. The mirror image of `ON_ALLY_CREATURE_BECOMES_TARGET_OF_OPPONENT_SPELL_OR_ABILITY`. The targeted creature is set as the non-targeting `targetId` and the listening permanent as the `sourcePermanentId`, so source-linked durations resolve correctly — pair with `GainControlOfTargetEffect(ControlDuration.WHILE_SOURCE_ON_BATTLEFIELD)` for "gain control of that creature for as long as you control this". Cards using this: `Willbreaker`.

### Ally creature becomes target of instant or sorcery trigger

Effects in the `ON_ALLY_CREATURE_BECOMES_TARGET_OF_INSTANT_OR_SORCERY` slot fire on ALL permanents with this slot on the creature's controller's battlefield whenever a creature that player controls becomes the target of an instant or sorcery spell. Only the spell path checks it (activated/triggered abilities never trigger it) and there is no controller restriction, so the creature's controller's own spells trigger it too. The targeted creature is set as the non-targeting `targetId` so the resolved effect can act on it � pair with `BoostTargetCreatureEffect` for "that creature gets +3/+3 until end of turn". Cards using this: `WildDefiance`.

## Wrapper / modifier effects
- `TargetPermanentColorCount()` is a target-relative `DynamicAmount` that counts the target
  permanent's current effective colors at activation time.

### Conditional effects (the `Condition` model)

`CardsInHandMatchingAtLeast(n, filter)` counts the controller's hand cards matching the supplied card predicate (Sasaya, Orochi Ascendant's seven land cards).

Game-state conditions are **data**, not classes: the sealed interface
`model/condition/Condition` has one small record per condition (`Metalcraft`, `MaxSpeed`, `Morbid`,
`Kicked`, `RepeatedAdditionalCostPaid(manaCost)`, `Raid`, `Equipped`, `ControlsPermanent(filter)`,
`ControlsPermanentCount(minCount, filter)` (at least), `ControlsPermanentCountAtMost(maxCount, filter)` (at most),
`AnyPlayerControlsPermanent(filter)`, `AnyPlayerControlsPermanentCount(minCount, filter)` (N+ across all battlefields),
`AnyPlayerControlsPermanentCountAtMost(maxCount, filter)` (at most N across all battlefields � use `0` for "no matching permanents on the battlefield"; Pestilence's end-step self-sacrifice when no creatures exist; also gated as an intervening-if at `UPKEEP_TRIGGERED` in `StepTriggerService` — Spirit Mirror's "if there are no Reflection tokens on the battlefield"),
`OpponentControlsPermanent(filter)`, `DefendingPlayerControlsPermanent(filter)`, `ControlsMoreCreaturesThanOpponent`,
`APlayerControlsMoreCreaturesThanEachOtherPlayer`,
`APlayerHasMoreCardsInHandThanEachOtherPlayer`,
`DefendingPlayerPoisoned`,
`OpponentPoisoned`, `OpponentDealtDamageThisTurn(minimumAmount)` (an opponent was dealt N+ damage this turn � use `1` for "any damage"; Bloodcrazed Goblin, Spinerock Knoll), `ControllerDealtDamageThisTurn(minimumAmount)` (the controller-relative counterpart — *you* were dealt N+ damage this turn, combat or not; reads the same `GameData.damageDealtToPlayersThisTurn`; Boarded Window's end-step self-exile), `DealtDamageByRedSpellThisTurn()` (the controller was dealt damage this turn by a red instant or sorcery spell � reads `GameData.lastRedSpellDamagerThisTurn`, recorded in `DamageSupport.dealDamageToPlayer`; Suffocation's `setCastCondition`), `OpponentLostLifeThisTurn(minimumAmount)` (an opponent lost N+ life this turn from any source, damage included � reads `lifeLostThisTurn`; Sygg, River Cutthroat; `isEtbTriggerGate()` for intervening-if ETBs like Voldaren Ambusher),
`OpponentGainedLifeThisTurn(minimumAmount)` (an opponent gained N+ life this turn; Needlebite Trap),
`AnyPlayerLostLifeThisTurn(minimumAmount)` (any player lost N+ life this turn from any source, including damage; supports intervening-if triggers),
`ControllerLifeAtLeast(n)`,
`ControllerDidntLoseLifeThisTurn` (the source's controller lost no life this turn; damage counts as life loss; Luminarch Ascension),
`AnOpponentLifeAtMost(n)` (at least one opponent of the controller has N or less life; Blood Baron of Vizkopa's static boost, combined with `ControllerLifeAtLeast(30)` via `AllConditions`),
`OpponentLostLifeLastTurn()` (an opponent of the controller lost life during the immediately preceding turn; Feast on the Fallen),
`OpponentOwnsCardInExile()` (an opponent of the controller owns a card in exile; the controller's own exiled cards are excluded; Warden of the Beyond),
`ControllerLifeAtMost(n)`, `EachPlayerLifeAtMost(n)` (every player's life total is at or below N; upkeep intervening-if for Cryptolith Fragment's "if each player has 10 or less life"), `GraveyardCardThreshold(n, filter)`, `CardsInLibraryAtLeast(n)` (controller has N+ cards in library; Battle of Wits), `AnyLibraryAtMost(n)` (some player's library has N or fewer cards; Shelldock Isle), `AnyGraveyardAtLeast(n)` (some player's graveyard has N or more cards; Visions of Beyond), `OpponentGraveyardAtLeast(n)` (an opponent of the controller has N or more cards in their graveyard � controller's own graveyard excluded; Jace's Phantasm), `CardsInHandAtLeast(n)` (controller has N+ cards in hand; Imaginary Pet), `CardsInHandAtMost(n)` (controller has N or fewer cards in hand; Thresher Lizard STATIC +1/+2 with threshold 1), `ActivePlayerHandAtLeast(n)` (the player whose upkeep/step it is has N+ cards in hand � Misers' Cage's "if that player has five or more cards in hand" on OPPONENT_UPKEEP_TRIGGERED), `ActivePlayerHandEmpty` (the player whose upkeep/step it is has no cards in hand � gates upkeep triggers that read "if you/that player have no cards in hand"; Hollowborn Barghest), `ActivePlayerControlsPermanent(filter)` (the player whose upkeep/step it is controls a permanent matching the predicate — "if that player controls a nonblack, nonland permanent" on EACH_UPKEEP_TRIGGERED; Urborg Stalker), `ControllerHandEmpty` (controller has no cards in hand � Idle Thoughts activated; Bloodhall Priest ETB/attack gate via `isEtbTriggerGate` + `CombatAttackService` filter), `CastFromZone(zone)`,
`AttacksAlone`, `DuringCombat` (met while the current step is one of the five combat steps; encodes "dies during combat" — Mongrel Pack's `ON_DEATH` `ConditionalEffect`), `FirstCombatPhase` (met when the current combat phase is the turn's first — reads `GameData.combatPhasesThisTurn == 1`; gates additional-combat effects from looping across the extra combats they create, Finest Hour's intervening "if it's the first combat phase of the turn"), `MinimumAttackers(n)`, `AttackedWithCreaturesThisTurn(minimum)` (controller declared N+ attacking creatures this turn, cumulative across combats; Windbrisk Heights), `HasAttacker(predicate)`, `AllMatchingCreaturesAttack(filter)` (every controlled permanent matching the filter is attacking; vacuous if none match — Mob Mentality), `NoSpellsCastLastTurn`,
`TwoOrMoreSpellsCastLastTurn`, `SourceCounterThreshold(n, type)`, `SourceCounterCountParity(parity)` (the total number of counters on the source permanent is odd/even), `SourceUntapped` (the source permanent is untapped — Sphinx Sovereign's end-step branch), `TopCardOfLibraryColor(color)`,
`ChosenColorStrictlyMostCommonAmongOpponentNontokens` (Call to Arms: source's chosen color is strictly most common among an opponent's nontoken permanents; multicolor counts per color, colorless ignored, tokens ignored),
`ColorMostCommonAmongAllPermanents` (the given color is most common among all permanents or tied; multicolor counts for each color, colorless ignored),
`AllNonartifactCreaturesShareColor` (every nonartifact creature on the battlefield shares at least one effective color; artifact creatures are ignored and colorless creatures never satisfy it),
`SourceIsRenowned` (the source permanent is renowned, CR 702.112b — the intervening-if of "whenever this creature attacks, if it's renowned"; filtered at trigger time in `CombatAttackService`; Consul's Lieutenant),
`SourceIsSaddled` (the source permanent is saddled until end of turn; the attack trigger condition of "whenever this creature attacks while saddled" is filtered at declaration time in `CombatAttackService`; Brightfield Glider),
`SelfHasKeyword(keyword)`, `ControllerTurn`, `NotControllerTurn`,
`ControllerOwnTurnCountAtMost(n)` (it is the controller's turn and they have taken at most `n` turns this
game, per `GameData.turnsTakenByPlayer`, extra turns included � wrap in `NotCondition` for Serra Avenger's
"you can't cast this during your first, second, or third turns of the game"), `SourceHasSubtype(subtype)`,
`TargetPermanentMatches(filter)`, `WonClash` (the controller won their most recent clash � written by
`ClashEffect` during resolution, read by a later effect on the same stack entry; e.g. Whirlpool Whelm's
"if you win, you may put that creature on top of its owner's library instead"), and more � see the
package for the full list). Two generic wrappers combine a condition with effects:

- `ConditionalEffect(Condition condition, CardEffect wrapped)` � resolves/applies `wrapped`
  only while the condition is met (intervening-if / "as long as" patterns). Targeting
  delegates to the wrapped effect.
- `ConditionalReplacementEffect(Condition condition, CardEffect baseEffect, CardEffect upgradedEffect)`
  � resolves `upgradedEffect` when the condition is met, otherwise `baseEffect`
  ("instead" upgrade patterns, e.g. kicker). Targeting delegates to both. A 2-arg convenience
  form `ConditionalReplacementEffect(condition, upgradedEffect)` sets `baseEffect` to `null`
  ("apply this effect iff the condition is met, otherwise nothing"); it is meaningful only for
  entry-time replacement effects (the conditional enters-tapped land cycles), never for stack
  resolution.

`ControllerPlayedAtLeastLandsThisTurn(minimum)` checks the controller's land-play count for the
current turn. It is useful as a trigger-time gate after a land-play event has been counted.

All conditions are evaluated in one place, the engine's `ConditionEvaluationService`
(exhaustive switch over the sealed hierarchy � adding a condition without an evaluation is a
compile error). New conditions: add the record to `model/condition/`, add it to the `permits`
list on `Condition`, and add its case to `ConditionEvaluationService.isMet`. Never add a new
per-condition wrapper effect class.

`TargetPlayerLifeTotalEquals(n)` checks the targeted player's life total at resolution. It is a
resolution-time condition, so it does not narrow which players can be targeted.

### Dynamic amounts (the `DynamicAmount` model)

`CountersOnStackEntryCard(CounterType)` reads counters on the source spell's stack object while it remains on the stack (Lightning Storm).

- `TriggeringSpellColorCount()` — the number of effective colors of the spell that caused the
  current triggered ability. Use for spell-cast triggers that draw or otherwise count that spell's
  colors (Moonveil Regent).
