| `SacrificeUnlessSacrificeOwnPermanentEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate filter, String description)` | sacrifice this permanent unless you sacrifice a matching permanent you control; auto-sacrifices when nothing matches (Sacred Mesa: `PermanentHasSubtypePredicate(PEGASUS)`, `"a Pegasus"`) |
| `ExileUnlessDiscardCardTypeEffect` | `(CardType requiredType)` | exile the source permanent unless its controller discards a card of the required type during resolution; no valid card means the source is exiled automatically (Body Snatcher, `ON_ENTER_BATTLEFIELD`) |
| `SacrificeSelfUnlessSacrificeCreaturesWithTotalPowerEffect` | `(int requiredPower)` | sacrifice this permanent unless you sacrifice any number of creatures with total power `requiredPower` or greater (Phyrexian Dreadnought, 12). Excludes the source; auto-sacrifices the source when the other creatures' total effective power falls short, otherwise a `MultiPermanentChoiceContext.SacrificeCreaturesWithTotalPowerOrSacrificeSource` prompt � an empty pick sacrifices the source, a pick below the threshold is rejected and the prompt stands |
| `ChampionCreatureEffect` | `(CardSubtype... championedSubtypes)` � no-arg ctor = any creature; multiple subtypes match inclusively ("Goblin or Shaman", Lightning Crafter) | champion a creature (or creature of one of the subtypes): on ETB sacrifice unless you exile another matching creature you control; when this leaves the battlefield the exiled card returns. Uses `PermanentChoiceContext.ChampionCreature` + `exileReturnOnPermanentLeave`. Used by Changeling Hero. For a "when a creature is championed with this" follow-up trigger, add the triggered effect to the `ON_CHAMPIONED` slot � it fires from `PermanentChoiceBattlefieldHandlerService.handleChampionCreature` right after the exile (player-targeting effects route through `PermanentChoiceContext.ChampionedTriggerTarget`; Mistbind Clique) |
| `DestroyNonlandPermanentsWithManaValueEqualToChargeCountersEffect` | `()` | destroy each nonland permanent with mana value equal to the number of charge counters on source (reads snapshotted count from xValue). Used by Ratchet Bomb |
| `DestroyNonlandPermanentsWithManaValueXDealtCombatDamageEffect` | `()` | destroy each nonland permanent with mana value equal to X whose controller was dealt combat damage by the source permanent this turn. Reads X from xValue, checks combatDamageToPlayersThisTurn. Used by Steel Hellkite |
| `SacrificeSelfAndTargetDiscardsPerPoisonCounterEffect` | `()` | "sacrifice this, then that player discards a card for each poison counter they have." Wrap in `MayEffect` for "you may" behavior. Used on ON_COMBAT_DAMAGE_TO_PLAYER triggers where "that player" is the damaged player. StackEntry context: targetId = damaged player, sourcePermanentId = source creature. Resolved by `PlayerInteractionResolutionService` |
| `SacrificeSelfToDestroyCreatureDamagedPlayerControlsEffect` | `(boolean cannotBeRegenerated, List<UUID> eligibleTargetIds)`; one/no-arg constructors leave the snapshot empty | "sacrifice this, then destroy target creature that player controls." Wrap in `MayEffect` for "you may" behavior. Used on ON_COMBAT_DAMAGE_TO_PLAYER (Blind Zealot) and ON_ATTACKS_UNBLOCKED (Necrite, `cannotBeRegenerated=true`) triggers where "that player" is the damaged / defending player. Trigger collectors snapshot eligible creature IDs; after the may is accepted the choice is mandatory and limited to still-legal snapshotted permanents. StackEntry context: targetId = affected player, sourcePermanentId = source creature. |
| `TransformSelfAndAttachToCreatureDamagedPlayerControlsEffect` | `()` | "transform this, then attach it to target creature that player controls." Wrap in `MayEffect` for "you may transform" behavior. Used on ON_COMBAT_DAMAGE_TO_PLAYER triggers where "that player" is the damaged player (e.g. Soul Seizer). StackEntry context: targetId = damaged player, sourcePermanentId = source permanent. Presents multi-permanent choice (max 1), then transforms and attaches via `AnimationResolutionService.completeTransformAndAttach`. Applies `ControlEnchantedCreatureEffect` steal when present on the back face |
| `SacrificeAtEndOfCombatEffect` | `()` or `(int damageToController)` | sacrifice the source at end of combat. With `damageToController > 0` ("sacrifice it and it deals N damage to you", Time Elemental = 5) the source also deals that much damage to its controller at end of combat via `CombatService.processEndOfCombatSacrifices`; the damage is a delayed trigger dealt with last-known information, so it fires even if the creature already left the battlefield. Put on ON_ATTACK / ON_BLOCK |
| `DestroySelfAtEndOfCombatEffect` | `()` | schedule the source permanent for **destruction** at end of combat (regeneration/indestructible apply, unlike sacrifice). "When this creature blocks/attacks, destroy it at end of combat." Put on ON_BLOCK / ON_ATTACK; queues a `DelayedPermanentAction(DESTROY_AT_END_OF_COMBAT)` delayed action drained in `CombatService.processEndOfCombatDestructions()`. See Cinder Wall |
| `ReturnSelfToHandAtEndOfCombatEffect` | `()` | schedule the source permanent to be **returned to its owner's hand** at end of combat. "When this creature attacks or blocks, return it to its owner's hand at end of combat." Put on ON_ATTACK / ON_BLOCK; queues a `DelayedPermanentAction(RETURN_TO_HAND_AT_END_OF_COMBAT)` drained in `CombatService.processEndOfCombatReturnsToHand()`, which skips the source if it already left the battlefield. See Phantom Whelp |
| `PutSelfOnTopOfLibraryAtEndOfCombatEffect` | `()` | schedule the source permanent to be **put on top of its owner's library** at end of combat. "When this creature attacks or blocks, put it on top of its owner's library at end of combat." Put on ON_ATTACK / ON_BLOCK; queues a `DelayedPermanentAction(PUT_ON_TOP_OF_LIBRARY_AT_END_OF_COMBAT)` drained in `CombatService.processEndOfCombatLibraryTucks()`, which skips the source if it already left the battlefield. See Saprazzan Outrigger |
| `PutCounterOnCombatOpponentAtEndOfCombatEffect` | `(CounterType counterType, int amount)` or `(�, boolean alsoTap)` | schedule the **combat opponent** (the creature this permanent blocks, or that becomes blocked by it) to get `amount` counters of `counterType` at end of combat. "At end of combat, put a [counter] on each creature blocking or blocked by this creature." Put on ON_BLOCK (`needsAttackerTarget` in `CombatBlockService` binds the blocked attacker) + ON_BECOMES_BLOCKED (`TriggerMode.PER_BLOCKER`, binds each blocker); queues a `PutCounterOnPermanentAtEndOfCombat` delayed action drained in `CombatService.processEndOfCombatOpponentCounters()` (respects `cantHaveCounters`). Greater Werewolf = `(CounterType.MINUS_ZERO_MINUS_TWO, 1)`; Dread Wight = `(CounterType.PARALYZATION, 1, true)` � also taps the opponent; paralyzation counters prevent untap during the untap step (source-independent) and grant `{4}: Remove a paralyzation counter from this creature` on placement. The `MINUS_ZERO_MINUS_TWO` counter subtracts 2 toughness each (`Permanent.getEffectiveToughness`/`getToughnessModifiers`, `CharacteristicState`) |
| `PutCounterOnCombatOpponentEffect` | `(CounterType counterType, int amount[, CardEffect grantedStaticEffect, CardEffect grantedUpkeepEffect])` | puts counters on the **combat opponent** immediately on resolution. A `CombatOpponentReferencingEffect`, so the block pipeline bakes the opponent into the non-targeting `targetId`. Placement respects counter prevention. Optional effects are granted persistently only when counters are placed; Mindbender Spores supplies its fungus-counter untap lock and upkeep-removal ability this way. Counter names have no intrinsic rules |
| `DestroyTargetPermanentAtEndOfCombatEffect` | `()` or `(boolean cannotBeRegenerated)` | schedule the **targeted** permanent for destruction at end of combat. Unlike `DestroyCombatOpponentAtEndOfCombatEffect` the permanent is a real chosen target; unlike `DestroySelfAtEndOfCombatEffect` it is the target rather than the source. Queues a `DelayedPermanentAction(DESTROY_AT_END_OF_COMBAT)` drained in `CombatService.processEndOfCombatDestructions()` (regeneration/indestructible apply). `RemovalEffect` DESTROY; `targetSpec()` = harmful CREATURE. Use for "�? Destroy it at end of combat" riders � Goblin Sappers pairs it with `MakeCreatureUnblockableEffect` (and `DestroySelfAtEndOfCombatEffect` on the {R}{R} mode) |
| `DealDamageToTargetCreatureAtEndOfCombatEffect` | `(DynamicAmount damage)`; convenience `(int)` | schedule the **source** to deal `damage` damage to the **targeted** creature at end of combat � the delayed sibling of `DealDamageToTargetCreatureEffect`. The target is chosen on activation, the damage happens once combat ends. Resolution evaluates the amount and queues a `DealDamageToPermanentAtEndOfCombat` (carrying the source card, so last-known information still applies if the source left the battlefield); drained in `CombatService.processEndOfCombatDamage()`, which runs state-based actions afterwards so lethal damage kills. `DamageDealingEffect` (creatures only); `targetSpec()` = harmful CREATURE. See Dwarven Sea Clan |
| `DestroyCombatOpponentsOfTargetAtEndOfCombatEffect` | `()` | "Choose target creature. At this turn's next end of combat, destroy all creatures that blocked or were blocked by it this turn" (Venomous Breath). Unlike `DestroyCombatOpponentAtEndOfCombatEffect` (a Basilisk-style combat trigger on the source permanent) this is a one-shot spell effect keyed to a chosen target. Resolution queues a `DestroyCombatOpponentsAtEndOfCombat` delayed action; the creatures to destroy are only computed at drain time from `GameData.combatBlockOpponentIdsThisTurn` (recorded for both directions at declare-blockers time in `CombatBlockService`), so blocks declared after the spell resolved are included. Drained in `CombatService.processEndOfCombatCombatOpponentDestructions()`; regeneration and indestructible apply. `RemovalEffect` DESTROY; `targetSpec()` = harmful CREATURE |
| `GrantTrampleToCreaturesBlockedByTargetEffect` | `()` | "Creatures that were blocked by that creature this combat gain trample until end of turn" (Ride Down). The target is a currently blocking creature (`targetSpec()` = benign CREATURE narrowed by `PermanentIsBlockingPredicate`). Resolution snapshots its `blockingTargetIds`, grants trample to each surviving creature, and leaves the ordinary `DestroyTargetPermanentEffect()` to resolve next on the same target group |
| `TapCombatOpponentsOfTargetAtEndOfCombatEffect` | `()` | One-shot delayed tap/untap-lock effect for Triton Tactics. It has a benign creature `targetSpec()` and is bound to the spell's `target(TargetFilters.creature(), 0, 2)` group. Resolution queues a `TapCombatOpponentsAtEndOfCombat` action for each chosen creature; `CombatService.processEndOfCombatCombatOpponentTaps()` reads the directional `GameData.combatOpponentIdsBlockedByThisTurn` map at the next end of combat and taps/deduplicates the attackers that were blocked by those chosen creatures, incrementing their next-untap lock. |
| `PutMinusOneCounterOnSourceAtEndOfCombatEffect` | `()` | schedule the source permanent to get a **-1/-1 counter at end of combat** (delayed, so it stays full size for the combat damage step � unlike the immediate `PutCountersOnSourceEffect(-1,-1,1)`). "Whenever this creature attacks or blocks, put a -1/-1 counter on it at end of combat." Put on ON_ATTACK and/or ON_BLOCK; queues a `PutMinusOneCounterAtEndOfCombat` delayed action drained in `CombatService.processEndOfCombatSourceCounters()` (respects `cantHaveCounters`/`cantHaveMinusOneMinusOneCounters`, fires -1/-1 put-on-creature triggers). See Wicker Warcrawler |
| `PutCounterOnSourceAtEndOfCombatEffect` | `(CounterType counterType, int amount)` / `(CounterType, int, CreateTokenEffect tokenForController)` | generic sibling of the above: schedule the source permanent to get `amount` counters of any `counterType` **at end of combat**, and � when `tokenForController` is non-null � create that token for the source's controller as part of the same delayed action. "At end of combat, if this creature attacked or blocked this combat, put a -0/-1 counter on this creature and create a 0/1 white Deserter creature token." Put on ON_ATTACK and ON_BLOCK (the slots encode the intervening-if). Queues a `PutCounterOnPermanentAtEndOfCombat` for the source, drained in `CombatService.processEndOfCombatOpponentCounters()`; the token is still created when `cantHaveCounters` blocks the counter, since one trigger does both. Nothing happens if the source left the battlefield. See Kjeldoran Home Guard |
| `SacrificeTargetThenRevealUntilTypeToBattlefieldEffect` | `(Set<CardType> cardTypes)` | sacrifice the targeted permanent, then its controller reveals cards from the top of their library until a card matching one of the specified types is found; that card is put onto the battlefield under that player's control, and all other revealed cards are shuffled into their library. Polymorph-style effect (used by Shape Anew for artifact�artifact) |
| `SacrificeTargetPermanentsThenRevealTopCardEffect` | `()` | sacrifice every selected target permanent, then each affected controller reveals the top card of their library and puts it onto the battlefield if it is a permanent card; nonpermanent cards remain on top. Used by Vaevictis Asmadi, the Dire with `target(TargetFilters.permanent(), 0, 99)` and `AT_MOST_ONE_PER_CONTROLLER` |
| `DestroyTargetThenRevealUntilTypeToBattlefieldEffect` | `(boolean cannotBeRegenerated, Set<CardType> cardTypes)` | destroy the targeted permanent (optionally preventing regeneration), then its controller reveals cards from the top of their library until a card matching one of the specified types is found; that card is put onto the battlefield under that player's control, and all other revealed cards are shuffled into their library. Reveal happens regardless of whether destruction succeeds (indestructible). Used by Polymorph (creature�creature with cannotBeRegenerated=true) |
| `ExileAllCreaturesYouControlThenRevealCreaturesToBattlefieldEffect` | `()` | exile all creatures you control, then reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal that many creature cards; put all revealed creature cards onto the battlefield, then shuffle the rest into your library. Mass Polymorph-style effect |
| `SeparatePermanentsIntoPilesAndSacrificeEffect` | `()` | separate all permanents target player controls into two piles; target player sacrifices all permanents in the chosen pile (Liliana of the Veil ultimate). Two-step async flow: controller assigns piles via multi-permanent choice, then target player picks pile to sacrifice via may-ability choice |
| `WhimsOfTheFatesEffect` | `()` | each player separates all permanents they control into three piles, then one pile is chosen uniformly at random for that player and sacrificed. The engine prompts each player for Pile 1 and Pile 2 in controller-first turn order; the unselected permanents form Pile 3, and all randomly selected permanents are sacrificed together |
| `SeparateCreaturesIntoPilesAndDestroyEffect` | `()` | separate all creatures target player controls into two piles; target player chooses a pile and all creatures in it are destroyed without allowing regeneration (Do or Die). Two-step async flow: controller assigns piles via multi-permanent choice, then target player picks the pile to destroy via may-ability choice |

### Sacrifice costs (for activated abilities)

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `ExileSelfCost` | `()` | exile this permanent as cost (e.g. Brittle Effigy). Handled in `ActivatedAbilityExecutionService` via `removePermanentToExile` |
| `SacrificeSelfCost` | `()` or `(boolean trackPower)` | sacrifice this permanent as cost. `trackPower=true` snapshots effective power into the stack entry's xValue at payment (last-known info). Pair with `CounterUnlessPaysEffect(0, true, false)` for "unless pays {X}, where X is this creature's power" (Mausoleum Wanderer) |
| `RemoveAllCountersAsCostEffect` | `(CounterType counterType)` or `(CounterType counterType, boolean fromGrantingEquipment)` | additional cost: remove all counters of the given type from the source. The number removed is snapshotted into the ability's xValue (in `ActivatedAbilityExecutionService`, via `Permanent.getCounterCount`/`setCounterCount`) before the counters are cleared, so a companion effect (e.g. `LookAtTopCardsEffect` with an `XValue()` look count) scales with the count removed. Used by Jar of Eyeballs (`CounterType.EYEBALL`). `fromGrantingEquipment = true` pays from the Equipment that granted the ability instead of the activating permanent — Hankyu's "{T}, Remove all aim counters from Hankyu: This creature deals damage to any target equal to the number of aim counters removed this way" (`RemoveAllCountersAsCostEffect(AIM, true)` + `DealDamageToAnyTargetEffect(new XValue())`). Contrast `RemoveAllCountersEffect`, which is a resolution effect snapshotting into the event value |
| `RemoveAllCountersEffect` | `(CounterType counterType, CounterRemovalSubject subject)`; convenience `(CounterType)` = `SOURCE` | resolution effect (not a cost): remove all counters of the given type from the subject (`SOURCE` = this permanent, non-targeting; `TARGET` = benign `TargetPredicates.creature()`, the card's own target filter narrows further — Hapatra's Mark) and snapshot the removed count as the entry's *event value*, so a later effect on the same entry reads "that much" via `EventValue` � e.g. Ashling the Pilgrim's `ConditionalEffect(NthAbilityResolutionThisTurn(3), RemoveAllCountersEffect(PLUS_ONE_PLUS_ONE))` + `ConditionalEffect(..., MassDamageEffect(new EventValue(), true))`. Contrast `RemoveAllCountersAsCostEffect`, which is paid at activation and snapshots into xValue. `SOURCE` reports `CombatDamageTriggerContextEffect.TriggerContext.SOURCE_SELF` (Ammit Eternal on `ON_COMBAT_DAMAGE_TO_PLAYER`), `TARGET` reports `null` |
| `RemoveCountersToCreateTetraviteTokensEffect` | `(CreateTokenEffect tokenTemplate)` | Tetravus upkeep trigger 1 ("you may remove any number of +1/+1 counters from this creature. If you do, create that many � tokens"). Its handler prompts a 0..N number choice (`ChoiceContext.TetravusCounterRemoval`; 0 = decline, so no `MayEffect` wrapper); the completion in `ChoiceHandlerService` removes that many +1/+1 counters and creates that many tokens from `tokenTemplate`, adding each created id to `GameData.sourceCreatedTokens` (source permanent id � token id set) as "created with" the source. Does nothing if the source has no +1/+1 counters |
| `RemoveAllCountersOfTypeFromAllPermanentsEffect` | `(CounterType counterType)` | remove every counter of that type from every permanent on every battlefield. Corrosion LTB ("remove all rust counters from all permanents") |
| `RemoveAllCountersFromMatchingPermanentsEffect` | `(CounterType counterType, PermanentPredicate predicate)` | remove every counter of that type from every permanent matching `predicate` across all battlefields. Mine Layer LTB uses `PermanentIsLandPredicate` for "remove all mine counters from all lands" |
| `RemoveAllCountersFromAllPermanentsEffect` | `()` | resolution effect that removes every concrete counter from every permanent on every battlefield (Aether Snap) |
| `ExileTetraviteTokensToPutCountersOnSelfEffect` | `()` | Tetravus upkeep trigger 2 ("you may exile any number of tokens created with this creature. If you do, put that many +1/+1 counters on this creature"). Its handler gathers the source's still-alive tracked tokens from `GameData.sourceCreatedTokens` (any controller) and opens a `MultiPermanentChoiceContext.ExileTetraviteTokensPutCountersOnSource` multi-permanent choice; the completion in `MultiPermanentChoiceHandlerService` exiles the chosen tokens and puts that many +1/+1 counters on the source. Does nothing if the source has no surviving tokens |
| `SacrificeCreatureCost` | `()` or `(boolean trackSacrificedManaValue)` or `(boolean trackSacrificedManaValue, boolean trackSacrificedPower)` or `(boolean trackSacrificedManaValue, boolean trackSacrificedPower, boolean trackSacrificedToughness)` or `(boolean trackSacrificedManaValue, boolean trackSacrificedPower, boolean trackSacrificedToughness, boolean excludeSelf)` | sacrifice a creature as cost. When `trackSacrificedManaValue=true`, the sacrificed creature's mana value is stored in the StackEntry's xValue (e.g. Birthing Pod). When `trackSacrificedPower=true`, the sacrificed creature's effective power (including static bonuses) is stored in xValue (e.g. Ichor Explosion). When `trackSacrificedToughness=true`, the sacrificed creature's effective toughness is stored in xValue (e.g. Disciple of Griselbrand). When `excludeSelf=true`, the source permanent cannot be chosen as the sacrifice target � use for "Sacrifice another creature" costs (e.g. Grimgrin, Corpse-Born) |
| `SacrificePermanentOrPayManaCost` | `(String manaCost, PermanentPredicate filter, String description)` | additional cast cost: sacrifice a matching permanent **or** pay `manaCost`. Exactly one option — `PlayCardRequest.sacrificePermanentId` selects sacrifice; null pays the mana on top of the spell's mana cost. Used by Eaten Alive for creatures and Annihilating Glare for artifacts or creatures. Handled by `AdditionalSpellCostService` / `SpellCastingService` |
| `DiscardCardOrPayManaCost` | `(String manaCost)` | additional cast cost: discard a card **or** pay `manaCost` (Lightning Axe: `"{5}"`). Exactly one option � `PlayCardRequest.discardHandCardIndex` selects discard; null pays the mana on top of the spell's mana cost. Satisfiable with another hand card or enough mana for the combined cost. Handled by `AdditionalSpellCostService` / `SpellCastingService` |
| `SacrificePermanentCost` | `(PermanentPredicate filter, String description)` or `(PermanentPredicate filter, String description, boolean excludeSource)` | sacrifice a permanent matching filter as cost. Works for spell costs, activated abilities (via `MultiplePermanentSacrificeCostHandler`), and predicate-backed forced costs. Uses `PredicateEvaluationService.matchesPermanentPredicate()` for validation. Use `PermanentAllOfPredicate(List.of(new PermanentIsCreaturePredicate(), new PermanentHasSubtypePredicate(subtype)))` with `excludeSource=false` for "Sacrifice a [subtype]" creature costs that can sacrifice the source. The 4-arg form adds `trackSacrificedPower` � snapshots the sacrificed permanent's effective power into the ability's xValue at payment (the predicate-based sibling of `SacrificeCreatureCost(false, true)`), read back via `XValue`. Freyalise Supplicant: half that power via `Divided(new XValue(), 2)`. The 5-arg form adds `trackSacrificedManaValue` � snapshots the sacrificed permanent's mana value into xValue instead (Soldevi Adnate: `AwardManaEffect(BLACK, new XValue())`; mana abilities read xValue via `AmountContext.forManaAbility(source, controller, xValue)`) |
| `SacrificeMultiplePermanentsCost` | `(int count, PermanentPredicate filter)` | sacrifice N permanents matching filter as cost (e.g. "Sacrifice three artifacts: ..." with `PermanentIsArtifactPredicate`). Multi-step UI: if exactly N match, auto-sacrifices all; otherwise prompts one-at-a-time. Validated and paid in `AbilityActivationService`. Also valid in the **SPELL slot** as an additional cast cost ("As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice two creatures" � Phyrexian Tribute, `(2, PermanentIsCreaturePredicate)`); the chosen permanents ride on `PlayCardRequest.additionalCostSacrificePermanentIds` and are validated/paid by `AdditionalSpellCostService` + `SpellCastingService` before any mana is spent. Harness: `castSorceryWithSacrifices(player, index, targetId, ids)` |
| `TapAnyNumberOfPermanentsCost` | `(PermanentPredicate filter)` | **SPELL-slot** additional cast cost: "As an additional cost to cast this spell, tap any number of untapped permanents you control matching filter" (Burn at the Stake, `PermanentIsCreaturePredicate`). Any count including **zero** is legal, so it never blocks castability. The number tapped becomes the spell's X value, so a companion effect scales with it (Burn at the Stake pairs it with `DealDamageToAnyTargetEffect(new Scaled(new XValue(), 3))`). Chosen permanents ride on `PlayCardRequest.additionalCostSacrificePermanentIds` (shared with `SacrificeMultiplePermanentsCost` / `ReturnAnyNumberOfPermanentsToHandCost` — no spell carries more than one) and are validated/paid by `AdditionalSpellCostService.validateTapAnyNumberOfPermanentsCost` + `SpellCastingService.payTapAnyNumberOfPermanentsCost` before any mana is spent. Harness: `castSorceryTappingPermanents(player, index, targetId, ids)`. Contrast `TapMultiplePermanentsCost` (activated-ability only) |
| `SacrificeAllCreaturesYouControlCost` | `()` | sacrifice all creatures you control as cost (SPELL slot; Soulblast — total power snapshotted into X) |
| `ReturnAnyNumberOfPermanentsToHandCost` | `(PermanentPredicate filter)` | **SPELL-slot** additional cast cost: "As an additional cost to cast this spell, return X permanents you control matching filter to their owner's hand" (Infernal Harvest, `PermanentHasSubtypePredicate(SWAMP)`). Any count including **zero** is legal. The number returned becomes the spell's X value (Infernal Harvest pairs it with `DealDividedDamageEffect.xAmongTargetCreatures()`). Chosen permanents ride on `PlayCardRequest.additionalCostSacrificePermanentIds`; harness `castSorceryReturningPermanents(player, index, damageAssignments, ids)`. Contrast `ReturnCreatureToHandCost` (exactly one creature) / `ReturnMultiplePermanentsToHandCost` (activated-ability only) |
| `SacrificeAllPermanentsYouControlCost` | `()` | sacrifice all permanents you control as an additional cast cost (SPELL slot; Kaervek's Spite). Legal with zero permanents. Paid by `SpellCastingService`; stripped by `AdditionalSpellCostService` |
| `ReturnMultiplePermanentsToHandCost` | `(int count, PermanentPredicate filter)` | return N permanents matching filter from battlefield to owner's hand as cost (e.g. "Return two lands you control to their owner's hand" with `PermanentIsLandPredicate`). Multi-step UI: if exactly N match, auto-returns all; otherwise prompts one-at-a-time. Validated and paid in `AbilityActivationService`. Works with both battlefield and graveyard activated abilities |
| `ReturnCreatureToHandCost` | `()` | additional cost to cast a **spell**: return a creature you control to its owner's hand (Familiar's Ruse). SPELL slot. The creature is supplied via `PlayCardRequest.sacrificePermanentId` (reuses the sacrifice-cost id field) and paid in `SpellCastingService`; spell is unplayable if you control no creature (`CastingCostService.canPayAdditionalSpellCosts`). This is the spell-cast analogue of `ReturnMultiplePermanentsToHandCost` (which is activated-ability only) |
| `ReturnPermanentToHandCost` | `()` or `(PermanentPredicate filter)` | additional cost to cast a **spell**: return exactly one matching permanent you control to its owner's hand (Disappearing Act; Deprive uses `PermanentIsLandPredicate`). The no-arg form matches any permanent. SPELL slot. The permanent is supplied via `PlayCardRequest.sacrificePermanentId`, validated before mana payment, and returned by `SpellCastingService`; spell is unplayable if you control no matching permanent |
| `PutCounterOnControlledCreatureCost` | `(CounterType counterType, int count)` | put `count` counter(s) of the given type on a creature you control. **Spell cost** (SPELL slot, Scarscale Ritual: `MINUS_ONE_MINUS_ONE, 1`): creature supplied via `PlayCardRequest.sacrificePermanentId` and paid in `SpellCastingService`; spell is unplayable if you control no creature (`CastingCostService.canPayAdditionalSpellCosts`). Also usable as an **activated-ability cost** (Hatchet Bully): dispatched to `PutCounterOnCreatureCostHandler` via the `PermanentChoiceCostHandler` pattern � auto-selects when only one creature qualifies, prompts when multiple. Counter placed directly; creature dies later via state-based actions if toughness reaches 0 |
| `PutCounterOnOpponentCreatureCost` | `(CounterType counterType, int count)` | `ForcedCostOrElseEffect` cost for cumulative upkeep: the payer puts one counter on a creature an opponent controls for each of `count` age-counter payments, choosing separately among eligible opponent creatures; no eligible creature makes the cost unpayable. Used by `CumulativeUpkeepEffect.putCounterOnOpponentCreature(...)` (Sheltering Ancient) |
| `BlightCost` | `()` | blight X as an additional SPELL-slot cast cost: put X -1/-1 counters on a creature you control, where X is the announced value and may be capped by the card's `XValueCap`; creature supplied via `PlayCardRequest.sacrificePermanentId` and paid in `SpellCastingService` |
| `BlightEffect` | `(int count, CardEffect thenEffect)` or `(int count, CardEffect thenEffect, boolean thenEffectTargets)` | resolution-time blight action: choose a creature you control, put `count` -1/-1 counters on it, then put `thenEffect` on the stack; set `thenEffectTargets` for a targeted reflexive follow-up that chooses its target after blighting (Warren Torchmaster). Use `MayEffect(BlightEffect, ...)` for optional blight (Blighted Blackthorn) |
| `DiscardCardTypeCost` | `(CardPredicate predicate, String label)` or `(CardPredicate predicate, String label, boolean manaValueEqualsX)` or full `(predicate, label, manaValueEqualsX, count, sameName, trackManaValue)` | discard a card matching a predicate as cost (null predicate = any card). The `label` is used in UI messages. E.g. `new DiscardCardTypeCost(new CardTypePredicate(CardType.LAND), "land")`, `new DiscardCardTypeCost(new CardIsHistoricPredicate(), "historic")`, `new DiscardCardTypeCost(null, null)` for any card. Set `manaValueEqualsX=true` for "discard a card with mana value X" — the discardable cards are additionally restricted to those whose mana value equals the ability's chosen X (Knollspine Invocation, paired with an `{X}` mana cost). `trackManaValue=true` snapshots the discarded card's mana value into the stack entry's `xValue` at payment (Mercurial Chemister + `DealDamageToTargetCreatureEffect(new XValue())`). Also usable as a **spell cost** (SPELL slot, Seize the Spoils; a count greater than one uses `PlayCardRequest.discardHandCardIndices`), validated before any cost is paid (`AdditionalSpellCostService`), and the spell is unplayable without enough other matching cards in hand (`CastingCostService.canPayAdditionalSpellCosts` / `validDiscardCostIndices` — the spell can never be its own discard). `imprintOnSource=true` (7th component of the full ctor) imprints the discarded card on the source card, so the ability's effects can gate on it with `ConditionalEffect(new ImprintedCardMatches(filter, description, "discarded card"), …)` (Necromancer's Stockpile)  |
| `DiscardLastDrawnCardCost` | `()` | activation-only hand-card cost that permits only the last card the controller drew this turn, if it remains in hand; it reuses the `HandCardCost` discard-choice path (Jandor's Ring) |
| `EscalateDiscardCost` | `()` | Escalate (CR 702.124): discard one card for each mode chosen beyond the first. SPELL slot. Satisfiable with a single mode (zero discards); concrete cast validation requires `modesChosen - 1` indices in `PlayCardRequest.discardHandCardIndices`. Collective Brutality |
| `EscalateManaCost` | `(String manaCost)` | Escalate (CR 702.124): pay `manaCost` for each mode chosen beyond the first. SPELL slot. Folded into the spell's total mana cost so cost reducers apply; free/alternate casts still pay escalate. Borrowed Hostility |
| `EscalateSacrificeCost` | `(int count, PermanentPredicate filter)` | Additional cast cost paid once for each mode chosen beyond the first. Compact: `()` defaults to `(1, ANY)`, `(int count)` defaults to `(count, ANY)`. Reports `count` from `CostEffect.sourceCountersRemoved()`, which the AI weighs as one point of cost per counter |

| `PutCardFromHandOnTopOfLibraryCost` | `()` | activation-only `HandCardCost`: choose one card from hand and put it on top of its controller's library instead of discarding it. Uses the shared hand-card choice flow; no discard triggers fire (Hidden Retreat) |

## Counter spells

`CounterSpellIfManaValueEqualsSourceCountersEffect(CounterType)` is an `ON_ANY_PLAYER_CASTS_SPELL` trigger descriptor and resolved effect: the collector checks the source-counter equality at trigger time, targets the triggering spell, and snapshots its mana value so later counter changes do not undo the trigger. Used by Chalice of the Void.

`RevealTopCardAndCounterTriggeringSpellIfManaValueMatchesEffect()` is an `ON_OPPONENT_CASTS_SPELL` resolved effect for Counterbalance. It reveals the source controller's top library card, leaves it on top, and counters the spell that caused the trigger when the revealed card's mana value matches the spell's current mana value. Wrap the spell-cast trigger in `MayEffect` for Counterbalance's optional reveal.

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `CounterUnlessTakesDamageEffect` | `(int damage)` | counter target spell unless its controller accepts that damage from the countering spell; the target spell remains on the stack while the damage is dealt. Used by Molten Influence |

Enables the non-modal multi-spell-target cast path: `SpellCastingService.multipleSpellTargets` = `!wasModal && !unwrappedNeedsTarget && getMaxTargets() > 1`, validated by `TargetLegalityService.validateMultiSpellTargetsOnStack` (now accepts `getMinTargets()..maxTargets` distinct spells). |

Pair with a `StackEntryPredicateTargetFilter` on the card to narrow which abilities are legal targets |

The one-argument form requires the entering permanent to share the source controller (Naban); pass `false` for effects that apply to permanents entering under any player's control (Yarok). Each copy adds one extra trigger. |
| `AdditionalCreatureDeathTriggerEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate sourcePredicate)` | if a creature dying causes a triggered ability of a matching permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time (static; Drivnod, Carnage Dominus). |
| `CreaturesEnterAsCopyOfSourceEffect` | `()` or `(boolean copyEnchantedCreature, boolean nontokenOnly)` | creatures you control enter as a copy of this creature (static replacement effect, e.g. Essence of the Wild). Handled in BattlefieldEntryService.putPermanentOntoBattlefield(). `copyEnchantedCreature=true` copies the creature the source Aura is attached to instead of the source (no-op while unattached); `nontokenOnly=true` skips entering tokens � `(true, true)` is Infinite Reflection's "Nontoken creatures you control enter as a copy of enchanted creature" |
| `CounterSpellIfManaValueEqualsXEffect` | `()` | `CounterSpellingEffect`; counters the target spell ONLY if its mana value equals the ability's X. X comes from a `DiscardCardTypeCost` with `trackManaValue`, which snapshots the mana value of the card discarded to pay the cost. Benign `SPELL_ON_STACK` spec; a mismatch resolves as a no-op rather than fizzling. Hisoka, Minamo Sensei |

## Bounce / return to hand

| `ReturnSelfToHandAtEndOfCombatEffect` | `()` | creature combat trigger: the source permanent is **returned to its owner's hand** at end of combat. Resolution queues a `DelayedPermanentAction(RETURN_TO_HAND_AT_END_OF_COMBAT)`, drained in `CombatService.processEndOfCombatReturnsToHand()`, which skips the source if it already left the battlefield. Use ON_ATTACK and/or ON_BLOCK. See Quicksilver Behemoth |
| `DelayedEndOfCombatEffect` | `(CardEffect effect)` | schedules the wrapped non-targeting ability to trigger at the beginning of the end-of-combat step. The delayed trigger preserves the source card and controller even if the source permanent leaves the battlefield. Use ON_ATTACK / ON_BLOCK for delayed instructions such as Fickle Efreet's end-of-combat coin flip |

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `ReturnToHandEffect` | **static factories only** (private ctor) | bounce permanents to owners' hands over `BounceScope{TARGET, SELF, ALL_MATCHING, TARGET_PLAYERS_PERMANENTS, TARGET_PLAYERS_OWNED, AURAS_ATTACHED_TO_TARGET, ENCHANTED}`. Factories: `target()` (bounce the chosen target); `targetWithCastTimeXValue(DynamicAmount)` (targeted bounce whose X-scaled target cap is evaluated from game state as the spell is cast — Aether Burst); `targetAndControllerLosesLife(int)` (Vapor Snag — controller, snapshotted before the bounce, loses N); `targetAndControllerDraws(int)` (Call to Heel — controller, snapshotted before the bounce, draws N); `self()` (bounce the source; declares source-self targeting so trigger collectors retain the source id); `allPermanentsMatching(PermanentPredicate filter)` (every permanent matching `filter` across all battlefields, null = every permanent — Evacuation uses `PermanentIsCreaturePredicate`); `permanentsTargetPlayerControls(filter)` (River's Rebuke — the target player's matching permanents; makes the spec player-targeting); `permanentsTargetPlayerOwns(filter)` (Hurkyl's Recall — the target player's owned matching permanents, any controller; makes the spec player-targeting); `aurasAttachedToTarget()` (Scarab of the Unseen); `enchanted()` (bounce the permanent the source Aura is attached to — Sun Clasp; non-targeting; `ActivatedAbilityExecutionService` rebinds it to `enchantedSnapshot(hostId)` at activation so a self-sacrificing Aura still bounces the host via last known information — Phantom Wings) |
| `ReturnTargetPermanentToHandAndReduceControllerSpeedEffect` | `()` | returns the target permanent to its owner's hand, then reduces its controller's speed by one only when that speed is greater than every other player's speed, never below 1. The handler snapshots the controller before the bounce. Used by Spikeshell Harrier. |
| `ReturnTargetPermanentAndAllWithSameNameToHandEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate targetPredicate[, PermanentPredicate sameNamePredicate])` | targeted bounce: returns the target and every other same-name permanent matching `sameNamePredicate` across all battlefields to their owners' hands. The target is the only target; same-name permanents are not target-checked. Used by Echoing Truth |
| `ReturnAllPermanentsOfChosenColorToHandEffect` | `()` / `(PermanentPredicate filter)` | controller chooses a color at resolution, then every permanent matching `filter` with that effective color across all battlefields returns to its owner's hand (`null` filter = every permanent; Dromar, the Banisher uses `PermanentIsCreaturePredicate`). Implements `BoardWipeEffect`; the choice is handled by a dedicated resolution-time color interaction |
| `ReturnAllPermanentsOfColorToHandEffect` | `(CardColor color)` / `(CardColor color, PermanentPredicate filter)` / `(CardColor color, PermanentPredicate filter, boolean opponentsOnly)` | returns every permanent of the fixed effective color matching the optional filter across all battlefields to its owner's hand; `opponentsOnly` excludes the resolving source controller's battlefield. Implements `BoardWipeEffect`; Llawan, Cephalid Empress |
| `ReturnTargetAndAttachedMatchingToHandEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate attachedFilter)` | bounce target creature and all attached permanents matching `attachedFilter` to their owners' hands. | `ReturnTopCreatureCardFromGraveyardToBattlefieldEffect` | `(GraveyardOwner graveyard, boolean assignNoCombatDamageIfReturned)` | put the top creature card of a graveyard onto the battlefield **under the effect controller's control**. `graveyard` = `CONTROLLER` (your own) or `TARGET_PLAYER` (the stack entry's `targetId`; on `ON_ATTACKS_UNBLOCKED` that is the defending player). "Top creature card" = the creature card closest to the top (the most recently put there); noncreature cards sitting above it are skipped, not blockers. Non-targeting, no-op with no creature card in the graveyard. `assignNoCombatDamageIfReturned` adds the stack entry's `sourcePermanentId` to `creaturesPreventedFromDealingCombatDamage` **only when a card was actually returned** — the "if you do" half of Bone Dancer, which a `SequenceEffect` with `AssignNoCombatDamageEffect` would get wrong on an empty graveyard. Mistmoon Griffin uses `(CONTROLLER, false)` as the second step of `SequenceEffect.of(ExileSourceCardFromGraveyardEffect(), it)` on `ON_DEATH` — one trigger, and the Griffin must leave the graveyard first or it would be its own top creature card; Bone Dancer uses `MayEffect(new …(TARGET_PLAYER, true))` on `ON_ATTACKS_UNBLOCKED` |
| `ReturnMatchingPermanentsUnlessOwnerPaysEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate filter, String manaCost)` | `BoardWipeEffect` (`sweepsBoard()` always true); punisher mass bounce — every permanent matching `filter` across ALL battlefields returns to its owner's hand unless that permanent's OWNER pays `manaCost`. The payer is the owner, NOT the controller — "return it to its owner's hand unless that player pays" names the owner and then refers back to them, so the player who may pay is always the one whose hand would receive the permanent (they differ only once it has changed hands). The handler resolves the owner with the engine's battlefield convention `stolenCreatures.getOrDefault(id, controllerId)`, matching `PermanentRemovalService.removePermanentToHand`. Each matching permanent is an independent decision made by its own owner, offered one at a time through the may-ability system in APNAP order BY OWNER (CR 101.4); declining, or accepting without the mana, bounces it and moves on. Cut the Tethers = `(PermanentHasSubtypePredicate(SPIRIT), "{3}")` |

## Graveyard return

- `ReturnTargetCardsFromGraveyardToBattlefieldEffect(CardPredicate, int, CounterType, int)` — fixed-cap targeted reanimation with a counter rider applied to each permanent that enters.

Second Sunrise uses `EachPlayerReturnsCardsFromGraveyardToBattlefieldEffect(Integer.MAX_VALUE, filter, true)` with a `CardAnyOfPredicate` for artifact, creature, enchantment, and land cards, so each player returns only those qualifying cards put into their graveyard from the battlefield this turn.

### Unified effect: `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect`

All graveyard-to-hand and graveyard-to-battlefield return effects are handled by a single unified record.

**Builder pattern:**
```
ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder()
    .destination(GraveyardChoiceDestination)   // HAND, BATTLEFIELD, or TOP_OF_OWNERS_LIBRARY (required)
    .filter(CardPredicate)                     // which cards qualify (default: null = any)
    .sourceChosenSubtype(boolean)               // true = match cards of the source permanent's chosen subtype (default: false)
    .source(GraveyardSearchScope)              // default: CONTROLLERS_GRAVEYARD � omit unless ALL_GRAVEYARDS or OPPONENT_GRAVEYARD
    .targetGraveyard(boolean)                  // true = player chooses whose graveyard to search at cast time (default: false)
    .returnAll(boolean)                        // true = return all matching cards, false = choose one (default: false)
    .thisTurnOnly(boolean)                     // true = only CREATURE cards put there from battlefield this turn (default: false)
    .fromBattlefieldThisTurn(boolean)          // true = ALL cards (any type) put there from battlefield this turn (default: false; Twilight Shepherd, Faith's Reward)
    .fromAnywhereThisTurn(boolean)             // true = only cards put there from any zone this turn (default: false)
    .discardedOrCycledThisTurn(boolean)        // true = only cards the controller cycled or discarded this turn (default: false; Shadow of the Grave)
    .discardedByOpponentThisTurn(boolean)      // true = only cards discarded because of an opponent's spell or ability (default: false; Pure Intentions)
    .targetPutIntoGraveyardFromBattlefieldThisTurn(boolean) // true = the TARGETED graveyard card must have come from the battlefield this turn
                                               //   card put into that graveyard from the battlefield this turn
                                               //   (default: false; Grim Return). Pairs with targetGraveyard(true);
                                               //   reads creatureCardsPutIntoGraveyardFromBattlefieldThisTurn
    .targetNotPutIntoGraveyardThisCombat(boolean) // true = the TARGETED graveyard card must not have been put
                                                  //   into a graveyard during the current combat phase
                                                  //   (default: false; Storrev, Devkarin Lich)
    .attachmentTarget(PermanentPredicate)      // non-null = aura attaches to matching permanent on ETB (default: null)
    .gainLifeEqualToManaValue(boolean)         // true = controller gains life equal to returned card's mana value (default: false)
    .loseLifeEqualToManaValue(boolean)         // true = controller loses life equal to returned card's mana value (default: false);
                                               //   pre-targeted path only (Reanimate); life loss via LifeSupport, so triggers fire
    .attachToSource(boolean)                   // true = attach the returned card to the source permanent (default: false).
                                               //   search-and-choose path: optional "you may attach" prompt after ETB (Auriok Survivors)
                                               //   pre-targeted BATTLEFIELD path: mandatory, prompt-free � the Aura enters already
                                               //   attached; fizzles if the source is gone or the Aura can't enchant it (Hakim, Loreweaver)
    .grantHaste(boolean)                       // true = grant haste to the returned permanent (default: false)
    .grantKeywords(Set<Keyword>)                // non-empty = grant these keywords indefinitely to the returned permanent
    .sacrificeAtEndStep(boolean)               // true = sacrifice the returned permanent at the next end step
    .exileAtEndStep(boolean)                   // true = exile at the next end step (default: false). Unearth's extra
    .exileAtYourNextEndStep(boolean)            // true = exile at the returned permanent controller's next end step
                                               //   "exile it instead if it would leave the battlefield" clause is the
                                               //   separate .exileIfLeavesBattlefield(true) � pair the two for Unearth /
                                               //   Postmortem Lunge; Shallow Grave uses exileAtEndStep alone
    .topmost(boolean)                          // true = return the topmost matching card of the controller's ordered
                                               //   graveyard with no prompt at all (default: false); Shallow Grave
    .requiresManaValueEqualsX(boolean)         // true = restrict to cards with MV = X (default: false)
    .manaValueXOffset(int)                     // offset added to X for the exact-MV restriction (default: 0)
    .requiresManaValueAtMostX(boolean)         // true = restrict to cards with MV ? X (default: false); e.g. Profane Command
    .dynamicMaxManaValue(DynamicAmount)        // death-trigger limit evaluated when the trigger is collected; e.g. soulshift X
    .maxManaValueEqualsLifeGainedThisTurn(boolean) // true = restrict to cards with MV <= life gained this turn (default: false); e.g. Moseo
    .grantColor(CardColor)                     // non-null = permanently grant this color "in addition to" (default: null)
    .grantSubtype(CardSubtype)                 // non-null = permanently grant this subtype "in addition to" (default: null)
    .enterWithCounters(Set<CounterType>)       // one counter of each listed type is placed on the returned permanent as it enters
    .enterTapped(boolean)                      // true = enters the battlefield tapped (default: false)
    .underOwnersControl(boolean)               // true = put each card onto battlefield under its owner's control (default: false)
    .returnAtRandom(boolean)                   // true = return a random matching card instead of player choice (default: false)
    .battlefieldIfCreatureElseHand(boolean)    // true = route each returned card by type — creature cards to the battlefield,
                                               //   everything else to hand (default: false); returnAtRandom path only, overrides
                                               //   destination (Deadbridge Chant)
    .battlefieldIfCreatureElseExile(boolean)   // true = route each randomly selected card by type — creature cards to the
                                               //   battlefield, everything else to exile (default: false); returnAtRandom path only
    .shuffleGraveyardBeforeRandomSelection(boolean) // true = randomly reorder the controller's graveyard before the random selection
                                               //   (default: false); returnAtRandom path only (Search for Survivors)
    .choosePermanentType(boolean)              // true = prompt controller to choose a permanent type at resolution, then return all matching (default: false); implies returnAll
    .exileSourceFromGraveyard(boolean)         // true = exile the source card from graveyard before selecting random cards (default: false); e.g. Moldgraf Monstrosity
    .grantSourceHasteIfSubtype(CardSubtype)    // non-null = source permanent gains haste until end of turn if the returned card has this subtype (default: null); HAND search-and-choose only; e.g. Warren Pilferers (Goblin)
    .greatestPower(boolean)                    // true = restrict the (mandatory) controller's-graveyard search-and-choose to the matching card(s) with greatest power; single card auto-forced, ties chosen and cannot be declined (default: false); e.g. Desecrator Hag
    .exileIfLeavesBattlefield(boolean)         // true = set exile-if-leaves replacement on the returned permanent (default: false); Dreams of the Dead, Unearth
    .exileIfDying(boolean)                      // true = set "if this creature would die, exile it instead" on the returned permanent (default: false); Can't Stay Away
    .grantCumulativeUpkeepCost(String)         // non-null = grant that Cumulative upkeep cost as a persistent UPKEEP_TRIGGERED ability (default: null); Dreams of the Dead "{2}"
    .plusOneCountersIfExiledCostCardHasSubtype(CardSubtype) // condition keyed to the exiled additional-cost card snapshot
    .counterIfExiledCostCardHasSubtype(CounterType) // counter type placed when that subtype condition matches
    .counterCountIfExiledCostCardHasSubtype(int) // number of those counters to place
    .plusOneCountersIfCardType(CardType)       // non-null = only add the plusOneCounterCount counters when the returned permanent currently has this card type
    .linkToSource(boolean)                     // true = bond the reanimated permanent to the source permanent's chosenPermanentId (default: false); pre-targeted BATTLEFIELD path only; pair with RemoveLinkedPermanentEffect triggers; Coffin Queen
    .build()
```

Only `destination` is required. All booleans default to `false`, all object references default to `null`, and `source` defaults to `CONTROLLERS_GRAVEYARD`. Only set fields that differ from defaults.

Use `manaValueXOffset` with `requiresManaValueEqualsX(true)` when the exact mana value is derived from X, such as a target with mana value X plus one after a sacrificed creature's mana value is tracked.

On the pre-targeted `BATTLEFIELD` path, a card reanimated out of a **different player's** graveyard is registered in `GameData.stolenCreatures` automatically (with the matching PERMANENT control effect), so it dies to its owner's graveyard rather than the reanimator's — no card-side flag needed.

**CardPredicate filter system** (in `model/filter/`):

| Predicate | Constructor | Matches |
|-----------|-------------|---------|
| `CardTypePredicate` | `(CardType cardType)` | cards of a given type (CREATURE, ARTIFACT, etc.) |
| `CardSubtypePredicate` | `(CardSubtype subtype)` | cards of a given subtype (ZOMBIE, GOBLIN, etc.) |
| `CardKeywordPredicate` | `(Keyword keyword)` | cards with a given keyword (INFECT, FLYING, etc.) |
| `CardIsSelfPredicate` | `()` | only the source card itself (Squee-style self-return) |
| `CardIsAuraPredicate` | `()` | aura cards |
| `CardIsAuraEnchantCreaturePredicate` | `()` | Aura cards with enchant creature (read from the Aura's spell target filter) |
| `CardIsPermanentPredicate` | `()` | permanent cards (creature, artifact, enchantment, planeswalker, land, kindred � not instant/sorcery) |
| `CardMaxManaValuePredicate` | `(int maxManaValue)` | cards with mana value ? maxManaValue |
| `CardMinManaValuePredicate` | `(int minManaValue)` | cards with mana value ?A minManaValue |
| `CardSupertypePredicate` | `(CardSupertype supertype)` | cards with a given supertype (BASIC, LEGENDARY) |
| `CardColorPredicate` | `(CardColor color)` | cards that ARE the colour � the colour is present among `getColors()` (multicolour-aware per CR 105.2c; a Black-Green card matches both `CardColorPredicate(BLACK)` and `CardColorPredicate(GREEN)`, order-independent). Used by "whenever a {colour} spell is cast" triggers and colour-filtered searches (Green Sun's Zenith) |
| `CardNotPredicate` | `(CardPredicate predicate)` | NOT � inverts a predicate |
| `CardAllOfPredicate` | `(List<CardPredicate> predicates)` | AND � all predicates must match |
| `CardAnyOfPredicate` | `(List<CardPredicate> predicates)` | OR � any predicate matches |

Pass `null` as filter to allow any card.

**GraveyardSearchScope enum** (in `model/`):

| Value | Meaning |
|-------|---------|
| `CONTROLLERS_GRAVEYARD` | search only the controller's graveyard (default) |
| `ALL_GRAVEYARDS` | search any player's graveyard |
| `OPPONENT_GRAVEYARD` | search only opponent's graveyard |

**GraveyardChoiceDestination enum** (in `model/`):

| Value | Meaning |
|-------|---------|
| `HAND` | return chosen card(s) to hand |
| `BATTLEFIELD` | put chosen card(s) onto battlefield |
| `TOP_OF_OWNERS_LIBRARY` | put card on top of its owner's library (e.g. Noxious Revival) |
| `BOTTOM_OF_OWNERS_LIBRARY` | put card on the bottom of its owner's library (e.g. Mistveil Plains) |

**Migration from old effects:**

| Old effect | New equivalent |
|------------|----------------|
| `ReturnCardFromGraveyardToHandEffect()` | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).targetGraveyard(true).build()` |
| `ReturnCardFromGraveyardToHandEffect(CardType.CREATURE)` | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).filter(new CardTypePredicate(CREATURE)).build()` |
| `ReturnCardOfSubtypeFromGraveyardToHandEffect(subtype)` | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).filter(new CardSubtypePredicate(subtype)).build()` |
| `ReturnCardWithKeywordFromGraveyardToHandEffect(type, kw)` | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).filter(new CardAllOfPredicate(List.of(new CardTypePredicate(type), new CardKeywordPredicate(kw)))).build()` |
| `ReturnSelfFromGraveyardToHandEffect()` | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).filter(new CardIsSelfPredicate()).returnAll(true).build()` |
| `ReturnCreatureFromGraveyardToBattlefieldEffect()` | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(new CardTypePredicate(CREATURE)).build()` |
| `ReturnArtifactOrCreatureFromAnyGraveyardToBattlefieldEffect()` | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(new CardAnyOfPredicate(List.of(new CardTypePredicate(ARTIFACT), new CardTypePredicate(CREATURE)))).source(ALL_GRAVEYARDS).build()` |
| `TargetOpponentChoosesCardFromGraveyardEffect(CardPredicate)` | target opponent chooses a matching card in their graveyard; put it onto the battlefield under the controller's control |
| `ReturnAuraFromGraveyardToBattlefieldEffect()` | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(new CardIsAuraPredicate()).attachmentTarget(attachmentTarget).build()` |
| `ReturnCreatureCardsPutIntoYourGraveyardFromBattlefieldThisTurnToHandEffect()` | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).filter(new CardTypePredicate(CREATURE)).returnAll(true).thisTurnOnly(true).build()` |
| `ReturnCreatureCardsPutIntoYourGraveyardFromAnywhereThisTurnToHandEffect()` | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).filter(new CardTypePredicate(CREATURE)).returnAll(true).fromAnywhereThisTurn(true).build()` |

| Card | Usage |
|------|-------|
| Recollect | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).targetGraveyard(true).build()` � any card, targets graveyard |
| Crawl from the Cellar | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).filter(CREATURE).targetGraveyard(true).build()` (mandatory GY) + `target(Zombie you control, 0, 1).addEffect(PutCounterOnTargetPermanentEffect(+1/+1))` + `FlashbackCast` � use `.upTo(true)` only when the GY target itself is "up to one" (Yawgmoth) |
| Gravedigger | `MayEffect(ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).filter(new CardTypePredicate(CREATURE)).build())` � creature to hand |
| Corpse Cur | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).filter(new CardAllOfPredicate(List.of(new CardTypePredicate(CREATURE), new CardKeywordPredicate(INFECT)))).build()` � creature with infect |
| Lord of the Undead | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).filter(new CardSubtypePredicate(ZOMBIE)).build()` � Zombie subtype |
| Doomed Necromancer | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(new CardTypePredicate(CREATURE)).build()` � creature to battlefield |
| Beacon of Unrest | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(new CardAnyOfPredicate(...)).source(ALL_GRAVEYARDS).build()` � artifact or creature from any graveyard |
| Nomad Mythmaker | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(new CardIsAuraPredicate()).attachmentTarget(new PermanentIsCreaturePredicate()).build()` � aura to battlefield attached to creature |
| Hakim, Loreweaver | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(new CardIsAuraPredicate()).targetGraveyard(true).attachToSource(true).build()` � targeted Aura from your graveyard, enters attached to the source (no host choice) |
| Auriok Survivors | `MayEffect(ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(new CardSubtypePredicate(EQUIPMENT)).attachToSource(true).build())` � equipment to battlefield attached to source |
| Squee, Goblin Nabob | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).filter(new CardIsSelfPredicate()).returnAll(true).build()` � self-return |
| No Rest for the Wicked | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).filter(new CardTypePredicate(CREATURE)).returnAll(true).thisTurnOnly(true).build()` � all creatures that died this turn |
| Twilight Shepherd | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).returnAll(true).fromBattlefieldThisTurn(true).build()` � ETB: all cards (any type) put into your graveyard from the battlefield this turn |
| Faith's Reward | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(new CardIsPermanentPredicate()).returnAll(true).fromBattlefieldThisTurn(true).build()` � all permanent cards put into your graveyard from the battlefield this turn go back to the battlefield. The `returnAll` + this-turn path honours `destination(BATTLEFIELD)` (plus `enterTapped`/`grantColor`/`grantSubtype` and the battlefield riders); it is prompt-free |
| Garna, the Bloodflame | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).filter(new CardTypePredicate(CREATURE)).returnAll(true).fromAnywhereThisTurn(true).build()` � all creature cards put into graveyard from anywhere this turn |
| Shadow of the Grave | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).returnAll(true).discardedOrCycledThisTurn(true).build()` � return all cards in your graveyard that you cycled or discarded this turn (cycling is a discard; tracked in the central discard hook `TriggerCollectionService.checkDiscardTriggers` via `GameData.cardsDiscardedOrCycledThisTurn`) |
| Reanimate | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).source(ALL_GRAVEYARDS).filter(new CardTypePredicate(CREATURE)).targetGraveyard(true).loseLifeEqualToManaValue(true).build()` — targeted reanimation from any graveyard + controller loses life equal to that card's mana value |
| Razor Hippogriff | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).filter(new CardTypePredicate(ARTIFACT)).gainLifeEqualToManaValue(true).build()` � artifact to hand + gain life equal to mana value |
| Noxious Revival | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(TOP_OF_OWNERS_LIBRARY).source(ALL_GRAVEYARDS).targetGraveyard(true).build()` � any card from any graveyard on top of owner's library |
| Postmortem Lunge | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(new CardTypePredicate(CREATURE)).targetGraveyard(true).grantHaste(true).exileAtEndStep(true).exileIfLeavesBattlefield(true).requiresManaValueEqualsX(true).build()` � X-cost creature with MV=X from your graveyard to battlefield with haste; exile at next end step |
| Profane Command (reanimate mode) | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(CREATURE).targetGraveyard(true).requiresManaValueAtMostX(true).build()` � creature with MV ? X from your graveyard to battlefield; pair inside a choose-two modal with `{X}` |
| Shallow Grave | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(new CardTypePredicate(CREATURE)).topmost(true).grantHaste(true).exileAtEndStep(true).build()` � "return the top creature card of your graveyard to the battlefield, it gains haste, exile it at the beginning of the next end step". Non-targeting and prompt-free: `topmost` walks the ordered graveyard from the top and returns the first matching card via the pre-targeted path (`GraveyardReturnSupport.resolveTopmostFromControllersGraveyard`), so all battlefield riders apply. No `exileIfLeavesBattlefield` � a creature that dies before the end step just goes to the graveyard |
| Moseo, Vein's New Dean | `new ConditionalEffect(new GainedLifeThisTurn(), ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(new CardTypePredicate(CREATURE)).targetGraveyard(true).maxManaValueEqualsLifeGainedThisTurn(true).build())` in `CONTROLLER_END_STEP_TRIGGERED` � end-step "if you gained life this turn, return up to one target creature card with MV X or less, X = life gained this turn". End-step graveyard targeting reuses the `SpellGraveyardTargetTrigger` flow |
| Rise from the Grave | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(new CardTypePredicate(CREATURE)).source(ALL_GRAVEYARDS).grantColor(CardColor.BLACK).grantSubtype(CardSubtype.ZOMBIE).build()` � creature from any graveyard to battlefield as a black Zombie in addition to other colors/types |
| Reassembling Skeleton | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(new CardIsSelfPredicate()).returnAll(true).enterTapped(true).build()` � self-return to battlefield tapped (graveyard activated ability) |
| Warcry Phoenix | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(new CardIsSelfPredicate()).returnAll(true).enterTapped(true).enterAttacking(true).build()` � self-return to battlefield tapped and attacking (graveyard attack trigger) |
| Fatestitcher (Unearth) | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(new CardIsSelfPredicate()).returnAll(true).grantHaste(true).exileAtEndStep(true).exileIfLeavesBattlefield(true).build()` � Unearth self-return with haste, exiled at next end step or if it would leave the battlefield (graveyard activated ability with `SORCERY_SPEED` timing). Built by `Card.addUnearth(cost)`. `grantHaste`/`exileAtEndStep`/`exileIfLeavesBattlefield` are honored on the `returnAll` self-return path as well as the targeted path; the two exile flags are independent (Shallow Grave sets only `exileAtEndStep`) |
| Open the Vaults | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(new CardAnyOfPredicate(List.of(new CardTypePredicate(ARTIFACT), new CardTypePredicate(ENCHANTMENT)))).source(ALL_GRAVEYARDS).returnAll(true).underOwnersControl(true).build()` � return all artifacts and enchantments from all graveyards under their owners' control |
| Charmbreaker Devils | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).filter(new CardAnyOfPredicate(List.of(new CardTypePredicate(INSTANT), new CardTypePredicate(SORCERY)))).returnAtRandom(true).build()` � return a random instant or sorcery from your graveyard to hand |
| Deadbridge Chant | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).returnAtRandom(true).battlefieldIfCreatureElseHand(true).build()` — "choose a card at random in your graveyard. If it's a creature card, put it onto the battlefield. Otherwise, put it into your hand" (`UPKEEP_TRIGGERED`; pair with `MillEffect(10, CONTROLLER)` on `ON_ENTER_BATTLEFIELD`) |
| Make a Wish | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).returnAtRandom(true).randomCount(2).build()` � return two cards at random from your graveyard to hand |
| Creeping Renaissance | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).returnAll(true).choosePermanentType(true).build()` � choose a permanent type, return all cards of that type from your graveyard to hand |
| Moldgraf Monstrosity | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(new CardTypePredicate(CREATURE)).returnAtRandom(true).randomCount(2).exileSourceFromGraveyard(true).build()` � on death, exile self from graveyard then return two random creature cards to battlefield |
| Warren Pilferers | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).filter(new CardTypePredicate(CREATURE)).grantSourceHasteIfSubtype(CardSubtype.GOBLIN).build()` in `ON_ENTER_BATTLEFIELD` � return a creature card from your graveyard; if it's a Goblin card, this creature gains haste until end of turn |
| Dawn-Blessed Pennant | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).sourceChosenSubtype(true).targetGraveyard(true).build()` � return target card of the source permanent's chosen subtype from your graveyard to your hand |
| Vengeful Rebirth | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).targetGraveyard(true).build()` + `RecordReturnedGraveyardCardValueEffect(NONLAND_MANA_VALUE)` + `target(AnyTargetPredicateTargetFilter(...)).addEffect(new DealDamageToAnyTargetEffect(new EventValue(), false, false, 0))` + `ExileSpellEffect()` � return target graveyard card to hand, then deal its mana value as damage to any target if it was a returned nonland, then exile the spell. See `RecordReturnedGraveyardCardValueEffect` below |
| Morgue Burst | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).filter(new CardTypePredicate(CREATURE)).targetGraveyard(true).build()` + `RecordReturnedGraveyardCardValueEffect(POWER)` + `target(AnyTargetPredicateTargetFilter(...)).addEffect(new DealDamageToAnyTargetEffect(new EventValue(), false, false, 0))` - same two-target shape, damage equal to the returned creature card's power |
| `AnimateReturnedPermanentIfSubtypeEffect` | `(CardSubtype subtype, AnimatePermanentsEffect animation)` | unbound rider after a targeted `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect`; finds the returned permanent by its card ID, checks the current subtype, and applies the supplied animation. Used by Tune Up to permanently animate a returned Vehicle |

| Kheru Lich Lord | `MayPayManaEffect("{2}{B}", ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(CREATURE).returnAtRandom(true).grantKeywords(Set.of(FLYING, TRAMPLE, HASTE)).exileAtEndStep(true).exileIfLeavesBattlefield(true).build(), ...)` — upkeep payment returns a random creature with indefinite keyword grants and both exile riders |

### `RecordReturnedGraveyardCardValueEffect`

Graveyard-return glue effect (`TargetSpec.NONE`), parameterized by `ReturnedGraveyardCardValue`: `NONLAND_MANA_VALUE` (Vengeful Rebirth) or `POWER` (Morgue Burst). Sets the entry's event value to that characteristic of the card on `entry.targetId` (a graveyard target, Yawgmoth's-Vile-Offering two-target shape: graveyard card on `targetId`/targetZone GRAVEYARD, any target on a `target(...)` group) **only when that nonland card was actually returned to the controller's hand** � the handler confirms the card is now in hand rather than reading its type in place, so a graveyard target that became illegal (exiled/removed in response, CR 608.2b) records 0 and deals no damage. A returned land also records 0.

Add it **UNBOUND**, right after the `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect`. `EffectResolutionService` remaps `entry.targetId` to a bound effect's target group for the duration of that effect (so `DestroyTargetPermanentEffect`-style bound effects read the group via `targetId`); leaving this effect unbound keeps `targetId` pointing at the graveyard card while it runs. Pair with a **bound** `DealDamageToAnyTargetEffect(new EventValue(), false, false, 0)` on the any-target group � binding is what makes the position accept player targets (`Card.doesPositionAllowPlayerTargets`) and lets the AI classify it as harmful damage. `0` event value = no damage (`dealDamageToPlayer` no-ops on `<= 0`).

### `RecordReturnedGraveyardCardMatchEffect`

Graveyard-return glue effect (`TargetSpec.NONE`) that records `1` when the card on `entry.targetId` was actually returned to the controller's hand and matches its `CardPredicate`, otherwise `0`. Add it **UNBOUND** immediately after `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect`; the event value can feed `DrawCardEffect(new EventValue())` for a conditional draw rider such as Cemetery Recruitment.

### Other graveyard effects

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `ReturnOneOfEachSubtypeFromGraveyardToHandEffect` | `(List<CardSubtype> subtypes)` | return one card of each listed subtype from controller's graveyard to hand, processed sequentially. Single matches auto-return; multiple matches prompt choice. A multi-typed card can only satisfy one subtype. Used by Grim Captain's Call |
| `ReturnUpToOneCardOfEachManaValueFromGraveyardToHandEffect` | `()` | return any number of cards with different mana values from controller's graveyard to hand. Choices are sequential, optional, and later choices exclude mana values already selected. Used by Seasons Past |
| `ReturnOneCreatureOfEachManaValueFromGraveyardToBattlefieldEffect` | `(List<Integer> manaValues)` | return one creature card for each listed mana value from controller's graveyard to the battlefield, processed sequentially. Missing values are skipped; single matches auto-return and multiple matches use mandatory sequential choices. Used by Gruesome Menagerie |

Because the exile snapshot is taken first, creatures sacrificed by step two stay in their graveyards. ## Draw / discard / hand manipulation

`RevealAnyNumberOfCardsFromHandEffect(CardPredicate filter)` makes the controller choose any
number of matching cards from their hand to reveal publicly. The selected count is stored on the
resolving stack entry for a following `EventValue`-based effect; Brine Seer chains it into
`CounterUnlessPaysEffect(new EventValue())`.

`RevealCardFromHandThenPutOntoBattlefieldIfSharesNameWithPermanentEffect()` makes the controller
reveal one chosen card from hand. If it shares a name with any permanent on any battlefield, the
card is put onto the battlefield; otherwise it remains in hand. Retraced Image uses the mandatory
`PendingInteraction.RetracedImageCardChoice`.

`PutControllerCardFromHandOnTopOfLibraryEffect()` is the non-targeting controller-scoped form of
the hand-to-library-top choice. It requires the controller to choose one card when their hand is
nonempty, and an empty hand resolves without a prompt. `GrantNoMaximumHandSizeEffect(UNTIL_NEXT_TURN)` grants a temporary
controller-scoped hand-size exemption that is removed when that player's next turn begins.

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `DrawCardUnlessTargetSacrificesCreatureOrPaysLifeEffect` | `(int lifeCost)` | targets an opponent; that opponent chooses to sacrifice a creature, pay `lifeCost` life, or let the effect's controller draw a card. The sacrifice and payment options are pruned when unavailable; a sole draw option resolves without a prompt. Uses `ChoiceContext.IndulgentTormentorChoice`, `PermanentChoiceContext.TormentSacrifice`, and dedicated `GameData.indulgentTormentor` progress state. Indulgent Tormentor (M15) |
| `DrawCardEffect` | `(DynamicAmount amount, boolean onlyIfSacrificed)` | controller draws that many cards, one at a time (draw-replacement effects and "whenever you draw" triggers see each draw). Convenience ctors: `(int amount)`, `()` = 1, `sacrificeOnly(int amount)` for "when you sacrifice this, draw …" death triggers. Covers "draw X cards" (`XValue`), "draw a card for each creature you control" (`PermanentCount`), "for each creature card in your graveyard" (`CardsInGraveyard`), "for each charge counter on [source]" (`CountersOnSource` � evaluates the live source, falling back to `sourcePermanentSnapshot` when sacrificed as a cost, e.g. Culling Dais). Advertises a benign PLAYER `targetSpec()` when the amount is target-relative � `CardsDiscardedByTargetPlayerThisTurn` (Dream Salvage) or a `PermanentCount` with `CountScope.TARGET_PLAYER` ("draw a card for each tapped creature target player controls": Theft of Dreams, Tamiyo, the Moon Sage's -2) � so a loyalty ability needs no card-level player filter |
