## Library manipulation

| `RevealTopCardMayPutMatchingOntoBattlefieldEffect` | `(CardPredicate predicate)` | publicly reveal the relevant player's top card; if it matches `predicate`, that player **may** put it onto the battlefield (else, or on decline, it stays on top). `EACH_UPKEEP_TRIGGERED` uses the active player from the trigger entry, so Gate to the Aether acts on each player's own library. Normalfx handler queues a `PendingMayAbility`; the mayfx handler reuses `MayMiscHandlerService.handleLookAtTopCardPutLandOrCreatureChoice` |
| `RevealTopCardMayPutMatchingOntoBattlefieldWithCounterAndTypeEffect` | `(CardPredicate, CounterType, CardType)` | publicly reveal the relevant player's top card; if it matches, that player may put it onto the battlefield with the specified counter and an additional persistent card type. Arbiter of the Ideal |
| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `SearchLibraryForCardsWithTargetCreatureNameEffect` | `(int count)` | target creature; search the controller's library for up to `count` cards with the target creature's name, reveal them, put them into hand, then shuffle. The normal handler resolves the target's current name and delegates the actual interaction and shuffle to `SearchLibraryEffect`. Used by Pack Hunt |
| `SearchLibraryForCardWithSameNameAsAnotherCreatureYouControlEffect` | `()` | choose another creature controlled by the resolving controller during resolution, then search their library for one card with that creature's exact name, reveal it, put it into hand, and shuffle. Non-targeted; multiple candidates use `PermanentChoiceContext.PatternMatcherCreatureChoice`, while one candidate delegates directly to `SearchLibraryEffect`. Used by Pattern Matcher |
| `SearchLibraryForCardWithSameNameAsCreatureInHandEffect` | `()` | choose and reveal a creature card from the controller's hand during resolution, then search their library for one card with that card's exact name, reveal it, put it into hand, and shuffle. The revealed creature remains in hand. Used by Assembly Hall |
| `SacrificeCreatureSearchLibraryForCreatureToHandEffect` | `()` | sacrifice a creature (as effect, not cost); if you do, search library for a creature card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. With 0 creatures nothing happens; with 1 auto-sacrifices; with 2+ prompts choice via `SacrificeCreatureThenSearchLibrary` context. Used by Garruk, the Veil-Cursed |
| `TargetPlayerSacrificesCreatureThenCreateTokensIfSubtypeEffect` | `(CardSubtype requiredSubtype, CreateTokenEffect tokenTemplate)` | targets a player (player-targeting spec); that player sacrifices a creature of their choice and, if it had `requiredSubtype` (last-known info, evaluated before removal so type-adding effects/changeling count), the same player creates the `tokenTemplate` tokens under their own control. With 0 target-player creatures nothing happens; with 1 auto-sacrifices; with 2+ prompts choice via `SacrificeCreatureCreateTokensIfSubtype` context. Encode "gains haste until end of turn" via the template's `grantedKeywordsUntilEndOfTurn`. Used by Warren Weirding |
| `TargetPlayerSacrificesRandomPermanentsUntilLandEffect` | `()` | the stack entry's `targetId` player sacrifices a uniformly-random permanent they control; if it was a nonland permanent, repeat. Ends on the first land sacrificed or when they control no permanents. The engine makes the random choice, so the whole loop resolves synchronously (no player input). Used by Tyrant of Discord (ETB, `PlayerPredicateTargetFilter(OPPONENT)`) |
| `SearchLibraryEffect` | `(DynamicAmount count, CardPredicate filter, LibrarySearchDestination destination, ManaValueBound manaValueBound, int castFromGraveyardCount, boolean requireDifferentNames[, LibrarySearchPlayer searchPlayer])`; convenience `()`, `(filter)`, `(filter, destination)`, `(count, filter, destination)`, `(count, filter, destination, searchPlayer)`, `(filter, int count, int castFromGraveyardCount)`, `(filter, destination, manaValueBound)`, `(count, filter, destination, bound, requireDifferentNames)`, `(filter, destination, grantHaste, exileAtEndStep)` | unified library search (collapsed the whole `SearchLibraryFor*` family). Find `count` cards matching `filter` (+ optional `ManaValueBound` mana-value constraint) and move them to `destination` (`HAND`/`BATTLEFIELD`/`BATTLEFIELD_TAPPED`/`TOP_OF_LIBRARY`), then shuffle. `filter == null` ? unrestricted (any card; not revealed, can't fail to find � Diabolic Tutor); non-null filter or a bound ? restricted (reveals for `HAND`/`TOP_OF_LIBRARY`, may fail to find; prompt/no-match text via `CardPredicateUtils.describeFilter()`). Flashback casts (`StackEntry.isCastWithFlashback()`) search `castFromGraveyardCount`. `requireDifferentNames=true` (Uncage the Menagerie) excludes already-chosen names on subsequent picks; `count <= 0` still searches and shuffles. By-name search = `CardNamedPredicate` (Squadron Hawk). To-top = `TOP_OF_LIBRARY` (Liliana Vess, Brutalizer Exarch). Creature-to-battlefield with MV/colour/subtype via filter + `ManaValueBound` (Citanul Flute `(false,0)`, Birthing Pod `(true,1)`, Green Sun's Zenith `CardColorPredicate(GREEN)`, Myr Turbine subtype). `ManaValueBound(amount, exact, offset)` bounds MV ?/= `amount + offset`; the `(exact, offset)` ctor uses X (`XValue`), other `DynamicAmount`s give board-derived bounds � Beseech the Queen bounds by `PermanentCount` of lands controlled (null filter, any card). `searchPlayer=ACTIVE_PLAYER` searches the player whose upkeep caused an each-upkeep trigger (Oath of Lieges); otherwise the stack entry's controller is searched. `grantHaste`/`exileAtEndStep` apply to battlefield destinations only: the found permanent gains haste and/or is queued for `DelayedPermanentActionKind.EXILE_AT_END_STEP` (Zirilan of the Claw `(dragon permanent card, BATTLEFIELD, true, true)`). Used by Diabolic Tutor `()`, Increasing Ambition `(null,1,2)`, land fetchers `(basicLand())`, Fabricate/Trinket Mage `(predicate)`, Rampant Growth/Primeval Titan `(count, filter, BATTLEFIELD_TAPPED)` |
| `SearchLibraryAndOrGraveyardForCardToHandEffect` | `(CardPredicate filter)` | choose up to one matching card from the controller's library and/or graveyard, reveal it, and put it into hand. The one-argument constructor uses `CardIsPermanentPredicate` |

Use `XValue()` for "mills X", `CountersOnSource(CHARGE)` for Grindclock, `CardsInHand(TARGET_PLAYER)` for "mills cards equal to their hand size" (Dreamborn Muse). "Each player mills N" = `MillEffect(N, CONTROLLER)` + `MillEffect(N, EACH_OPPONENT)` (Ghoulcaller's Bell, Chill of Foreboding). For flashback "twice X" (Increasing Confusion), wrap two mills in `ConditionalReplacementEffect(new CastFromZone(Zone.GRAVEYARD), Mill(XValue(), TARGET_PLAYER), Mill(Scaled(XValue(),2), TARGET_PLAYER))` |

## Exile

`ExileGraveyardCardsEffect` also supports `GraveyardExileScope.DYING_CREATURE_CONTROLLER`, a non-targeting scope that exiles the last-known controller's graveyard when used by a delayed death trigger such as Burn Away.

Scopes: `OWN` (a player exiles `count` cards from their own graveyard, their choice; `affectedPlayerId` baked at trigger time � Curse of Oblivion), `TARGET_CARDS_ANY_GRAVEYARD` (scope `ALL_GRAVEYARDS`; exile one target card from any graveyard, optional `CardTypePredicate` filter � Cemetery Reaper/Thraben Heretic/Conversion Chamber/Ascendant Dustspeaker/Glorious Decay/Purify the Grave; fizzles if target removed; validated by `GraveyardTargetValidators`), `TARGET_CARDS_OPPONENT_GRAVEYARD` (scope `OPPONENT_GRAVEYARD`; exile exactly `count` target cards via `targetCardIds`, validated by `TargetLegalityService.validateMultiTargetGraveyardAbility()` � Deadeye Tracker count=2), `TARGET_PLAYER_ENTIRE` (player-targeting spec; exile a target player's whole graveyard � Nihil Spellbomb), `TARGET_PLAYER_ALL_MATCHING` (player-targeting spec; exile every card matching the filter from the TARGET player's graveyard, null filter = whole graveyard, and record the number exiled on the entry's `eventValue` for a following `EventValue` reader – Crypt Incursion + `GainLifeEffect(Scaled(EventValue(), 3))`), `ALL_PLAYERS` (exile every player's graveyard � Sentinel Totem), `ALL_OPPONENTS` (exile every opponent's graveyard � Phyrexian Scriptures chapter III). `exactTargetCount` + `trackWithSource` support exact multi-card imprint choices such as Spellweaver Helix. Works in the `ON_ENTER_BATTLEFIELD` slot (Rooftop Percher � all-graveyards multi-select via `GraveyardTargetingService.handleGraveyardExileETBTargeting`), as a `"Discard this card"` hand ability (Faerie Macabre), and in the `SPELL` slot (Scarab Feast � cast-time multi-select via `GraveyardTargetingService.handleUpToNSingleGraveyardSpellTargeting`, wired in `SpellCastingService`). The SPELL path adds the **single-graveyard** restriction ("from a single graveyard"): `graveyardTargetOperation.singleGraveyard` is set so `GraveyardChoiceHandlerService.handleMultipleCardsChosen` rejects a selection spanning more than one graveyard (and `MultiGraveyardChoiceAiStrategy` confines the AI's picks to one). Resolved by `ExileCardsFromGraveyardEffectHandler` (reads `targetCardIds`). Implements the `GraveyardCardChoosingEffect` capability (`graveyardChoiceMaxTargets()` / `graveyardChoiceFilter()`), which is how trigger collectors route it to a multi-card graveyard selection without an `instanceof`. The 5-arg form adds the Rysorian Badger riders: `lifeGainPerExiledCard` makes `lifeGain` per card actually exiled, `filter` restricts the choosable cards, and `assignNoCombatDamage` adds the entry's `sourcePermanentId` to `creaturesPreventedFromDealingCombatDamage` when at least one card was exiled (`ON_ATTACKS_UNBLOCKED`, selection via `GraveyardTargetingService.handleUnblockedAttackGraveyardChoiceTargeting`). On `ON_COMBAT_DAMAGE_TO_PLAYER` (Skullsnatcher) `CombatDamageService` routes it to `handleCombatDamageGraveyardChoiceTargeting`, the same up-to-N selection narrowed to the damaged player's graveyard. The 3-arg form's `singleGraveyard` flag enforces one-graveyard selection and its `trackWithSource` flag preserves the source ID for later source-linked returns (Gravegouger) |

Copy form (`copyExiledCards=true`) = each token is a copy of the exiled card with an Eternalize-style transform: `colorOverride` replaces the copy's color, `addedSubtype` is added in addition to its other types, `powerOverride`/`toughnessOverride` set base P/T. Hour of Eternity = `(false, true, 4, 4, CardColor.BLACK, CardSubtype.ZOMBIE)` � "a copy of that card, except it's a 4/4 black Zombie". Copy build delegates to `GraveyardReturnSupport.createTokenCopyFromCard(...)` |

List<CardSubtype> subtypes, Set<Keyword> keywords, Set<CardType> additionalTypes, Map<EffectSlot, CardEffect> tokenEffects)` or factory: `CreateTokenEffect.ofArtifactToken(int amount, String tokenName, List<CardSubtype> subtypes, List<ActivatedAbility> abilities)` or static factories for common tokens: `CreateTokenEffect.whiteSpirit(int amount)` (1/1 white Spirit with flying), `CreateTokenEffect.blackZombie(int amount)` (2/2 black Zombie), `CreateTokenEffect.whiteSoldier(int amount)` (1/1 white Soldier), `CreateTokenEffect.ofTreasureToken(int amount)` (Treasure artifact) or canonical (all params): `(CardType primaryType, DynamicAmount amount, String tokenName, int power, int toughness, CardColor color, Set<CardColor> colors, List<CardSubtype> subtypes, Set<Keyword> keywords, Set<CardType> additionalTypes, boolean tappedAndAttacking, boolean tapped, Map<EffectSlot, CardEffect> tokenEffects, List<ActivatedAbility> tokenAbilities, boolean exileAtEndOfCombat, boolean exileAtEndStep, boolean legendary, int initialPlusOnePlusOneCounters, Set<Keyword> grantedKeywordsUntilEndOfTurn)` (also with `int amount` = `Fixed` sugar) | create N tokens. The count is a `DynamicAmount` evaluated at resolution (source-relative amounts read the live source permanent, falling back to `sourcePermanentSnapshot` when it left the battlefield as a cost); every "create a token for each �" wording is this effect + an amount � never a new effect class. Power/toughness are also `DynamicAmount`s (every int ctor is `Fixed` sugar): "create an X/X token where X is �" = the `(String tokenName, DynamicAmount power, DynamicAmount toughness, CardColor, List<CardSubtype>, Set<Keyword>, Set<CardType>)` ctor, e.g. Phyrexian Rebirth's `EventValue()`/`EventValue()` colorless Horror as a `DestroyAllPermanentsEffect` rider. The single-color convenience constructor also accepts a `DynamicAmount` in the amount position. Examples: "for each charge counter on ~" = `CountersOnSource(CHARGE)` (Shrine of Loyal Legions), "create X tokens" = `XValue()` (White Sun's Zenith), "for each Aura and Equipment attached to ~" = `AttachmentsOnSource(true, true)` (Valduk) / Equipment only = `(false, true)` (Kemba, Kha Regent), "for each poison counter your opponents have" = `OpponentPoisonCounters()` (Phyrexian Swarmlord), "for each creature you control" = `PermanentCount(IsCreature, CONTROLLER)` (Chancellor of the Forge), "for each creature card in your graveyard" = `CardsInGraveyard(CardTypePredicate(CREATURE), CONTROLLER)` (Spider Spawning; Kessig Cagebreakers adds `tappedAndAttacking=true` via the canonical ctor), "for each Forest you control" = `PermanentCount(HasSubtype(FOREST), CONTROLLER)` (Howl of the Night Pack), "for each creature put into your graveyard from the battlefield this turn" = `CreatureDeathsThisTurn(CONTROLLER)` (Fresh Meat), "half the number of Zombies you control, rounded down" = `Divided(PermanentCount(AllOf(IsCreature, HasSubtype(ZOMBIE)), CONTROLLER), 2)` (Endless Ranks of the Dead). `primaryType` determines the token's card type (CREATURE for creature tokens, ARTIFACT for artifact tokens like Treasure/Clue/Food); all convenience constructors default to CREATURE. `tokenAbilities` adds activated abilities to the token (e.g. Treasure's tap-sacrifice-for-mana). For non-creature tokens, power/toughness are ignored and `handleCreatureEnteredBattlefield` is not called. `ofArtifactToken` factory creates colorless artifact tokens with abilities. `color` is primary display color. `colors` (Set&lt;CardColor&gt;, nullable) is full color identity for multi-color tokens. Multi-color constructors default keywords/additionalTypes to empty sets. When `initialPlusOnePlusOneCounters` &gt; 0, each created token enters with that many +1/+1 counters (e.g. Additive Evolution's 0/0 Fractal with three counters). When `tappedAndAttacking=true`, tokens enter the battlefield tapped and attacking (CR 508.8) � used for "whenever ~ attacks, create tokens tapped and attacking" abilities (e.g. Hero of Bladehold). When `tapped=true`, tokens enter the battlefield tapped but not attacking � used for cards like Army of the Damned. When `exileAtEndOfCombat=true`, tokens are exiled at end of combat step � used for temporary attack tokens (e.g. Geist of Saint Traft). When `tokenEffects` is non-empty, each entry's effect is registered on the token card at the given slot, giving the token its own triggered abilities (e.g. Mitotic Slime's cascading death triggers). When `legendary=true`, the token has the LEGENDARY supertype (subject to legend rule) � used for named legendary tokens (e.g. Verix Bladewing creating Karox Bladewing). `grantedKeywordsUntilEndOfTurn` (defaults to empty in every convenience constructor) is added to each created token's `Permanent.grantedKeywords` after it enters, i.e. keywords the token gains until end of turn � distinct from innate `keywords`. Used for "create a ... token. It gains haste until end of turn" (e.g. Artistic Process's Elemental gains haste) |

Wraps a `CreateTokenEffect` that defines the token characteristics. Targets player (player-targeting spec). Used by Dowsing Dagger (target opponent creates Plant tokens on ETB). On `ON_SELF_LEAVES_BATTLEFIELD` a dedicated collector in `DeathTriggerCollectorService` evaluates the blueprint's dynamic power/toughness against the leaving permanent and freezes it (`CreateTokenEffect.withPowerToughness`) before queueing the target choice, because the source is gone by resolution � Phantasmal Sphere ("target opponent creates an X/X Orb, where X is the number of +1/+1 counters on this creature") . On `ON_ANY_PLAYER_TAPS_LAND` a collector in `LandTapTriggerCollectorService` handles the "whenever you tap this land for mana, target opponent creates ..." shape (Forbidden Orchard): it fires only when the source land itself is tapped by its own controller and creates the token for that controller's opponent, inline like every other land-tap trigger |

| `RememberTargetPlayerEffect` | `()` | targeted ETB marker that stores the target player on the source permanent for a later linked leaves-the-battlefield ability. If the source leaves before the ETB resolves, the leaves-trigger collector recovers the target from the pending ETB stack entry. |

## Poison counters

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `MeliraPoisonReplacementEffect` | `()` | STATIC replacement marker: the first poison-counter event affecting its controller becomes one poison counter, and later poison-counter events that turn are ignored. Checked by the shared poison application path. Melira, the Living Cure |
| Poison-counter application path | — | `LifeSupport`, combat poison damage, damage-source poison, and delayed poison all use the shared replacement path, including `MeliraPoisonReplacementEffect` and `PlayerCantGetPoisonCountersEffect` |
| `ReturnTargetCardOnDeathThisTurnEffect` artifact targeting | — | The delayed-return registration also handles artifacts and registered permanents that change type before entering a graveyard; Melira, the Living Cure uses it for another creature or artifact |
| `GiveTargetPlayerPoisonCountersEffect` | `(DynamicAmount amount)` | give the targeted player an evaluated number of poison counters; use target-relative amounts such as `TargetPlayerPoisonCounters` for threshold differences. Vraska, Betrayal's Sting |
| `GivePoisonCountersEffect` | `(int amount, PoisonRecipient recipient)`, `(int amount, PoisonRecipient recipient, CardPredicate spellFilter)` or `(int amount, PoisonRecipient recipient, CardPredicate spellFilter, UUID affectedPlayerId)` | give N poison counters, routed by `PoisonRecipient` {CONTROLLER (self-poison, e.g. Phyrexian Vatmother upkeep), TARGET_PLAYER (targets a player; with `spellFilter` doubles as an `ON_CONTROLLER_CASTS_SPELL` trigger descriptor firing when the controller casts a matching spell, resolving into a `spellFilter == null` copy � Hand of the Praetors), EACH_PLAYER (every player incl. controller, e.g. Ichor Rats ETB), ENCHANTED_PERMANENT_CONTROLLER (`ON_ENCHANTED_PERMANENT_TAPPED` slot; `affectedPlayerId` is null in the card def and baked in at trigger time by `MiscTriggerCollectorService.handleEnchantedPermanentTapPoison` � Relic Putrescence)}. All placement routes through the central `LifeSupport.applyPoisonCounters` path (respects `PlayerCantGetPoisonCountersEffect` suppression) |
| `GiveControllerPoisonCountersOnTargetDeathThisTurnEffect` | `(int amount)` | delayed trigger: registers the target creature so that when it dies this turn, its controller gets N poison counters. Reads target from stack entry's `targetId`. Tracking in `GameData.creatureGivingControllerPoisonOnDeathThisTurn`, cleared at end of turn |
| `ReturnTargetCardOnDeathThisTurnEffect` | `()` / `(boolean enterTapped)` / `underControllerExcludingSource()` / `fromControllerGraveyard()` | delayed trigger: registers the target creature so that when it dies this turn, that card returns to the battlefield (tapped when `enterTapped`). The default forms return under the card owner's control (Graceful Reprieve, Supernatural Stamina); `underControllerExcludingSource()` returns under the registering ability's controller and narrows the target to a creature other than the source (Adarkar Valkyrie); `fromControllerGraveyard()` only fires when the card enters the registering controller's graveyard (Saffi Eriksdotter). Reads target from stack entry's `targetId`; tracking in `GameData.creaturesReturnedToBattlefieldOnDeathThisTurn` (card ID → list of `DelayedReturnOnDeath`, cleared at end of turn), so multiple registrations for the same creature each create a delayed trigger. |
| `ReturnTriggeringCardFromGraveyardToBattlefieldEffect` | `()` / `(boolean enterTapped, boolean returnUnderController)` | triggered-ability effect: returns the stack entry's card from its owner's graveyard to the battlefield, under the triggered ability controller's control when `returnUnderController` is true (Adarkar Valkyrie), otherwise under its owner's control. Fizzles if no longer in a graveyard. Pushed by the death pipeline for `ReturnTargetCardOnDeathThisTurnEffect`; not added directly to a card |
| `ResolveEffectOnTargetDeathThisTurnEffect` | `(CardEffect effect)` | delayed trigger: registers the target creature so that when it dies this turn, the wrapped `effect` resolves under the registering player's control. Reads target from stack entry's `targetId`; tracking in `GameData.creatureTriggeringEffectOnDeathThisTurn` (map of `DelayedEffectOnDeath`, cleared at end of turn). The death pipeline pushes a triggered ability resolving the wrapped effect, carrying the registering `sourcePermanentId` so self-referential effects (`TransformToBackFaceEffect`) find their source. Pair with `DealDamageToTargetCreatureEffect`. Used by Skeletonize (token) and Initiate of Blood (flip) |

## Creature pump / boost

- `BoostTargetPermanentEffect` — `(DynamicAmount powerBoost, DynamicAmount toughnessBoost, PermanentPredicate filter)` or `(int, int, PermanentPredicate)`; target permanent gets +X/+Y until end of turn. The optional filter narrows the permanent target, including creature-or-Vehicle targets, and dynamic amounts evaluate against the source/controller.

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `SetBasePowerToughnessEffect` | `(Integer power, Integer toughness, GrantScope scope)`; `(int power, int toughness)` � `GrantScope.TARGET`; `toughnessOnly(int toughness)` � `(null, toughness, TARGET)` | set base P/T (modifiers still apply on top, CR 613 layer 7b). `scope == TARGET`: one-shot, sets target creature's base P/T **until end of turn** (Diminish, Quandrix Charm). `scope == SELF`: one-shot on the source, **until end of turn**, for a non-targeting self ability (Marsh Flitter). Any other scope (`ENCHANTED_CREATURE`, `EQUIPPED_CREATURE`, �): continuous STATIC (Deep Freeze, Darksteel Mutation). Every setter is a CR 613 sublayer-7b entry ordered by timestamp � one-shot resolutions create a floating 7b effect (per-target for the mass setter, locking the affected set per CR 611.2c) and dual-write the legacy `Permanent` UEOT override fields for last-known-information/direct readers; the latest-timestamp setter wins and beats any 7a CDA in layer order. A `null` component means "leave that base value alone" � `toughnessOnly(1)` ("has base toughness 1", Chariot of the Sun) writes only the 7b toughness and keeps printed power; a partial setter deliberately skips the all-or-nothing legacy UEOT fields and relies on the floating 7b entry, so only the one-shot `TARGET`/`SELF` pipeline supports nulls (continuous static scopes must pass both). |
| `SetSelfBasePowerToughnessIndefinitelyEffect` | `(int power, int toughness)` | non-targeting activated ability effect that permanently sets the source's base P/T. Reuses the layer-7b `SetBasePowerToughnessEffect` floating path with `EffectDuration.PERMANENT` and permanent legacy overrides. |
| `SetAllUnblockedCreaturesBasePowerToughnessEffect` | `(int power, int toughness)` | set base P/T of **every unblocked creature (any player's)** until end of turn (CR 613 layer 7b, modifiers apply on top). "Unblocked" = attacking + no creature blocking it, evaluated and locked in at resolution (CR 611.2c); creatures that become unblocked later aren't affected. Same floating-7b + legacy-field dual-write mechanics as the mass own-creatures setter. Inkfathom Witch |
| `SetSelfPowerToughnessFromTargetCreatureEffect` | `(int powerFromTargetToughnessOffset, int toughnessFromTargetPowerOffset, PermanentPredicate targetPredicate)` | targets a creature but changes the **source**: reads the target's effective toughness/power once at resolution, adds the offsets, and installs an until-end-of-turn layer-7b setter on the source (a floating `SetBasePowerToughnessEffect(p, t, SELF)` plus the legacy UEOT dual-write, exactly like `SetBasePowerToughnessEffectHandler`). The values are locked in � later P/T changes on the target, or the target leaving, don't update them. `targetSpec()` is `benign(CREATURE, targetPredicate)`; pass the same predicate to the ability's `PermanentPredicateTargetFilter`. Sworn Defender (`{1}`, `(-1, 1, PermanentAllOfPredicate(PermanentIsCreaturePredicate, PermanentInCombatWithSourcePredicate))`) |
| `SetTargetBasePowerToughnessUntilNextUpkeepThenAddCounterEffect` | `(int power, int toughness)` / `(int power, int toughness, CounterType, int amount)` | Cycle of Life. Registers a layer-7b floating `SetBasePowerToughnessEffect` on the target with `EffectDuration.UNTIL_CONTROLLERS_NEXT_UPKEEP` � deliberately NOT dual-writing the legacy `basePowerToughnessOverriddenUntilEndOfTurn` fields, which turn cleanup would clear a turn early � and queues a `PutCounterOnPermanentAtNextUpkeep` delayed action. Both are drained at the top of `StepTriggerService.handleUpkeepTriggers` when the effect's controller is the active player: the base P/T expires first, then the counter trigger goes on the stack (non-targeting). `targetSpec()` is a plain benign CREATURE � the "you cast this turn" narrowing lives on the ability's `TargetFilter`, the only validation path that knows the source's controller |
| `GrantBaseStatsToCounterBearersEffect` | `(CounterType counterType, int power, int toughness, Set<Keyword> keywords)` | resolves (one-shot) into a **game-wide continuous rule**: every creature with a `counterType` counter has base P/T `power`/`toughness` (CR 613 layer 7b) and the given `keywords` (layer 6), for as long as it holds such a counter. The handler adds two **source-independent** `FloatingContinuousEffect`s (a `SetBasePowerToughnessEffect` and a `GrantKeywordEffect`) with `sourcePermanentId == null`, `EffectDuration.PERMANENT`, and `scope == PermanentHasCountersPredicate(counterType)`: the layered pass re-evaluates the scope every pass, so the rule persists after the creating card leaves the battlefield (official ruling) and lapses the instant the counter is removed. Idempotent � a second copy of the source establishes nothing new. Install once in `ON_ENTER_BATTLEFIELD`; pair with an upkeep `MayEffect(PutCounterOnTargetPermanentEffect(counterType))` + `target(creature)`. Aven Mimeomancer (feather counter � base 3/1 + flying). **Not a targeted effect** (`targetSpec()` NONE); the counter comes from a separate targeted trigger. Requires the `counterType` to be handled in `PermanentHasCountersPredicate` (both the `PredicateEvaluationService` and `StaticEffectSupport` switches) and in `PermanentCounterSupport.placeCounterOnPermanent`. |
| `SwitchPowerToughnessEffect` | `()` | switch target creature's power and toughness until end of turn. Each resolution adds one floating `L7D_SWITCH_PT` effect (no `Permanent` field � two switches cancel via parity); the layered queries (`GameQueryService.getEffectivePower/getEffectiveToughness`) compute full pre-switch P/T through 7c and swap the finished values (CR 613.4d), so asymmetric boosts follow the pre-switch component. `Permanent.getEffectivePower()` is intrinsic and pre-switch |
| `SwitchAllCreaturesPowerToughnessEffect` | `()` | switch the power and toughness of each creature on the battlefield until end of turn. The handler fixes the affected creature set at resolution and reuses one floating switch effect per creature. |
| `BoostTargetCreatureEffect` | `(DynamicAmount powerBoost, DynamicAmount toughnessBoost[, PermanentPredicate filter])` � convenience `(int, int)` / `(int, int, PermanentPredicate)` / `(int, int, GrantDuration)` ctors wrap in `Fixed` | target creature gets +X/+Y until end of turn. A trailing `GrantDuration.UNTIL_YOUR_NEXT_TURN` instead records a floating `BuffTargetCreatureIndefinitelyEffect` keyed to the ability's controller (expires via `expireFloatingEffectsAtTurnStart`), so the pump survives end-of-turn cleanup — "up to one target creature gets -2/-0 until your next turn" (Jace, Telepath Unbound +1). Optional `filter` narrows the `targetSpec()` predicate ("target creature an opponent controls gets -2/-0" � Ominous Sphinx's cycle/discard trigger, `AllOf(IsCreature, Not(ControlledBySourceController))`); `null` = plain "target creature". **All "target creature gets +N/+M �" wordings, including "for each �", "+X/+X" (X paid), and "where X is �", use this one effect with `DynamicAmount` parameters** � the amount evaluates against the SOURCE (effect controller), so counting contexts refer to the controller, not the pumped target. Examples: `(new PermanentCount(new PermanentIsCreaturePredicate(), CountScope.CONTROLLER), same)` "+X/+X where X = creatures you control" (Elder of Laurels); `(new XValue(), new Fixed(0))` "+X/+0" (Kessig Wolf Run), `(new XValue(), new XValue())` "+X/+X" (Untamed Might); `(new Sum(new Fixed(1), new CardsInGraveyard(new CardNamedPredicate("Ancestral Anger"), CountScope.CONTROLLER)), new Fixed(0))` "+X/+0 where X is 1 plus the number of cards named Ancestral Anger in your graveyard" (Ancestral Anger; count at resolution � the spell is not yet in the graveyard). Also a `CombatOpponentReferencingEffect`: on ON_BLOCK / ON_BECOMES_BLOCKED (PER_BLOCKER) the combat opponent is baked in as the trigger's non-targeting target, so "blocks or becomes blocked by a creature, that creature gets +1/+1" needs no target filter (Flailing Drake) |
| `BoostTargetCreatureByTargetPlayerCountEffect` | `(DynamicAmount powerBoost, DynamicAmount toughnessBoost[, boolean harmful[, int targetPlayerGroup]])` | target creature gets the supplied dynamic P/T modifiers until end of turn, evaluating both amounts with the separately declared target player's id. Use `CountScope.TARGET_PLAYER` for "for each [permanent] that player controls" when the player and creature are different target groups (Dark Salvation). The default player target group is `0`; `harmful` controls whether protection prevents the effect |
| `BoostPairedCreatureOfTargetEffect` | `(DynamicAmount powerBoost, DynamicAmount toughnessBoost)` � convenience `(int, int)` | soulbond rider for a targeted pump: "If it's paired with a creature, that creature also gets +X/+Y until end of turn". Boosts the **soulbond partner** (`Permanent.pairedWithId`) of each target, never the target itself; no-op when the target is unpaired or has left the battlefield. Bind it to the same target group as a `BoostTargetCreatureEffect` (Joint Assault = both `(2, 2)`). Amounts evaluate against the source/controller like `BoostTargetCreatureEffect`. Implements `CreatureBoostEffect`, so AI polarity/scoring picks it up |
| `BoostSelfEffect` | `(DynamicAmount powerBoost, DynamicAmount toughnessBoost)` � convenience `(int, int)` ctor wraps in `Fixed` | this creature gets +X/+Y. One-shot (until end of turn) in triggered/activated slots, continuous when placed in `STATIC` (selfOnly static handler). **All "gets +N/+M for each �" wordings use this one effect with `DynamicAmount` parameters** � see the Dynamic amounts section. Examples: `(new PermanentCount(new PermanentIsArtifactPredicate(), CountScope.CONTROLLER), new Fixed(0))` "+1/+0 for each artifact you control" (Hellkite Igniter, Karn token, Deadeye Plunderers); `PermanentCount(..., CONTROLLER, true)` "+1/+0 for each *other* Rat you control" (Rat Colony); `PermanentCount(..., OPPONENTS)` "for each creature your opponents control" (Scourge of Geier Reach); `PermanentCount(new PermanentIsEnchantmentPredicate(), ANY_PLAYER)` "for each enchantment on the battlefield" (Yavimaya Enchantress); `PermanentCount(AllOf(IsAttacking, HasSubtype(PIRATE)), CONTROLLER, true)` "for each other attacking Pirate" (Dire Fleet Captain, ON_ATTACK); `CardsInGraveyard(new CardTypePredicate(LAND), CONTROLLER)` "for each land card in your graveyard" (Multani); `Scaled(new AttachmentsOnSource(true, true), 2)` "+2/+2 for each Aura and Equipment attached" (Champion of the Flame; equipment-only: `AttachmentsOnSource(false, true)`, Goblin Gaveleer); `CreaturesBlockingSource()` "for each creature blocking it" (Elvish Berserker, ON_BECOMES_BLOCKED); `OpponentPoisonCounters()` (Mycosynth Fiend); `ImprintedCreaturePower()`/`ImprintedCreatureToughness()` (Phyrexian Ingester); `XValue()` "+X/+0 where X is the mana spent to cast that spell" inside `SpellCastTriggerEffect` � the trigger collector snapshots `xValue` for any amount that references X (Aberrant Manawurm) |

Use one wrapper per gated clause of a hybrid spell (e.g. Repel Intruders: `{W}`�create tokens, `{U}`�`CounterSpellEffect`; "do both if {W}{U} was spent" falls out for free). A targeted clause pairs with `target(filter, 0, 1)` since `registerEffectTargetIndex` unwraps the conditional |

Amount evaluated once at resolution. Examples: `(new Scaled(new XValue(), -1), new Scaled(new XValue(), -1))` "all creatures get -X/-X where X was paid" (Ichor Explosion); `(new XValue(), new Scaled(new XValue(), -1))` "+X/-X" (Flowstone Slide) |

With `GrantScope.ENCHANTED_CREATURE` it works as an aura boost (enchanted creature gets +X/+Y), with `GrantScope.EQUIPPED_CREATURE` it works as an equipment boost (equipped creature gets +X/+Y), and with `GrantScope.ENCHANTED_PLAYER_CREATURES` it affects creatures controlled by the enchanted player (for Curses). Amounts evaluate against the Aura/Equipment's controller (CR 109.5), so `CountScope.CONTROLLER` = "you"/"you control". Examples: `+X/+X` per creature card in all graveyards `(CardsInGraveyard(CardTypePredicate(CREATURE), ANY_PLAYER), same, EQUIPPED_CREATURE)` (Bonehoard); per creature card in your graveyard uses `CONTROLLER` (Wreath of Geists); `+X/+0` instants+sorceries in your graveyard uses `(CardsInGraveyard(anyOf(INSTANT,SORCERY), CONTROLLER), Fixed(0), �)` (Runechanter's Pike); `+1/+1` per land you control `(PermanentCount(PermanentIsLandPredicate, CONTROLLER), same, �)` (Blackblade Reforged); per basic-land subtype you control `(PermanentCount(PermanentHasSubtypePredicate(FOREST), CONTROLLER), same, �)` (Blanchwood Armor, Lashwrithe, Armored Ascension); `-1/-1` per Swamp uses `Scaled(�, -1)` (Quag Sickness); `+1/+1` per matching-name land `(LandsMatchingImprintedName(), same, �)` (Strata Scythe) ; with `amountsFromAttachedCreature=true` the amounts evaluate with the attached creature as amount source and its controller as amount controller, so `IfSourceAttacking` switches on *its* combat state and `CountScope.CONTROLLER` reads "its controller" (Tahngarth's Rage: +3/+0 while attacking, -2/-1 otherwise) — unlike `ShrinkEnchantedCreatureEffect` there is no toughness floor |
| `ShrinkEnchantedCreatureEffect` | `(DynamicAmount amount)` | static layer 7c (CR 613.4c): the enchanted creature gets `-X/-Y` where `X = amount` and `Y = min(X, toughnessSoFar - 1)`, i.e. the toughness reduction is clamped so this effect alone can never take the creature below 1 toughness. Two differences from `AttachedBoostEffect`, both demanded by the wordings that need this record: the toughness floor, and the fact that `amount` evaluates with the **enchanted creature** as the amount source and *its* controller as the amount controller � so `IfSourceAttacking` reads the enchanted creature's combat state, `CountScope.DEFENDING_PLAYER` reads the player it is attacking, and `CountScope.CONTROLLER` reads "its controller" (NOT the Aura's controller, unlike CR 109.5 "you control" wordings). The floor is measured against the creature's toughness *so far in the pass* (own effective toughness + bonuses already in the accumulator), which both counts other pumps and keeps the self-referential value from recursing into static bonus assembly. Snowblind = `IfSourceAttacking(PermanentCount(snow land, DEFENDING_PLAYER), PermanentCount(snow land, CONTROLLER))`. Handler `ShrinkEnchantedCreatureEffectHandler` |

## P/T setting / counters

| `SetCreatureTypesToImprintedCreatureEffect` | `(List<CardSubtype> retainedSubtypes)` or `(CardSubtype retainedSubtype)` | static self effect that replaces the source's creature subtypes with the creature subtypes of its imprinted card, retaining the supplied subtypes. Pass the same amount instance for both fields for "P/T are each equal to �". Replaced the entire `PowerToughnessEqualTo*` family and `BoostSelfBySlimeCountersOnLinkedPermanentEffect`. Examples: `PermanentCount(new PermanentIsLandPredicate(), CONTROLLER)` (lands you control � Molimo), `PermanentCount(new PermanentIsCreaturePredicate(), CONTROLLER)` (creatures you control � Scion of the Wild), `PermanentCount(new PermanentHasSubtypePredicate(CardSubtype.SWAMP), CONTROLLER)` (Swamps you control � Nightmare), `CardsInGraveyard(new CardTypePredicate(CardType.CREATURE), ANY_PLAYER)` (creature cards in all graveyards � Mortivore), `CardsInGraveyard(new CardTypePredicate(CardType.CREATURE), CONTROLLER)` (your graveyard only � Boneyard Wurm), `CardsInHand(CONTROLLER)` (your hand size � Psychosis Crawler), `ControllerLifeTotal()` (Ajani's Avatar token), `CountersOnLinkedPermanent(CounterType.SLIME, sourceId)` (Gutter Grime's Ooze tokens) |

| `AllyCombatDamageTriggerEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate dealerPredicate, CardEffect effect, boolean bindSourceToDealer, boolean oncePerDamageStep)` / sugar `(dealerPredicate, effect, bindSourceToDealer)` = `oncePerDamageStep=false` / `(dealerPredicate, effect)` = both `false` | ON_ALLY_CREATURE_COMBAT_DAMAGE_TO_PLAYER slot: when a creature you control matching `dealerPredicate` (null = any) deals combat damage to a player, put `effect` on the stack for its controller. `bindSourceToDealer=false` binds the stack entry's source to the permanent carrying the trigger; `true` binds it to the damage dealer so source-referencing effects apply to the dealer. The damaged player is bound as the stack entry's target, so target-player effects like `DiscardEffect(N, DiscardRecipient.TARGET_PLAYER)` resolve against them (Oona's Blackguard: `(PermanentHasCountersPredicate(PLUS_ONE_PLUS_ONE), DiscardEffect(1, TARGET_PLAYER))` � "that player discards a card"). The damaged player is bound as the stack entry's target, so target-player effects like `DiscardEffect(N, DiscardRecipient.TARGET_PLAYER)` resolve against them (Oona's Blackguard: `(PermanentHasCountersPredicate(PLUS_ONE_PLUS_ONE), DiscardEffect(1, TARGET_PLAYER))` � "that player discards a card"). Wrap `effect` in a `MayEffect` for "you may" wordings. Used by Boggart Mob (Goblin predicate � may create a 1/1 black Goblin Rogue token) and Rakish Heir (`(PermanentHasSubtypePredicate(VAMPIRE), PutCountersOnSourceEffect(1,1,1), true)` � counter goes on the dealing Vampire). Counter-type generic: harmful spec for `MINUS_ONE_MINUS_ONE`, benign otherwise (both modes declare `CREATURE`; the null-`targetId` tolerance CHOSEN needs comes from `EffectResolution.distributesAmountsAmongTargets`, not from a no-op category). Placement routes through `PermanentCounterSupport.placeCounterOnPermanent` (so -1/-1 prevention/reduction and +1/+1 triggers apply); a target that is no longer a creature at resolution is skipped (CR 608.2b) |
| `PutPhylacteryCounterOnTargetPermanentEffect` | `()` | put a phylactery counter on an artifact you control as an "as enters" replacement effect. Does NOT target (shroud/hexproof don't prevent it). Counter is placed directly when creature enters, not via stack. Artifact choice is validated at resolution: must be an artifact controlled by the caster. If no valid artifact is chosen, ability does nothing. Used by Phylactery Lich |
| `StateTriggerEffect` | `(StateTriggerPredicate, List<CardEffect>, String)` or `(PermanentPredicate sourcePredicate, List<CardEffect>, String)` | state-triggered ability (MTG rule 603.8). When the condition is met after SBAs, pushes effects onto the stack as a triggered ability. Won't retrigger while the ability is on the stack. Place in `STATE_TRIGGERED` slot. The `StateTriggerPredicate` form is a free-form lambda over the whole game state (Phylactery Lich, Gorilla Pack, Call to Arms). The `PermanentPredicate` form states a condition about the source permanent only and is evaluated through `PredicateEvaluationService`, so it is CR 613 layer-aware � use it whenever static grants must count ("When this creature has flying, sacrifice it" = `PermanentHasKeywordPredicate(FLYING)`, Floodgate; `Permanent.hasKeyword` alone would miss an aura's grant) |
| `DoubleCountersOnTargetPermanentEffect` | `()` | double the number of each kind of counter on target permanent (for every counter kind present, adds that many more of the same kind). permanent-targeting spec; use with `PermanentPredicateTargetFilter(new PermanentTruePredicate(), ...)` for "target permanent". Used by Gilder Bairn (`{2}{G/U}, {Q}` activated ability, `.withRequiresUntap()`) |
| `DoublePlusOneCountersOnTargetCreatureEffect` | `()` | double the number of +1/+1 counters on each target creature; targets are resolved independently and only +1/+1 counter placement uses the shared replacement/trigger pipeline. Used by Solidarity of Heroes |
| `DoublePlusOneCountersOnControlledCreaturesEffect` | `()` | double the number of +1/+1 counters on each creature you control (non-targeting). Distinct from `DoubleCountersOnTargetPermanentEffect` (single target, every counter kind) |
| `DoubleCountersOnEachControlledPermanentEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate predicate)` | double every kind of counter on each permanent the controller controls matching `predicate` (non-targeting), using the shared counter-placement replacement and trigger pipeline. Used by Miles Morales on `ON_ALLY_CREATURES_ATTACK` |
| `RemoveCountersFromTargetAndBoostSelfEffect` | `()` | remove up to X counters of any type from target permanent (X from xValue), then boost source +1/+0 per counter removed until end of turn. Removes in order: +1/+1, charge, phylactery, loyalty, -1/-1, awakening. Used by Hex Parasite |
| `RemoveCounterAndGainLifeEffect` | `(CounterType counterType, int lifeGain, CounterRemovalSubject subject)` | remove one counter of the given type from the subject; controller gains `lifeGain` life only if a counter was actually removed ("If you do"). `TARGET` declares a benign creature target — Woeleecher (MINUS_ONE_MINUS_ONE, 2), Chainbreaker (MINUS_ONE_MINUS_ONE, 0, removal only). `SOURCE` is non-targeting and resolves against the stack entry's `sourcePermanentId`; wrap in `MayEffect` for "you may" — Living Artifact (VITALITY, 1, UPKEEP_TRIGGERED), Exemplar of Strength (MINUS_ONE_MINUS_ONE, 1, ON_ATTACK) |
| `ProliferateEffect` | `()` or `(DynamicAmount amount)` | proliferate once, or resolve a dynamic number of sequential proliferate events; choose any number of permanents with counters and add one of each counter type already there |
| `AdjustEachCounterKindOnTargetEffect` | `()` | Quarry Hauler: "for each kind of counter on target permanent, put another counter of that kind on it or remove one from it." Targets any permanent (benign `PERMANENT` spec). At resolution snapshots every distinct counter kind present on the target and prompts the controller ADD/REMOVE once per kind through the generic list-choice (`ChoiceContext.AdjustCounterKindChoice`, handled by `ChoiceHandlerService.handleAdjustCounterKindChoice`); each kind is an independent decision. No-op if the target has no counters. ADD routes through `PermanentCounterSupport.placeCounterOnPermanent` (preserves +1/+1 self-triggers, -1/-1 prevention/watchers, saga chapters); REMOVE decrements; SBAs run once all kinds are resolved |
| `AdjustChosenCounterOnTargetEffect` | `()` or `(boolean suspendedCardOwnedOnly[, CounterType fixedCounterType])` | Clockspinning targets any permanent or a suspended card; Jhoira's Timebug passes `true, TIME` to restrict the permanent to the source controller, the suspended card to its owner, and the adjustment to time counters. Permanent additions use `PermanentCounterSupport`; a suspended card offers its time counter and removal uses the shared last-counter suspend-cast flow |
| `AddAnotherCounterOfChosenTypeToTargetEffect` | `()` | Animation Module activated ability: targets a permanent or player, snapshots the counter kinds present at resolution, asks the controller to choose one, and puts one more counter of that kind on the target. A player target means poison counters. Uses `ChoiceContext.AddAnotherCounterTypeChoice`; permanent placement goes through `PermanentCounterSupport.placeCounterOnPermanent` and poison placement through `LifeSupport.applyPoisonCounters` |
| `PutAwakeningCountersOnTargetLandsEffect` | `()` | combat damage trigger: choose any number of lands you control, put an awakening counter on each. Lands with awakening counters are 8/8 green Elemental creatures (permanent). Place in `ON_COMBAT_DAMAGE_TO_PLAYER` slot. Handled inline in CombatService via multi-permanent choice |
| `ChooseOpponentPermanentsAndPutCountersEffect` | `(CounterType counterType, int maxCount, PermanentPredicate filter)` | ETB: choose up to N permanents opponents control matching filter, put a counter of the specified type on each. Auto-selects all if ?maxCount eligible; prompts multi-permanent choice if more. Place in `ON_ENTER_BATTLEFIELD`. Resolved by `PermanentCounterResolutionService`. Used by Haphazard Bombardment (AIM, 4, nonenchantment) |
| `DestroyRandomOpponentPermanentWithCounterEffect` | `(CounterType counterType, int minRequired)` | end step trigger with intervening-if: if at least minRequired opponent permanents have the specified counter, destroy one at random. Place in `CONTROLLER_END_STEP_TRIGGERED`. Intervening-if checked in `StepTriggerService`; resolved by `DestructionResolutionService`. Used by Haphazard Bombardment (AIM, 2) |
| `RemoveXCountersFromSourceCost` | `(CounterType counterType)` | `CostEffect`; removes X counters of `counterType` from the SOURCE permanent, where X is the activation's chosen X. Unlike an `{X}` mana cost the X is bounded by the counters actually present, so the client prompts for it the way it prompts for a variable loyalty cost. The chosen X rides on the activation as its `xValue`, so the ability's effects read it back with an `XValue()` amount. Night Dealings (`CounterType.THEFT`), Cruel Sadist (`CounterType.PLUS_ONE_PLUS_ONE`). When the client does not announce X the engine raises an `XValueChoice` prompt bounded by the counters present |

## Keywords / abilities

- `GrantProtectionFromColorsUntilYourNextTurnEffect(Set<CardColor> colors)` — target creature you control gains protection from the listed colors until your next turn. The handler creates a floating layer-6 protection effect, which expires at the ability controller's next turn. Used by Sygg, Wanderbrine Shield.
- `GrantProtectionFromTargetPermanentColorsUntilEndOfTurnEffect()` — target permanent's effective colors are snapshotted on resolution; each creature controlled by the ability controller gains protection from those colors until end of turn. Used by Samite Elder.
- `GrantProtectionFromEverythingUntilNextTurnEffect()` — controller gains protection from every source until their next turn. Player targeting checks use the protection marker, while damage reuses the existing all-player-damage-prevention-until-next-turn state. The Stasis Coffin.

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `GrantKeywordEffect` | `(Keyword keyword, GrantScope scope)` or `(Keyword keyword, GrantScope scope, PermanentPredicate filter)` or `(Set<Keyword> keywords, GrantScope scope)` or `(Set<Keyword> keywords, GrantScope scope, PermanentPredicate filter)` or with explicit duration: `(Keyword keyword, GrantScope scope, GrantDuration duration)` / `(Set<Keyword> keywords, GrantScope scope, GrantDuration duration)` / static factory `GrantKeywordEffect.toTargetIf(Keyword keyword, PermanentPredicate grantCondition)` / canonical `(Set<Keyword> keywords, GrantScope scope, PermanentPredicate filter, GrantDuration duration, PermanentPredicate grantCondition)` | grant one or more keywords. In `EffectSlot.STATIC` the grant is continuous (anthem), duration and `grantCondition` are ignored |

| `GrantProtectionFromColorUntilEndOfTurnEffect` | `(CardColor color)`, `(CardColor color, PermanentPredicate predicate)`, or `(CardColor color, GrantScope scope)` | grants protection from a fixed, printed colour until end of turn. Default scope is `TARGET` ("target creature gains …"); pass `GrantScope.SELF` for "this creature gains protection from [color]" (Keeper of Kookus — no player target). No player colour choice (unlike `GrantProtectionChoiceUntilEndOfTurnEffect`). Adds to `Permanent.protectionFromColorsUntilEndOfTurn`, cleared by `TurnCleanupService`. The optional predicate narrows the legal target via `targetSpec()` for TARGET scope (Willow Priestess: "target **green** creature gains protection from black") — pass the same predicate to the ability's `PermanentPredicateTargetFilter` |
| `GrantProtectionChoiceUntilEndOfTurnEffect` | `(boolean includeArtifacts, boolean targetControllerChooses, GrantScope scope, PermanentPredicate filter)`, `(boolean includeArtifacts, boolean targetControllerChooses)`, `(boolean includeArtifacts)`, `(GrantScope scope)`, `(GrantScope scope, PermanentPredicate filter)`, or `()` | on resolution, prompts a player to choose a color (and optionally "artifacts" when `includeArtifacts=true`), then grants the target permanent protection from that choice until end of turn. Color protection stored in `Permanent.protectionFromColorsUntilEndOfTurn`, artifact protection in `Permanent.protectionFromCardTypes`. Both cleared on `resetModifiers()`. Triggers `ChoiceContext.ProtectionColorChoice` interaction. When `targetControllerChooses=true` the target permanent's controller chooses instead of the ability's controller (Pale Wayfarer's "the color of its controller's choice"). Used by Apostle's Blessing (`includeArtifacts=true`). The no-arg / single-arg constructors default `targetControllerChooses=false` for cards like Gods Willing. Multi-target aware: when the stack entry carries a flat target list (a `targetX` group � Prismatic Boon's "X target creatures"), every target is put into one `ProtectionColorChoice`, so a single pick applies to all of them; otherwise it falls back to `entry.targetId`. `GrantScope.SELF` is the untargeted "this creature gains protection from the color of your choice" shape (Knight of Dawn) — resolves against `entry.sourcePermanentId` and declares a NONE `targetSpec()`. `GrantScope.OWN_CREATURES` is the untargeted mass shape (Brave the Elements): every creature the controller controls matching `filter` (`null` = each creature you control) gets one shared colour pick, the set computed on resolution, with no prompt raised when nothing qualifies. `filter` is only consulted for `OWN_CREATURES` and the compact ctor rejects it on any other scope, as it rejects every scope outside TARGET / SELF / OWN_CREATURES |
| `LandsOfChosenTypeBecomeChosenBasicTypeUntilEndOfTurnEffect` | `()` | no-target effect: prompts for a land type then a basic land type (`LandsOfTypeBecomeBasicTypeChoice`, chained picks), then each land (any controller) whose effective basic land types include the first **becomes** the second until end of turn — type-replacing per rule 305.7 (`Permanent.transientLandTypeOverride`). Applied once at resolution via `applyBasicLandType(..., replacing=true)`. Used by Vision Charm |
| `GrantProtectionChoiceToControllerAndPermanentsUntilEndOfTurnEffect` | `()` | on resolution, prompts the controller to choose a color (colors only), then grants that controller **and each permanent they control** protection from the chosen color until end of turn (single color for all). Per-permanent protection stored in `Permanent.protectionFromColorsUntilEndOfTurn`; player protection stored in `GameData.playerProtectionFromColorsUntilEndOfTurn` (cleared by `TurnCleanupService`). A player with protection from a color can't be targeted by spells/abilities of that color (`TargetLegalityService`) and can't be dealt damage by sources of that color (`DamageResolutionService.dealDamageToPlayer`, `CombatDamageService`); query via `GameQueryService.playerHasProtectionFromColor`. Triggers `ChoiceContext.MassProtectionColorChoice` interaction. Used by the fateful hour mode of Faith's Shield (combine with `ConditionalEffect(new ControllerLifeAtMost(threshold), wrapped)`) |
| `GrantDamageToOpponentCreatureBounceUntilEndOfTurnEffect` | `()` | until end of turn, creatures you control gain "Whenever this creature deals damage to an opponent, you may return target creature that player controls to its owner's hand." Sets `hasDamageToOpponentCreatureBounce` flag on controlled creatures; CombatService creates `ReturnPermanentsOnCombatDamageToPlayerEffect(PermanentIsCreaturePredicate)` trigger with xValue=1. Cleared on `resetModifiers()`. Used by Arm with Aether |
| `GrantEffectToOwnCreaturesUntilEndOfTurnEffect` | `(EffectSlot slot, CardEffect grantedEffect[, PermanentPredicate filter])` | until end of turn, **creatures you control** (snapshot at resolution � later ETBs / control changes do not get it) gain a triggered ability for the specified slot; the optional predicate narrows the snapshot. Stores via `Permanent.addTemporaryTriggeredEffect`; collected alongside native effects (e.g. `ON_COMBAT_DAMAGE_TO_PLAYER` in `CombatDamageService`); cleared on `resetModifiers()`. Non-targeting. Driven (`ON_COMBAT_DAMAGE_TO_PLAYER` + `DrawCardEffect(1)` + trample grant); Despair (`ON_COMBAT_DAMAGE_TO_PLAYER` + `DiscardEffect(1, TARGET_PLAYER)` + menace grant). Own-creatures analog of `GrantEffectToTargetUntilEndOfTurnEffect` |
| `GrantEffectToTargetEffect` | `(EffectSlot slot, CardEffect grantedEffect)` or `(..., EffectDuration duration)` | grant a triggered ability to the target permanent. Default `PERMANENT` stores on `Permanent.addPersistentTriggeredEffect` (survives resetModifiers); `UNTIL_END_OF_TURN` uses temporary storage. Spec benign(PERMANENT). Skips if target already has an equal effect in that slot. Upkeep grants collected in StepTriggerService. Balduvian Shaman; Musician. `GrantEffectToTargetEffect.toEnchantedPermanent(slot, effect, duration)` (scope `ENCHANTED_PERMANENT`) grants to the permanent the source Aura is attached to instead, re-derived at resolution with no target and no skip-if-present check — Genju of the Fields' `ON_SELF_DEALS_DAMAGE` + `GainLifeEffect(new EventValue())` |
| `DestroyUnlessPaysPerCounterEffect` | `(CounterType counterType, String costPerCounter)` or `(CounterType, String, boolean sacrifice)` | UPKEEP_TRIGGERED: may pay `costPerCounter` A? that counter count on the source or destroy it (Musician). Zero counters = no-op. Fallback via `ForcedCostOrElseEffect` + `DestroyReferencedPermanentEffect(SOURCE)`, or `SacrificeSelfEffect` when `sacrifice=true` (Phantasmal Sphere � sacrifice ignores regeneration/indestructible) |
| `DamageTargetPlayerUnlessPaysPerCounterEffect` | `(int damage, CounterType counterType, String costPerCounter)` | the source deals `damage` to the player on the stack entry's `targetId` unless they pay `costPerCounter` � that counter count on the source (Energy Vortex, `OPPONENT_UPKEEP_TRIGGERED` � its `targetId` is the active player). Zero counters = no prompt, no damage. `DamageDealingEffect`. Reuses `EachPlayerTakesDamageUnlessPaysEffectHandler.offerToPlayers` with a single-entry payer list |
| `GrantTriggeredAbilityEffect` | `(EffectSlot slot, CardEffect grantedEffect, GrantScope scope[, PermanentPredicate filter])` | STATIC-slot continuous grant of a **triggered** ability to the permanents the scope selects. The grant record itself is accumulated as a granted effect by `GrantTriggeredAbilityEffectHandler` / `GrantTriggeredAbilitySelfEffectHandler` (the self pass is what covers the source permanent, since the layer pass never targets a source with itself), and trigger-collection sites read it back via `GrantedTriggeredAbilitySupport.grantedTriggeredEffects(gameData, permanent, slot)`. Wired today in `CombatDamageService` for `ON_COMBAT_DAMAGE_TO_PLAYER` / `ON_DAMAGE_TO_PLAYER`, in `StepTriggerService` for `UPKEEP_TRIGGERED` (via `GrantedUpkeepEffectSupport` — Avarice Amulet's "equipped creature has 'At the beginning of your upkeep, draw a card'", so the creature's controller draws), and in `CombatAttackService` for `ON_ATTACK` (collected off each attacker next to its native and temporary attack triggers, so a targeted grant routes through `PermanentChoiceContext.AttackTriggerTarget` with the attacker as source � Thorncaster Sliver's "Sliver creatures you control have 'Whenever this creature attacks, it deals 1 damage to any target'"). Wrapped in `ConditionalEffect` it is recomputed by the layer system, so the granted trigger turns on and off with the condition � unlike the one-shot `GrantEffectToTargetUntilEndOfTurnEffect`. For `ON_DEATH` grants the collection is different: `TriggerCollectionService.collectDeathTrigger` calls `GrantedTriggeredAbilitySupport.grantedTriggeredEffectsFromAttachments(gameData, permanentId, slot)`, which reads plain (non-conditional) `ENCHANTED_CREATURE`/`ENCHANTED_PERMANENT`/`EQUIPPED_CREATURE` grants straight off the attached permanents — the dying permanent has already left the battlefield, so a layered assembly no longer sees it, while its Aura is still attached (Infernal Scarring: "Enchanted creature has 'When this creature dies, draw a card'"). Conditional self-application goes through `StaticEffectSupport.applySelfOnlyConditionalStaticEffect`. Used by Tandem Lookout (`ConditionalEffect(SourceIsPaired, GrantTriggeredAbilityEffect(ON_DAMAGE_TO_PLAYER, DrawCardEffect(1), SELF_AND_PAIRED))`) |
| `RegisterDelayedReturnDyingCreatureUnderControlEffect` | `()` / `(boolean requireSourceOnBattlefield)` / `forOpponent()` | death-trigger effect that queues the dying creature's card for return at the next end step. `forOpponent()` targets an opponent as the delayed return controller. Global `ON_DEATH` grants are snapshotted before battlefield removal so they survive the death-trigger collection path. |
| `GrantEffectToTargetUntilEndOfTurnEffect` | `(EffectSlot slot, CardEffect grantedEffect)` | until end of turn, the target creature(s) gain a triggered ability for the specified slot. Stores the effect via `Permanent.addTemporaryTriggeredEffect(slot, effect)`. Trigger collection checks `Permanent.getTemporaryTriggeredEffects(slot)` alongside the card's native effects. Cleared on `resetModifiers()`. **Multi-target:** the handler fans over `entry.getTargetIds()` (falling back to `targetId`), so pair it with `target(filter, 0, 99)` for "any number of target creatures". Used by Verdant Rebirth (single-target ON_DEATH bounce) and Rabid Attack (with `BoostTargetCreatureEffect(1, 0)` on the same target list: "+1/+0 and gain 'when this dies, draw a card'"). **ON_ATTACK granted triggers** are collected off the attacker in `CombatAttackService` (native + `getTemporaryTriggeredEffects(ON_ATTACK)`); a granted `MustBlockSourceEffect(null)` has its source snapshotted to the attacker there. Used by Tower Above ("gains 'When this creature attacks, target creature blocks it this turn if able'"). **ON_COMBAT_DAMAGE_TO_PLAYER granted triggers** are likewise collected off the damage-dealing creature in `CombatDamageService` (native + `getTemporaryTriggeredEffects(ON_COMBAT_DAMAGE_TO_PLAYER)`); the controller draws via a plain `DrawCardEffect(1)`. Used by Open into Wonder ("gains 'Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw a card'", bound to a `targetX` group). **ON_BECOMES_BLOCKED granted triggers** are collected off the blocked attacker in `CombatBlockService` (native non-PER_BLOCKER registrations + `getTemporaryTriggeredEffects(ON_BECOMES_BLOCKED)`), both on normal blocker declaration and in `fireBecomesBlockedTriggersWithoutBlockers`; the granted effect is self-scoped to the attacker. Used by Barreling Attack ("When that creature becomes blocked this turn, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each creature blocking it" = `BoostSelfEffect(CreaturesBlockingSource(), CreaturesBlockingSource())`) |
| `ReturnSourceCardFromExileToOwnerHandEffect` | `()` | when resolved as an exile-from-battlefield trigger, returns the triggering source card from exile to its owner's hand. Uses the stack entry's card ID and exile owner. Used by Ashnod's Intervention via `SelfExiledFromBattlefieldEffect` and `GrantEffectToTargetUntilEndOfTurnEffect(ON_SELF_LEAVES_BATTLEFIELD, ...)` |
| `ReturnSourceCardFromGraveyardToOwnerHandEffect` | `()` | when resolved as a death trigger, returns the dying creature's card from its owner's graveyard to its owner's hand. Uses the stack entry's card ID (the trigger source) to identify which card to return. Unlike ReturnEnchantedCreatureToOwnerHandOnDeathEffect (for auras), this returns the source card itself. Used by Verdant Rebirth |
| `ReturnSourceCardFromGraveyardToBattlefieldEffect` | `(boolean tapped)` | when resolved as a death trigger, returns the dying creature's card from its owner's graveyard to the battlefield under its owner's control, tapped when `tapped` is true. Battlefield analogue of `ReturnSourceCardFromGraveyardToOwnerHandEffect`; immediate rather than queued (unlike `RegisterDelayedSelfReturnFromGraveyardEffect`) and adds no counter (unlike `UndyingReturnEffect`). Respects Grafdigger's Cage-style enter-from-graveyard bans and fizzles if the card left the graveyard. Used by Abnormal Endurance via `GrantEffectToTargetUntilEndOfTurnEffect(ON_DEATH, ...)` |
| `ReturnSourceCardFromGraveyardToBattlefieldFaceDownEffect` | `()` | death trigger that returns the dying source card from its owner's graveyard to the battlefield face down under the trigger controller's control. Uses the standard face-down creature characteristics and does not process the card's face-up ETB abilities. Fizzles if the card left the graveyard and respects enter-from-graveyard bans. Used by Ashcloud Phoenix |
| `GrantFlashbackToGraveyardCardsEffect` | `(Set<CardType> cardTypes)` | grants flashback to cards of the specified types in the controller's graveyard until end of turn. The flashback cost equals the card's mana cost. Tracks granted card IDs in `GameData.cardsGrantedFlashbackUntilEndOfTurn`. Cards that already have native flashback are skipped. Cleared at end of turn by `TurnCleanupService`. Used by Past in Flames |
| `GrantFlashbackToTargetGraveyardCardEffect` | `(Set<CardType> cardTypes)` | targets a single card of a matching type in the controller's graveyard and grants it flashback until end of turn. The flashback cost equals the card's mana cost. Own-graveyard-only (kept `@ValidatesTarget` validator enforces the controller's graveyard). Uses multi-graveyard targeting at ETB trigger time (`BattlefieldEntryService.handleGrantFlashbackETBTargeting`) or spell targeting (`targetId` in graveyard). Resolved by `KeywordGrantResolutionService`. Fizzles if target leaves graveyard. Tracks via `GameData.cardsGrantedFlashbackUntilEndOfTurn`. Used by Snapcaster Mage, Flashback (SOS) |
| `GrantHarmonizeToTargetGraveyardCardEffect` | `()` | targets an instant or sorcery card in the controller's graveyard and grants it harmonize until end of turn. The harmonize cost equals the card's mana cost; the temporary grant is tracked in `GameData.cardsGrantedHarmonizeUntilEndOfTurn`. |
| `GrantEmbalmToTargetCreatureCardEffect` | `()` | targets a creature card in the controller's graveyard and grants embalm until end of turn for the card's mana cost. The effect handler records the card ID in `GameData.cardsGrantedEmbalmUntilEndOfTurn`; `GameQueryService` exposes `Card.embalmAbility(card.getManaCost())` as an effective graveyard ability. Revalidates the target's zone and creature type on resolution. Used by Cursecloth Wrappings |
| `GrantTargetCreatureCardGraveyardCastAndCopyActivatedAbilitiesEffect` | `()` | targets a creature card in any graveyard and grants permission to cast that specific card this turn. Tracks card ID -> source permanent ID + casting player ID in `GameData.graveyardCreatureCastPermissionsUntilEndOfTurn`; cleared at cleanup. `SpellCastingService` consumes the permission when the allowed player casts the card from any graveyard by card ID, puts the permanent spell on the stack, then queues a delayed trigger above it. Used by Havengul Lich |
| `GrantSourceActivatedAbilitiesUntilEndOfTurnEffect` | `(List<ActivatedAbility> abilities, String copiedFromCardName)` | delayed triggered ability effect that grants the stack entry's source permanent the provided activated abilities until end of turn via `Permanent.temporaryActivatedAbilities`. Fizzles if the source permanent is gone. Used by Havengul Lich after the selected graveyard creature card is cast |
| `BushidoEffect` | `(DynamicAmount amount)` — int sugar ctor wraps `Fixed` | a Bushido ability. The combat trigger slots that represent Bushido use this rather than a bare `BoostSelfEffect` so other cards can distinguish Bushido from unrelated block triggers (Takeno, Samurai General reads every other Samurai's amount). `asBoost()` returns the `BoostSelfEffect(amount, amount)` the trigger resolves. Fixed N for printed bushido; `PermanentCount(IsAttacking, ANY_PLAYER)` for bushido X (Fumiko) |
| `GrantEffectToSourceUntilEndOfTurnEffect` | `(EffectSlot slot, CardEffect grantedEffect)` | grants the SOURCE permanent a temporary triggered ability until end of turn — "this creature gains '…' until end of turn". Non-targeting: the recipient is the resolving stack entry's source permanent, so nothing is chosen or validated. Stored via `Permanent.addTemporaryTriggeredEffect(EffectSlot, CardEffect)` and cleared at cleanup by `Permanent.resetModifiers()`. Self-scoped sibling of `GrantEffectToTargetEffect` — use that one when the recipient is a chosen target. Cruel Deceiver (`ON_ALLY_CREATURE_DEALS_DAMAGE_TO_CREATURE` + `DestroyDamagedCreatureEffect()`) |
| `GrantEffectToSourceOfChosenColorUntilEndOfTurnEffect` | `(EffectSlot slot, CardEffect grantedEffect)` | after a preceding resolution-time color choice, grants the source a temporary triggered ability whose event subject must have that chosen color. The handler captures the color into a fixed `PermanentColorInPredicate`, so separate activations retain separate choices; stores via `Permanent.addTemporaryTriggeredEffect` and clears at cleanup. |
| `GrantEffectToSourceUntilEndOfCombatEffect` | `(EffectSlot slot, CardEffect grantedEffect)` | grants the SOURCE permanent a temporary triggered ability for the current combat only. Non-targeting and stored separately from end-of-turn grants; `Permanent.clearCombatState()` removes it before a later combat. Goblin Flotilla uses it for `ON_BLOCK` and `ON_BECOMES_BLOCKED` |
| `GrantEffectToSourceEffect` | `(EffectSlot slot, CardEffect grantedEffect)` | grants the SOURCE permanent an indefinite triggered ability. Non-targeting: the recipient is the resolving entry's source permanent. Stored via `Permanent.addPersistentTriggeredEffect(EffectSlot, CardEffect)` and included in self-death trigger collection. Flame-Wreathed Phoenix (`ON_DEATH` + `ReturnSourceCardFromGraveyardToOwnerHandEffect`) |

## Combat restrictions / evasion

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `CantBeBlockedEffect` | `()` | can't be blocked (static) |
| `CantAttackOrBlockAloneEffect` | `(boolean restrictsBlocking)` | this creature can't attack alone (CR 508.1c, static); when `restrictsBlocking` is true it also can't block alone (CR 509.1a). The no-arg constructor defaults to `true` (Mogg Flunkies); pass `false` for "can't attack alone" only (Bonded Construct) |
| `CantAttackOrBlockUnlessGreaterPowerAlsoDoesEffect` | `()` | Okk: can't attack unless another declared attacker has strictly greater power; can't block unless another declared blocker has strictly greater power (static). Combat-set-dependent, so not a `Condition` � validated in `CombatAttackService.validateGreaterPowerAlsoAttacks` / `CombatBlockService.validateGreaterPowerAlsoBlocks` against the current combat's declared set, at declaration time only |
| `CantAttackOrBlockUnlessCountAlsoDoesEffect` | `(int otherCount)` | Orcish Conscripts (`2`): can't attack unless at least N other creatures are declared as attackers; can't block unless at least N other creatures are declared as blockers (static). Combat-set-dependent, so not a `Condition` � validated in `CombatAttackService.validateCountAlsoAttacks` / `CombatBlockService.validateCountAlsoBlocks` against the current combat's declared set, at declaration time only |
| `CantAttackUnlessMatchingCreatureAlsoAttacksEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate predicate, String requirementDescription)` | attack-only combat-set restriction: can't attack unless another declared attacker matches `predicate` (Scarred Puma). Validated in `CombatAttackService.validateMatchingCreatureAlsoAttacks` against the current combat's declared attackers |
| `CreaturesWithPowerGreaterThanAmountCantAttackEffect` | `(DynamicAmount amount)` | global static: any creature (either player's) whose effective power is strictly greater than `amount` can't attack (Ensnaring Bridge `new CardsInHand(CountScope.CONTROLLER)`). `amount` is evaluated from the source's controller via `AmountContext.forStaticEffect`; checked in `CombatAttackService.isCantAttackDueToGlobalRestriction` |
| `CantAttackNextTurnCombatOpponentEffect` | `()` | combat trigger (Wall of Dust): the combat opponent (the creature this permanent blocks) can't attack during its controller's next turn. Placed on `ON_BLOCK`; a `CombatOpponentReferencingEffect`, so `CombatBlockService` auto-targets the blocked attacker (non-targeting). The handler sets `Permanent.cantAttackNextTurn`, which `TurnProgressionService` promotes to `cantAttackThisTurn` at that creature's controller's next turn start (scoped to that player's turn) and self-clears after the one turn; barred in `CombatAttackService.canCreatureAttack` |
| `OtherCreaturesCantAttackThisTurnEffect` | `()` | SPELL one-shot rider (Intimidation Bolt "Other creatures can't attack this turn"). Appends the accompanying spell's creature target (`entry.getTargetId()`) to the turn-scoped `GameData.otherCreaturesCantAttackExemptCreatureIds`; `CombatAttackService.canCreatureAttack` lets a creature attack only if its ID equals EVERY exemption � so only the targeted survivor may attack, a dead target locks everyone, and creatures entering later are barred too. Untargeted itself (reads the damage effect's target), so `targetSpec()` stays `NONE`; pair with `DealDamageToTargetCreatureEffect(N)`. Cleared at each turn transition |
| `CreaturesCantAttackThisTurnEffect` | `()` | SPELL one-shot global restriction: no creature can attack for the rest of the turn, including creatures entering after resolution. Sets `GameData.creaturesCantAttackThisTurn`; `AttackLegalityService` checks it during attacker declaration and `TurnCleanupService` clears it |
| `PeaceTalksEffect` | `()` | SPELL one-shot (Peace Talks). Sets `GameData.peaceTalksTurnsRemaining` to at least 2 (this turn + next); decremented in `TurnProgressionService.advanceTurn`; active while `> 0`. Creatures can't attack (`AttackLegalityService`); players and permanents can't be targets of spells or activated abilities (`TargetLegalityService` / `ValidTargetService`) — triggered abilities unaffected. Untargeted (`targetSpec()` `NONE`) |
| `CantBlockEffect` | `()` | this creature can't block (static) |
| `CantBlockThisCombatEffect` | `()` | targeted creature can't block any creature for the current combat; handler sets the combat-scoped marker cleared by `Permanent.clearCombatState()` |
| `CantBlockUnlessEffect` | `(Condition condition, String requirementDescription)` | static: this creature can't block unless `condition` is met (Marauding Boneslasher: `new ControlsOtherPermanentCount(1, new PermanentHasSubtypePredicate(ZOMBIE))`, "you control another Zombie"). The block-only counterpart of `CantAttackUnlessEffect` and the block half of `CantAttackOrBlockUnlessEffect`. `BlockingRestrictionEffect` facet `cantBlockUnless()`; evaluated in `GameQueryService.canBlock` (via `isCantBlockUnlessConditionUnmet`) relative to the source's controller. Does NOT restrict attacking |
| `TargetPlayerChoosesCreatureRestCantBlockEffect` | `()` | SPELL, player-targeting spec: the targeted player chooses one creature they control to keep able to block; every OTHER creature they control can't block this turn (sets `Permanent.cantBlockThisTurn`). Presents a `MultiPermanentChoiceContext.ChooseCreatureRestCantBlock` to the target player (count 1); 0-1 creatures ? no choice, resolves harmlessly. Pair with a `PlayerPredicateTargetFilter(OPPONENT)`. Used by Goblin War Cry |
| `TargetPlayerChoosesCreaturesToAttackNextTurnEffect` | `()` | player-targeting spec: the targeted player chooses **any number** of creatures they control (`MultiPermanentChoiceContext.ChooseCreaturesToAttackNextTurn`, max = all their creatures). The chosen set — possibly empty — is stored in `GameData.chosenAttackersNextTurn`; `TurnProgressionService.advanceTurn` promotes it to `chosenAttackersThisTurn` when that player's turn begins and queues one `DestroyPermanentIfDidNotAttackAtEndStep` per chosen creature. During that turn `AttackLegalityService` bars every creature outside the set (`isOutsideChosenAttackers`) and counts one must-attack requirement for every creature inside it, so an empty choice locks combat down entirely. With no creatures to choose the empty set is registered without a prompt. Pair with a `PlayerPredicateTargetFilter(OPPONENT)`. Used by Oracle en-Vec |
| `CantBlockCreaturesWithPowerGreaterOrEqualToOwnToughnessEffect` | `()` | static self-referential restriction (Ironclaw Curse): this creature can't block an attacker whose effective power ?A its own effective toughness. `BlockingRestrictionEffect` facet `cantBlockCreaturesWithPowerAtLeastOwnToughness()`; comparison resolved in `GameQueryService.findBlockDenial`, recognized on the blocker's own STATIC effects or via an attached aura |
| `CantBlockCreaturesWithPowerAtLeastEffect` | `(int minAttackerPower)` | static hard fixed-threshold restriction (Ironclaw Orcs, `(2)`): this creature can't block an attacker whose effective power ?A `minAttackerPower`. No cost, not self-referential. `BlockingRestrictionEffect` facet `cantBlockCreaturesWithPowerAtLeast()`; resolved in `GameQueryService.findBlockDenial` against the attacker's effective power |
| `CantBlockSourceEffect` | `(UUID sourcePermanentId)` | target creature can't block source permanent |
| `MatchingCreaturesCantBlockMatchingCreaturesEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate blockerPredicate, PermanentPredicate attackerPredicate, String description)` | global static: while the source is on the battlefield, any creature matching `blockerPredicate` can't block any creature matching `attackerPredicate`, board-wide (Boldwyr Intimidator "Cowards can't block Warriors"). Both predicates are evaluated with the imposing permanent's `FilterContext` (source controller + source card), so either side may be controller-relative: `PermanentControlledBySourceControllerPredicate` as the attacker predicate gives "creatures with flying can't block creatures you control" (Bower Passage). Evaluated in `BlockLegalityService.findBlockDenial` |
| `MatchingCreaturesCantBlockMatchingCreaturesUnlessPaysLifeEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate blockerPredicate, PermanentPredicate attackerPredicate, int lifePerBlocker, String description)` | global static life-tax counterpart of the hard deny above (Heat Wave): matching blockers can't block matching attackers unless the blocker's controller pays `lifePerBlocker` life for each such unique blocking creature. `GlobalBlockLifeCostEffect`; charged in `CombatBlockService.declareBlockers` via `GameQueryService.getGlobalBlockLifeTax`. The block stays legal for targeting — only the life cost gates it |
| `MatchingCreaturesCantAttackOrBlockEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate affectedPredicate, String description)` | global static: while the source is on the battlefield, any creature matching `affectedPredicate` can't attack OR block, board-wide. `affectedPredicate` is evaluated relative to the source's controller (`sourceControllerId`/`sourceCardId` supplied), so `PermanentControlledBySourceControllerPredicate` etc. resolve "you"/"your opponents". Kulrath Knight "Creatures your opponents control with counters on them can't attack or block" = `PermanentAllOfPredicate(PermanentNotPredicate(PermanentControlledBySourceControllerPredicate()), PermanentHasCountersPredicate(ANY))`; Light of Day "Black creatures can't attack or block" = `PermanentColorInPredicate(BLACK)`. Attack side in `CombatAttackService.isCantAttackDueToGlobalRestriction`; block side in `GameQueryService.canBlock`/`buildBlockerFacts` |
| `TargetCreatureBecomesSubtypeUntilEndOfTurnEffect` | `(CardSubtype subtype)` | target creature **becomes** the creature type until end of turn, **replacing** all its other creature types (Boldwyr Intimidator). Sets `Permanent.transientCreatureTypeOverride`, read by the layered pass; contrast additive/permanent `GrantSubtypeToTargetCreatureEffect` |
| `TargetCreatureBecomesChosenSubtypeUntilEndOfTurnEffect` | `()` | at resolution, choose a creature type other than Wall, then target creature becomes that type until end of turn, replacing all its other creature types (Unnatural Selection) |
| `SourceBecomesSubtypeUntilEndOfTurnEffect` | `(CardSubtype subtype)` or `(List<CardSubtype> subtypes)` | self analog (no target): the **source** permanent becomes the creature type(s) until end of turn, **replacing** all its other creature types (Paragon of the Amesha). Sets the source's transient creature type override; pair with `BoostSelfEffect` + `GrantKeywordEffect(GrantScope.SELF)` for a full self-transform ability |
| `CanBeBlockedOnlyByFilterEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate blockerPredicate, String allowedBlockersDescription)` | can only be blocked by matching creatures (static; also stored transiently on a `Permanent` for until-end-of-turn grants) |
| `CantBeBlockedByCreaturesMatchingPredicateEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate blockerPredicate)` or `(blockerPredicate, onlyIfDefenderControls)` | negative evasion: this creature can't be blocked by blockers matching the predicate (static, validated in `GameQueryService.getBlockingIllegalityReason`). Optional `onlyIfDefenderControls` gates the restriction (Arctic Foxes: power ?A2 only while defender controls a snow land). Taoist Mystic = `PermanentHasKeywordPredicate(HORSEMANSHIP)`. On an Aura (Black Scarab), put the effect directly in STATIC � `getAuraGrantedBlockingRestrictions` collects any Aura `BlockabilityRestrictionEffect` with `blockableOnlyBy` or `cantBeBlockedByCreaturesMatching` onto the enchanted attacker |
