Read via the `Predicate<CardEffect>` overload of `GameQueryService.hasAuraWithEffect` so the caller also inspects the relevant flag: `AttackLegalityService.canAttack` reads `preventsAttacking`, `BlockLegalityService.hasUnmetBlockRequirement` reads `preventsBlocking`; no handler |
| `EnchantedCreatureCantCrewEffect` | `()` | Aura static: the enchanted creature can't be tapped to pay a Vehicle's crew cost. `CrewCostHandler` excludes it from legal choices and rechecks the restriction when paying; no handler |
| `EnchantedCreatureCantTransformEffect` | `()` | enchanted creature can't transform (static Aura marker; `GameQueryService.isTransformPrevented` via `hasAuraWithEffect`). Bound by Moonsilver |
| `EnchantedCreatureCantAttackOrBlockAloneEffect` | `(boolean restrictsBlocking)` | enchanted creature can't attack alone, and optionally can't block alone; declaration-time Aura restriction |
| `EnchantedPermanentConditionalEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate filter, CardEffect ifMatch, CardEffect ifNotMatch)` | conditional wrapper for aura static effects: if the enchanted permanent matches the predicate, `ifMatch` is active; otherwise `ifNotMatch` is active. Only applies while the source aura is attached to the target permanent. Composes existing effects (e.g. `StaticBoostEffect` + `EnchantedCreatureCantAttackOrBlockEffect`). Static handler delegates to the active inner effect's handler and evaluates predicates with `matchesStaticFilter(...)`; combat system unwraps automatically via `hasAuraWithEffect`. Use `PermanentHasSubtypePredicate(...)` for subtype cases. |
| `CanAttackAsThoughHasteUnlessEnteredThisTurnEffect` | `()` | STATIC self-scoped: this creature can attack as though it had haste, unless it entered the battlefield this turn (Chaos Lord). Attack-only summoning-sickness bypass (no `{T}` activation), read in `AttackLegalityService.canAttack`; the "entered this turn" check scans `GameData.permanentsEnteredBattlefieldThisTurn`, which control changes do not touch � so the creature can attack the turn it changes controller |
| `EnchantedCreatureCanAttackAsThoughHasteEffect` | `()` | enchanted creature can attack as though it had haste (attack-only summoning-sickness bypass, static, Instill Energy-style; read in `CombatAttackService.canCreatureAttack` via `hasAuraWithEffect`). Does NOT lift summoning sickness for `{T}` ability activation � that's why it isn't `GrantKeywordEffect(HASTE, ENCHANTED)` |
| `EnchantedCreatureCanOnlyAttackAloneEffect` | `()` | enchanted creature can be declared as an attacker only if it is the sole attacker (static, Errantry-style; validated at declaration time in CombatAttackService � the mirror of `CantAttackOrBlockAloneEffect`) |
| `CanOnlyAttackAloneEffect` | `()` | STATIC self-only "this creature can only attack alone" (Master of Cruelties): the creature can be declared as an attacker only if it is the sole attacker. Checked off the creature's own STATIC effects in `CombatAttackService.validateCanOnlyAttackAlone`, alongside the Aura-scoped `EnchantedCreatureCanOnlyAttackAloneEffect` |
| `EnchantedCreatureCantActivateAbilitiesEffect` | `()` | enchanted creature's activated abilities can't be activated (static, Arrest-style) |
| `IgnoreSourceAuraEffectsUntilEndOfTurnEffect` | `()` | NORMAL: the source Aura's static effects are ignored until end of turn (Volrath's Curse "for that player to ignore this effect until end of turn"). Resolution flags the source permanent `auraEffectsIgnoredThisTurn`; `GameQueryService.hasAuraWithEffect` skips such an Aura entirely, which is the single lookup behind the enchanted-creature attack (`AttackLegalityService`), block (`BlockLegalityService`) and activated-ability (`AbilityActivationService`) restrictions. Cleared by `Permanent.resetModifiers()` at end of turn. Pair with a `SacrificePermanentCost` ability flagged `.withActivatableByAnyPlayer().withActivatableOnlyByEnchantedPermanentController()` |
| `IgnoreSourceDampingEngineEffectUntilEndOfTurnEffect` | `()` | NORMAL: marks the source Damping Engine restriction ignored until end of turn. Cleared by `Permanent.resetModifiers()` |
| `EnchantedCreatureCantActivateTapAbilitiesEffect` | `()` | enchanted creature's activated abilities with `{T}` in their costs can't be activated — non-tap abilities stay usable (static, Serra Bestiary). Enforced in `AbilityActivationService` on the mana-tap and `isRequiresTap()` paths via `GameQueryService.isLockedFromActivatingTapAbilities` |
| `EnchantedPlayerCantActivateNonManaNonLoyaltyAbilitiesEffect` | `()` | static on a Curse Aura enchanting a player: that player can activate only mana abilities (CR 605.1a) and loyalty abilities � every other activated ability (battlefield/graveyard/hand) is blocked (Overwhelming Splendor). Detected via `GameQueryService.playerCantActivateNonManaOrLoyaltyAbilities`; enforced at each activation entry point in `AbilityActivationService`. Pair with `LosesAllAbilitiesEffect(ENCHANTED_PLAYER_CREATURES)` + `SetBasePowerToughnessEffect(1, 1, ENCHANTED_PLAYER_CREATURES)` for the full card |
| `MatchingPermanentsCantActivateTapAbilitiesEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate affectedPredicate)` | board-wide sibling of `EnchantedCreatureCantActivateTapAbilitiesEffect`: while the source is on the battlefield, activated abilities with `{T}` in their costs of permanents matching `affectedPredicate` can't be activated (non-tap abilities stay usable). Katabatic Winds (`PermanentHasKeywordPredicate(FLYING)`). Enforced via `GameQueryService.isLockedFromActivatingTapAbilities` |
| `LockTargetPermanentEffect` | `(boolean locksAttacking, boolean locksBlocking, boolean locksActivatedAbilities, EffectDuration duration)` | resolved (non-static) targeted lock: stamps a `FloatingContinuousEffect` carrying the `PermanentLockEffect` facts onto the target creature. Attack side read in `CombatAttackService.canCreatureAttack`, block side in `GameQueryService.findBlockDenial`, activation side in `AbilityActivationService.validateNotBlockedByStaticAbilityLock` (mana abilities included; triggered abilities unaffected). Duration drives expiry (`UNTIL_END_OF_TURN` = cleanup, `UNTIL_YOUR_NEXT_TURN` = ability controller's next turn start). Edifice of Authority: `(true,false,false,UNTIL_END_OF_TURN)` = "can't attack this turn"; `(true,true,true,UNTIL_YOUR_NEXT_TURN)` = Detain. Targeted `harmful(CREATURE)`. |
| `LockMatchingPermanentsEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate predicate, boolean locksAttacking, boolean locksBlocking, boolean locksActivatedAbilities, EffectDuration duration)` | non-targeted mass sibling of `LockTargetPermanentEffect`: scans every battlefield and stamps one floating `LockTargetPermanentEffect` per permanent matching `predicate`, so the same readers and duration expiry apply. `FilterContext` carries the source card and controller, so controller-relative predicates (`PermanentControlledBySourceControllerPredicate`) work. Lavinia of the Tenth: "detain each nonland permanent your opponents control with mana value 4 or less". |
| `ControlledCreaturesCanBlockAsThoughUntappedEffect` | `()` | `TappedBlockPermissionEffect`; STATIC — tapped creatures you control can block as though they were untapped. Returns `PermanentControlledBySourceControllerPredicate` from `tappedBlockMatcher()`, which `BlockLegalityService` evaluates relative to the permanent carrying the effect, so the permission follows control changes rather than sticking to the original controller. Masako the Humorless |

| `AttackWithoutTappingPermissionEffect` | `allowsAttackingWithoutTapping()` | floating combat permission: while the effect's source is untapped, creatures controlled by the effect controller do not tap as part of attacking. Read during attacker declaration. Johan |

## Tap / untap

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `TapTargetThenUntapAnotherTargetEffect` | `()` | "Tap target permanent, then untap another target permanent." (Ral Zarek +1). Two-position multi-target: `targetIds.get(0)` is tapped, `targetIds.get(1)` is untapped; declare two permanent filters with `minTargets = maxTargets = 2` (the multi-target path already rejects duplicate targets, which is exactly what "another" requires). Each target is looked up independently at resolution, so one having left the battlefield does not stop the other half |
| `TapAndLockOtherPermanentsEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate filter)` | stack-resolution effect that taps every permanent matching `filter` except the source, and records a source-tapped untap lock on each one (Kill Switch). |
| `TapPermanentsEffect` | `(TapUntapScope scope[, PermanentPredicate filter])` | taps permanent(s) as an effect (fires "becomes tapped" triggers). Scope axis (see `TapUntapScope`): `TARGET` (tap target, with mixed multi-target-group handling), `SELF` (tap the source, works even if already tapped), `ENCHANTED` (tap the aura's attached creature), `TARGET_PLAYERS_PERMANENTS` (targets a player, taps their permanents matching `filter`), `ALL_CREATURES` (every battlefield's creatures matching `filter` � e.g. `Not(HasKeyword(FLYING))` for Deluge, `PermanentIsAttackingPredicate` for Clinging Mists). Replaces the former Tap{Target,Self,EnchantedCreature,PermanentsOfTargetPlayer,AllAttackingCreatures,Creatures} records |
| `UntapPermanentsEffect` | `(TapUntapScope scope[, PermanentPredicate filter[, int chosenCount]])` | untaps permanent(s) as an effect (no triggers). Scope axis: `TARGET` (untap target; `filter` acts as targeting restriction via the spec predicate, e.g. `PermanentIsArtifactPredicate` for Voltaic Servant), `ALL_TARGETS` (multi-target, iterates `getTargetIds()`), `SELF`, `SOURCE_PERMANENT`, `ENCHANTED` (untap the permanent the source Aura/Equipment is attached to — Thornbite Staff's `ON_ANY_CREATURE_DIES` untap, Paralyze / Dance of the Dead's pay-to-untap upkeep trigger; fizzles if unattached), `CONTROLLED` (untap all permanents you control matching `filter`, e.g. `PermanentIsLandPredicate`), `OTHER_CONTROLLED_CREATURES` (untap each other creature you control matching `filter`; excludes source by permanent id), `TARGET_PLAYERS_PERMANENTS`, `ALL_CREATURES`, `ATTACKED_CREATURES` (untap creatures that attacked this turn), `ALL_PERMANENTS` (untap every permanent on every battlefield matching `filter`, any type — Llanowar Druid: "Untap all Forests"). With `CONTROLLED` or `ALL_PERMANENTS`, a positive `chosenCount` switches to "untap **up to** N matching permanents" — the controller picks at resolution via `MultiPermanentChoiceContext.UntapChosenPermanents` and picking none is legal (Rewind `(CONTROLLED, PermanentIsLandPredicate, 4)`, Unwind `3`, Treachery `(ALL_PERMANENTS, PermanentIsLandPredicate, 5)`); 0 (the default) untaps every match. Mirrors `TapPermanentsEffect.chosenCount`. Replaces the former Untap{Target,AllTarget,Self,AllControlled,EachOtherCreatureYouControl,AttackedCreatures,EquippedCreature,UpToControlledPermanents} records |
| `TapPermanentsForAmountEffect` | `(DynamicAmount amount, PermanentPredicate filter)` | taps matching untapped permanents up to a dynamic amount; if more matches are available, the affected player chooses exactly the required number through `MultiPermanentChoiceContext.TapPermanentsForAmount`. The amount uses the source permanent or its last-known snapshot, making it suitable for counter-based upkeep abilities such as Tangle Wire |
| `UntapPermanentsEffect` | `(TapUntapScope scope[, PermanentPredicate filter[, int chosenCount]])` | untaps permanent(s) as an effect (no triggers). Scope axis: `TARGET` (untap target; `filter` acts as targeting restriction via the spec predicate, e.g. `PermanentIsArtifactPredicate` for Voltaic Servant), `ALL_TARGETS` (multi-target, iterates `getTargetIds()`), `SELF`, `SOURCE_PERMANENT`, `ENCHANTED` (untap the permanent the source Aura/Equipment is attached to — Thornbite Staff's `ON_ANY_CREATURE_DIES` untap, Paralyze / Dance of the Dead's pay-to-untap upkeep trigger; fizzles if unattached), `CONTROLLED` (untap all permanents you control matching `filter`, e.g. `PermanentIsLandPredicate`), `OTHER_CONTROLLED_CREATURES` (untap each other creature you control matching `filter`; excludes source by permanent id), `TARGET_PLAYERS_PERMANENTS`, `ALL_CREATURES`, `ATTACKED_CREATURES` (untap creatures that attacked this turn), `ALL_PERMANENTS` (untap every permanent on every battlefield matching `filter`, any type — Llanowar Druid: "Untap all Forests"). With `CONTROLLED`, a positive `chosenCount` switches to "untap **up to** N permanents you control" — the controller picks at resolution via `MultiPermanentChoiceContext.UntapChosenPermanents` and picking none is legal (Rewind `(CONTROLLED, PermanentIsLandPredicate, 4)`, Unwind `3`); 0 (the default) untaps every match. Mirrors `TapPermanentsEffect.chosenCount`. Replaces the former Untap{Target,AllTarget,Self,AllControlled,EachOtherCreatureYouControl,AttackedCreatures,EquippedCreature,UpToControlledPermanents} records |
| `TapPlayersPermanentsAndDamageEqualToCountEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate filter)` | `END_STEP_TRIGGERED` only: taps every untapped permanent matching `filter` that the end-step player controls, then deals that player damage equal to the number tapped this way (Monsoon, `PermanentHasSubtypePredicate(ISLAND)`). Non-targeted � implements the `EndStepPlayerTargetedEffect` marker, which makes `StepTriggerService`'s generic end-step branch bake the end-step (active) player into `targetId`. Already-tapped permanents are neither tapped nor counted; damage goes through the normal source-prevention/multiplier path |
| `TapOrUntapTargetPermanentEffect` | `()` | tap or untap target permanent (controller's choice). Multi-target aware: the handler iterates `entry.targetsForEffect(effect)`, so leaving one instance **unbound** (a bare `addEffect(...)`, not chained off `target(...)`) makes it toggle every target group — Hidden Strings' "target permanent, then … another target permanent" |
| `RemoveTargetFromCombatEffect` | `()` | removes target permanent from combat (clears attacking/blocking state); combine with `UntapPermanentsEffect(TapUntapScope.TARGET)` for Maze of Ith / Spires of Orazca style effects |
| `RemoveSourceFromCombatEffect` | `()` | removes the stack entry's source permanent from combat (clears attacking/blocking state); non-targeting source-relative sibling for self-referential triggers such as Mijae Djinn |
| `RemoveSelfFromCombatEffect` | `()` | removes the source permanent from combat without targeting it (clears attacking/blocking state); use inside an optional sequence such as Gustcloak Cavalier's becomes-blocked trigger |
| `SwapExclusiveBlockersBetweenTwoBlockedAttackersEffect` | `()` | General Jarkeld: two target blocked attackers; if each could be blocked by all creatures blocking the other, exclusive blockers (blocking exactly one of them) swap. Shared blockers unchanged. No re-fire of block/become-blocked triggers. Multi-target activated ability + `ONLY_DURING_DECLARE_BLOCKERS` |
| `SwapBlockingAssignmentsBetweenTwoCreaturesEffect` | `()` | Sorrow's Path: two target blocking creatures controlled by the same opponent; if each could block all creatures the other is blocking, replace both blocking assignments with the other's group. Rechecks blocking legality and blocker capacity and does not re-fire block triggers. Multi-target activated ability |
| `DoesntUntapEffect` | build via static factories (raw ctor is `(TapUntapScope scope, UntapLockCondition condition)`, validated so scope-condition pairings are legal): `DoesntUntapEffect.self()`, `.enchanted()`, `.targetWhileSourceOnBattlefield()`, `.targetWhileSourceTapped()` | permanent doesn't untap during its controller's untap step. Reuses the `TapUntapScope` enum. Factories: `self()` = `SELF`+`ALWAYS` (this permanent never untaps � a continuous static effect in `EffectSlot.STATIC`; Colossus of Sardia, Traxos, Grimgrin, Elaborate Firecannon), `enchanted()` = `ENCHANTED`+`ALWAYS` (the attached aura/equipment's host never untaps � STATIC on the aura, read via aura lookup; Claustrophobia, Dehydration, Numbing Dose, Heavy Arbalest), `targetWhileSourceOnBattlefield()` = `TARGET`+`WHILE_SOURCE_ON_BATTLEFIELD` (target doesn't untap while the source stays on the battlefield � resolved on the stack, uses `untapPreventedWhileSourceOnBattlefieldIds`; Dungeon Geists, Time of Ice), `targetWhileSourceTapped()` = `TARGET`+`WHILE_SOURCE_TAPPED` (target doesn't untap while the source stays tapped � uses `untapPreventedByPermanentIds`; Rust Tick). The `TARGET` variants declare no targeting flags � they piggyback on a companion `TapPermanentsEffect(TapUntapScope.TARGET)` (or a saga-chapter/ability target filter) on the same slot |
| `MayNotUntapDuringUntapStepEffect` | `()` | controller may choose not to untap this permanent during untap step (static); prompts player via may-ability system |
| `PayManaPerTappedCreatureToUntapEffect` | `(int manaPerCreature, PermanentPredicate creatureFilter)` | `EACH_UPKEEP_TRIGGERED` (Magnetic Mountain): "that player may choose any number of tapped [matching] creatures they control and pay {manaPerCreature} for each creature chosen this way. If the player does, untap those." Acting player = the stack entry's `targetId` (the active player). The handler gathers that player's tapped permanents matching `creatureFilter`, caps the count by what they can afford (`pool.getTotal() / manaPerCreature`), and begins a `MultiPermanentChoice` (`MultiPermanentChoiceContext.PayManaPerCreatureUntap`). When answered, `MultiPermanentChoiceHandlerService` pays `manaPerCreature`A?chosen generic from that player's pool and untaps the chosen creatures (via `TapUntapSupport.untapPermanent`, firing becomes-untapped triggers); empty selection = untap none. Pair with STATIC `MatchingPermanentsDoesntUntapEffect(sameFilter)` for the untap lock |
| `StaticOrbEffect` | `(maxUntap, filter, requiresUntappedSource)` | global "can't untap more than N [matching] permanents during untap steps" lock (Static Orb `()`=cap 2/all/while-untapped; Stoic Angel and Smoke `(1, PermanentIsCreaturePredicate, false)`=cap 1/creatures/always; Winter Orb `(1, PermanentIsLandPredicate, true)`=cap 1/lands/while-untapped). `TurnProgressionService.advanceTurn` pauses the untap step when `UntapStepService.bindingUntapRestriction` finds an active carrier whose filtered candidate pool exceeds `maxUntap`, and begins a `MultiPermanentChoice` (`MultiPermanentChoiceContext.StaticOrbUntap`, maxCount `maxUntap`) over the matching candidates; the answer resumes via `resumeStaticOrbUntap` � `untapChosenPermanents`, so only the chosen matching permanents untap while permanents the filter excludes untap normally. No card-side targeting |
| `SkipNextUntapEffect` | `(TapUntapScope scope, PermanentPredicate filter)` or `(TapUntapScope scope)` | one-shot "doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step"; increments `skipUntapCount` (decremented each untap step) on the scoped permanent(s). Scopes: `TARGET` (the entry's target � piggybacks on companion targeting effect e.g. `TapPermanentsEffect(TapUntapScope.TARGET)`, permanent-targeting spec; Frost Titan / Watertrap Weaver / Wall of Frost / Deluge Virtuoso), `SELF` (the source permanent itself � no targeting; use on a self-referential trigger like `ON_ATTACK`; Lead Golem � also the exert-as-activated-cost pattern; when paired with a mana producer the `SELF` rider applies inline in `ActivatedAbilityExecutionService.doResolveManaAbility`, Oasis Ritualist), `ENCHANTED` (the permanent the source Aura/Equipment is attached to, read at resolution � no targeting; "Whenever equipped creature attacks, it doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step", Stitcher's Graft on `ON_ATTACK`), `TARGET_PLAYERS_PERMANENTS` (permanents matching `filter` that the target player controls, player-targeting spec; Sleep = `PermanentIsCreaturePredicate`), `ALL_CREATURES` (every creature matching `filter` across all battlefields; Clinging Mists = `PermanentIsAttackingPredicate`, pair with `TapPermanentsEffect(TapUntapScope.ALL_CREATURES, new PermanentIsAttackingPredicate())`). Reuses the `TapUntapScope` enum |
| `SkipNextUntapEffect` | `(TapUntapScope scope, PermanentPredicate filter)` or `(TapUntapScope scope)` | one-shot "doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step"; increments `skipUntapCount` (decremented each untap step) on the scoped permanent(s). Scopes: `TARGET` (the entry's target � piggybacks on companion targeting effect e.g. `TapPermanentsEffect(TapUntapScope.TARGET)`, `canTargetPermanent()`; Frost Titan / Watertrap Weaver / Wall of Frost / Deluge Virtuoso), `SELF` (the source permanent itself � no targeting; use on a self-referential trigger like `ON_ATTACK`; Lead Golem), `TARGET_PLAYERS_PERMANENTS` (permanents matching `filter` that the target player controls, `canTargetPlayer()`; Sleep = `PermanentIsCreaturePredicate`), `ALL_CREATURES` (every creature matching `filter` across all battlefields; Clinging Mists = `PermanentIsAttackingPredicate`, pair with `TapPermanentsEffect(TapUntapScope.ALL_CREATURES, new PermanentIsAttackingPredicate())`). Reuses the `TapUntapScope` enum |
| `IfWonClashEffect` | `(CardEffect wrapped)` | clash-only marker for the "If you won, ..." clause on `EffectSlot.ON_CONTROLLER_CLASHES`. Not a stack effect � `TriggerCollectionService.fireClashTriggers` includes the wrapped effect in the trigger's resolved effect list only when the controller won the clash (winner fixed at trigger time). Targeting delegates to `wrapped`. Clash itself is a 2-player action performed by `performClash` (both reveal top card, strictly-higher mana value wins). `ON_CONTROLLER_CLASHES` triggers are inert until a card *initiates* a clash (see `ClashEffect`). See Entangling Trap: `TapPermanentsEffect(TARGET)` + `IfWonClashEffect(SkipNextUntapEffect(TARGET))` |
| `IfLostClashEffect` | `(CardEffect wrapped)` | mirror of `IfWonClashEffect` on `EffectSlot.ON_CONTROLLER_CLASHES`: `fireClashTriggers` includes the wrapped effect only when the controller did **not** win (loss or tie). Pair a won-variant (`IfWonClashEffect`) with a lost-variant when the clash trigger does the same base thing either way but only a detail differs by outcome, so exactly one branch fires. See Rebellion of the Flamekin: two `MayPayManaEffect("{1}", CreateTokenEffect(3/1 Elemental Shaman �))` entries that differ only in `grantedKeywordsUntilEndOfTurn = HASTE` on the won branch. Non-targeting, so the trigger goes straight onto the stack |
| `ClashEffect` | `(List<CardEffect> beforeClash, CardEffect onWin, boolean repeatWhileWinning)`; convenience `(CardEffect onWin)` = `(List.of(), onWin, false)` | the clash-*source* stack effect. Each iteration the handler dispatches the `beforeClash` effects (via their own handlers, against the same entry), calls `TriggerCollectionService.performClash` for the controller, on a win dispatches `onWin` against the same stack entry (so it acts on the source permanent), and with `repeatWhileWinning` repeats the whole sequence until the first lost clash (deck-out counts as a loss). "Clash with an opponent. If you win, [X]" = `ClashEffect(X)` (`onWin` may be null for a bare clash); "[body], then clash with an opponent. If you win, repeat this process" = `ClashEffect(body, null, true)`. Mirrors `FlipCoinWinEffect`. See Oaken Brawler: `ClashEffect(new PutCountersOnSourceEffect(1, 1, 1))`; Hoarder's Greed: `ClashEffect(List.of(new LoseLifeEffect(2), new DrawCardEffect(2)), null, true)`. Delegates its `targetSpec()` to `onWin`/`beforeClash`, so a targeted win reward works on a targeting slot � Springjack Knight: `ON_ATTACK` `ClashEffect(new GrantKeywordEffect(Keyword.DOUBLE_STRIKE, GrantScope.TARGET))` (target chosen when the trigger goes on the stack) |
| `UntapAllPermanentsYouControlDuringEachOtherPlayersStepEffect` | `(TurnStep step)` or `(TurnStep step, PermanentPredicate filter)` | untap permanents you control during each other player's step. `filter=null` (1-arg form) untaps all; provide a predicate (e.g. `PermanentIsArtifactPredicate`) to untap only matching permanents |
| `UntapChosenPermanentEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate predicate)` | "untap target [permanent]" for a triggered ability on a slot with **no targeting pipeline** (e.g. `ON_COMBAT_DAMAGE_TO_PLAYER`). The effect is pushed non-targeting; at resolution `UntapChosenPermanentEffectHandler` collects every permanent matching `predicate` across all battlefields and begins a `MultiPermanentChoiceContext.UntapChosenPermanent` (maxCount 1) � the controller's chosen permanent is untapped when answered. Use instead of `UntapPermanentsEffect(TARGET)` when the trigger slot can't carry a cast-time target. Initiate's Companion: `PermanentAnyOfPredicate(creature, land)` |
| `TapChosenPermanentEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate predicate, boolean preventUntapWhileSourceTapped)` | "tap target [permanent]" for a triggered ability on a slot with **no targeting pipeline** (`ON_DAMAGE_TO_PLAYER`). `TapChosenPermanentEffectHandler` collects every matching permanent across all battlefields and begins a `MultiPermanentChoiceContext.TapChosenPermanent` (maxCount 1); the chosen permanent is tapped when answered and, when `preventUntapWhileSourceTapped`, added to the source's `untapPreventedByPermanentIds` untap lock. `damagedPlayerControlsAndSkipsNextUntap(predicate)` restricts the candidates to the damaged player's battlefield and increments the chosen permanent's `skipUntapCount`. Implements `CombatDamageTriggerContextEffect` so the damaged player and source permanent reach the handler. Thalakos Dreamsower and Mana Skimmer |
| `RegisterDelayedUntapPermanentsEffect` | `(int count, PermanentPredicate filter)` | registers a delayed trigger that fires at the beginning of the next end step, putting an `UntapPermanentsEffect(TapUntapScope.CONTROLLED, filter, count)` on the stack. Used by Teferi, Hero of Dominaria +1 with `PermanentIsLandPredicate` |
| `RegisterDelayedCreateTokenEffect` | `(CreateTokenEffect tokenEffect)` | registers a delayed trigger that fires at the beginning of the next end step, putting the wrapped `tokenEffect` on the stack so the token(s) are created under the resolving controller's control. Stored in `GameData.delayedActions` (`DelayedCreateToken`), drained in `StepTriggerService.handleEndStepTriggers`. Used by Rukh Egg's ON_DEATH trigger |
| `RegisterDrawCardsAtNextEndStepEffect` | `(int count)` / `()` = 1 | `CardDrawingEffect`; registers a `DrawCardsAtNextEndStep` delayed action so the resolving controller draws `count` cards at the beginning of the next end step. `triggeringPlayer()` instead registers the draw for the player carried on the trigger's `targetId`. Drained in `StepTriggerService.handleEndStepTriggers`. Used by Horn of Plenty |
| `RegisterExileCardsFromOwnGraveyardAtNextEndStepEffect` | `(int count)` | registers an `ExileCardsFromOwnGraveyardAtNextEndStep` delayed action so the resolving controller exiles `count` cards from their graveyard at the beginning of the next end step. The delayed trigger resolves `ExileGraveyardCardsEffect(OWN)`, which auto-exiles fewer available cards and otherwise uses sequential graveyard choices. Used by False Memories |
| `RegisterDrawCardsAtNextUpkeepEffect` | `(int count)` | `CardDrawingEffect`; registers a `DrawCardsAtNextUpkeep` delayed action so the resolving controller draws `count` cards at the beginning of the next turn's upkeep. Drained in `StepTriggerService.handleUpkeepTriggers` regardless of active player. No-arg `()` = 1. `RegisterDrawCardsAtNextUpkeepEffect.targetPlayer(count)` (`recipient=TARGET_PLAYER`) instead registers the draw for the **targeted** player and declares a benign `PLAYER` spec � "Target player draws a card at the beginning of the next turn's upkeep" (Sapphire Charm). `RegisterDrawCardsAtNextUpkeepEffect.targetSpellControllerMayDrawUpTo(count)` (`recipient=TARGET_SPELL_CONTROLLER`, `upTo=true`) registers an optional up-to-`count` draw for the controller of the spell targeted by this stack entry � read off the stack, so it must resolve before any accompanying `CounterSpellEffect` (Arcane Denial). `RegisterDrawCardsAtNextUpkeepEffect.targetGraveyardOwner(count)` (`recipient=TARGET_GRAVEYARD_OWNER`) registers the draw for the owner of the graveyard holding this entry's `targetCardIds` � "that player draws a card at the beginning of the next turn's upkeep" (Lodestone Bauble); read out of the graveyards, so it must be listed **before** the effect that moves those cards, and with no graveyard targets nobody draws. Used by Blessed Wine, Sapphire Charm, Arcane Denial, Lodestone Bauble |
| `RegisterDelayedLoseLifeAndReturnFromGraveyardToHandEffect` | `(int lifeLoss)` | registers a delayed trigger that fires at the beginning of the next end step, putting `LoseLifeEffect(lifeLoss)` + self `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect` (HAND) on the stack as one ability. Life loss still happens if the card left the graveyard. Stored as `DelayedLoseLifeAndReturnFromGraveyard`, drained in `StepTriggerService.handleEndStepTriggers`. Used by Brood of Cockroaches |
| `DrawUpToNCardsEffect` | `(int max)` | `CardDrawingEffect`; the resolving controller chooses 0..`max` through a `PendingInteraction.XValueChoice` and draws that many. Pushed as a delayed triggered ability by `StepTriggerService.handleUpkeepTriggers` for a `DrawCardsAtNextUpkeep` with `upTo=true` (Arcane Denial) |
| `MakeTargetAttackingCreatureBlockedEffect` | `()` | "Target unblocked attacking creature becomes blocked" (CR 509.1h). Harmful, targets via `TargetFilters.unblockedAttackingCreature()` (`PermanentIsUnblockedAttackingPredicate`) and works on creatures that can't be blocked. `MakeTargetAttackingCreatureBlockedEffectHandler` sets `Permanent.blockedWithoutBlockers`, so `PermanentIsBlockedPredicate` matches it and `CombatDamageService` gives it nothing to assign combat damage to (CR 510.1c � it deals none). Then calls `CombatBlockService.fireBecomesBlockedTriggersWithoutBlockers`, which fires the non-PER_BLOCKER `ON_BECOMES_BLOCKED` registrations, aura/equipment becomes-blocked triggers and `ON_ALLY_CREATURE_BECOMES_BLOCKED`; PER_BLOCKER registrations are skipped since there is no blocker. Flag cleared at end of turn. Dazzling Beauty. Also usable as an X-scaled multi-target group (`targetX(TargetFilters.attackingCreature(), cap)`): the handler fans over `entry.getTargetIds()` and skips any target already blocked by a real creature (no re-fire of its becomes-blocked triggers), so it pairs with `DealDamageToEachTargetEffect` for "X target attacking creatures become blocked" - Choking Vines |
| `MakeAllAttackingCreaturesBlockedEffect` | `()` | Makes every current attacking creature blocked without adding blockers. Uses the same no-blocker state and trigger path as `MakeTargetAttackingCreatureBlockedEffect`. Fog Patch |
| `RegisterTransformSourceAtNextUpkeepEffect` | `()` | Registers a `TransformSourceAtNextUpkeep` delayed action for the source permanent. Drained in `StepTriggerService.handleUpkeepTriggers` at the next upkeep (any active player) as a `TransformToBackFaceEffect` trigger. Used by Archangel Avacyn |
| `TransformToBackFaceEffect` | `()` | Transforms the source permanent to its back face only if it is still front-face; no-ops if already transformed or gone. Used by Archangel Avacyn's delayed upkeep trigger |
| `MeldWithNamedCreatureEffect` | `(String partnerName[, PermanentPredicate partnerPredicate])` | Exile the source and a named permanent you both own and control, then meld them into the source's `backFaceCard` (meld result). The one-argument form requires a creature; the predicate overload supports other partner types such as Argoth's land. Component cards are tracked on `Permanent.meldComponentCards`. Wrap in `ConditionalEffect(AllOf(own-source, own-named-partner), �)` on the relevant trigger slot |
| `RegisterDamageAtNextUpkeepUnlessPaysEffect` | `(int damage, String manaCost)` | SPELL registrar (Quenchable Fire). Reads the spell's already-chosen target (player or planeswalker) from `entry.targetId` � declares no target of its own (`TargetSpec.NONE`), so pair it with a `DealDamageToTargetPlayerOrPlaneswalkerEffect` in the same slot � and queues a `DamageAtNextUpkeepUnlessPays(spellControllerId, targetId, damage, manaCost, sourceCard)` delayed action. Drained in `StepTriggerService.handleUpkeepTriggers` only at the **spell controller's** upkeep: resolves the paying party (targeted player, else targeted planeswalker's controller; fizzles if gone) and pushes a `DamageTargetPlayerOrPlaneswalkerUnlessPaysEffect` trigger controlled by that payer with the target on `entry.targetId` |
| `RegisterPayManaOrLoseGameAtNextUpkeepEffect` | `(String manaCost)` | SPELL registrar (Pact of Negation). | `DamageTargetPlayerOrPlaneswalkerUnlessPaysEffect` | `(int damage, String manaCost)` | `DamageDealingEffect` (player-only). The pushed half of Quenchable Fire's delayed trigger � never cast directly. On resolution its handler prompts the payer (`entry.controllerId`) with a "you may pay `manaCost`" may-ability, stashing the damage recipient on `PendingMayAbility.targetCardId`; declining or being unable to pay deals `damage` to that player/planeswalker via `DealDamageToTargetPlayerOrPlaneswalkerEffectHandler` (mayfx `DamageTargetPlayerOrPlaneswalkerUnlessPaysHandler`) |

| `RegisterDelayedCombatDamageLootEffect` | `(int drawAmount, int discardAmount)` | registers a delayed triggered ability for the rest of the turn: whenever one or more creatures you control deal combat damage to a player, draw N then discard N. | `RegisterDelayedReturnCardFromGraveyardToHandEffect` | `(UUID cardId)` | registers a delayed trigger that fires at the beginning of the next end step, returning the card from its owner's graveyard to their hand (if still there). | `RegisterCombatDamageReflectionEffect` | `()` | registers a delayed triggered ability for the rest of the turn: whenever an attacking creature deals combat damage to the resolving controller, it deals that much damage back to its controller (the attacking player), with the attacking creature as the damage source. The blocking creatures and any block costs remain the defender's. Cleared by `CombatService.clearCombatState` (end of combat). Used by Melee |

| `RegisterDelayedDestroyCreatureDamagedByTargetEffect` | `()` | registers a delayed triggered ability for the rest of the turn: "whenever target creature deals combat damage to a non-Wall creature this turn, destroy that non-Wall creature". Not a `RemovalEffect` � the destruction hits what the target damages, not the target. Pair with `RegisterDelayedSacrificeSourceWhenTargetLeavesEffect` on the shared creature target. Used by Acidic Dagger |
| `RegisterDelayedSacrificeTargetWhenSourceLeavesEffect` | `()` | registers a delayed triggered ability for the rest of the turn: when the ability's source leaves the battlefield, sacrifice the targeted creature. Stored in `GameData.delayedActions` (`DelayedSacrificeTargetWhenSourceLeaves`); drained in `TriggerCollectionService.processDelayedSacrificeTargetWhenSourceLeaves` from every leave path in `PermanentRemovalService`; cleared at turn cleanup. Pair with pump + `RegisterDelayedSacrificeSourceWhenTargetLeavesEffect` for mutual leave-sacrifice (Phantasmal Mount) |
| `RegisterDelayedDestroyTargetWhenSourceLeavesEffect` | `()` | registers a delayed triggered ability for the rest of the turn: when the ability's source leaves the battlefield, destroy the targeted creature without allowing regeneration. Stored in `GameData.delayedActions` (`DelayedDestroyTargetWhenSourceLeaves`); drained in `TriggerCollectionService.processDelayedDestroyTargetWhenSourceLeaves` from every leave path in `PermanentRemovalService`; cleared at turn cleanup. Used by War Barge |
| `ReturnTriggeringLandFromGraveyardToBattlefieldEffect` | `(UUID landCardId)` | immediately returns the identified land from the graveyard to the battlefield under the ability controller's (= graveyard owner's) control; fizzles if it is no longer in a graveyard. Register the template with `null`; the `ON_ALLY_LAND_PUT_INTO_GRAVEYARD_BY_OPPONENT` collector stamps the concrete land card id. Used by Sacred Ground |
| `RegisterDelayedManaEqualToTargetSpellManaValueEffect` | `(ManaColor color)` / `(ManaColor color, boolean optional, boolean anyColorCombination, boolean firstMainOnly)` | Scattering Stroke's clash-win reward. Wrap in `ClashEffect` on a "counter target spell" card **before** the `CounterSpellEffect` so the targeted spell is still on the stack; reads `entry.getTargetId()`'s mana value (`getManaValue()+getXValue()`) and queues an optional `AddManaAtNextMainPhase` delayed action. Drained in `StepTriggerService.drainAddManaAtNextMainPhase` on both precombat and postcombat main for the active player, which pushes a `MayEffect(AwardManaEffect(color, amount))` ("you may add that much mana") onto the stack. The 4-arg form covers Plasm Capture (`COLORLESS, false, true, true`): `optional=false` skips the `MayEffect`, `anyColorCombination=true` swaps `AwardManaEffect` for `AwardManaOfColorsEffect(ManaColor.COLORS, amount)` so a colour is picked per mana, and `firstMainOnly=true` keeps the entry queued past a postcombat main so it fires only on a precombat ("first") main phase |
| `RegisterDelayedManaAtNextMainPhaseEffect` | `(ManaColor color, int amount)` | Conduit of Storms / Emrakul. ON_ATTACK: queues a **mandatory**, **this-turn-only** `AddManaAtNextMainPhase` (optional=false, thisTurnOnly=true). Drained on the next main phase (typically postcombat after attacking); unused entries cleared at cleanup. Mana is still added if the source left or transformed |
| `UnattachEquipmentFromTargetPermanentsEffect` | `()` | unattach all equipment from target permanents (multi-target) |
| `UnattachEnchantedEquipmentEffect` | `()` | non-targeting ETB effect: unattach the Equipment the source Aura is attached to, including any sacrifice-on-unattach behavior |

## Control / steal

| `ExchangeControlOfAllMatchingPermanentsWithTargetPlayerEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate filter[, ControlDuration])` | targeted mass control exchange: the resolving player and target player exchange all matching permanents for the requested duration. Both sides are collected before any control changes are applied, then each permanent receives a per-permanent `GainControlOfTargetEffect` floating control effect. Targets a player; use the target player's current battlefield for subsequent target-player-scoped riders |

- `ExchangeControlOfAllCreaturesWithTargetPlayerEffect` | `()` | exchanges control of all creatures controlled by the spell controller and target player until end of turn; snapshots both creature lists before applying paired `GainControlOfTargetEffect(END_OF_TURN)` floating control effects (Reins of Power) |
| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `GainControlOfTargetEffect(ControlDuration.WHILE_SOURCE_REMAINS_TAPPED)` | `()` | control lasts while the source remains tapped, regardless of who controls the source (Vedalken Shackles) |
| `TargetPlayerGainsControlOfSourceCreatureEffect` | `()` / `.triggeringPlayer()` | The player carried on the stack entry gains control of the source permanent. The constructor targets that player; `triggeringPlayer()` is non-targeting for a spell-cast trigger whose caster is already known (Drooling Ogre). |
| `TargetPlayerGainsControlOfTargetPermanentEffect` | `()` | first target player gains permanent control of the second target permanent; pair with a player target followed by `ControlledPermanentPredicateTargetFilter` (Donate) |
| `PlayerWithMostLifeGainsControlOfSourceCreatureEffect` | `()` | the player with strictly the most life gains permanent control of this creature; no-op on a tie for most life (intervening-if). GhazbA?n Ogre (`UPKEEP_TRIGGERED`) |
| `PlayerWithMostCreaturesGainsControlOfSourceCreatureEffect` | `()` | the unique player with strictly the most creatures gains permanent control of this creature; no-op on a tie (intervening-if). Wild Mammoth (`UPKEEP_TRIGGERED`) |
| `PlayerWithMostCardsInHandGainsControlOfSourceCreatureEffect` | `()` | the unique player with strictly the most cards in hand gains permanent control of this creature; no-op on a tie (intervening-if). Sokenzan Renegade (`UPKEEP_TRIGGERED`) |
| `GainControlOfTargetEffect` | `(ControlDuration duration[, CardSubtype grantedSubtype][, boolean tapWhenControlLost])` | gain control of target permanent for the given duration. `ControlDuration{PERMANENT, END_OF_TURN, WHILE_SOURCE_ON_BATTLEFIELD}`. PERMANENT optionally grants a subtype (Captivating Vampire "It becomes a Vampire") and supports multi-target (iterates `getTargetIds()` for "up to N target" abilities); END_OF_TURN (Threaten, Metallic Mastery � card's target filter handles type restriction) wears off in end-of-turn cleanup; WHILE_SOURCE_ON_BATTLEFIELD (Olivia Voldaren) ends when the source leaves the battlefield or its creator stops controlling it. Every resolution creates a floating `L2_CONTROL` continuous effect (CR 613.2/613.7) via `CreatureControlService.applyControlEffect`; the controller of a permanent is DERIVED from the newest active control effect (`GameData.deriveControllerOf`), so an expiring steal falls back to the next most recent still-active effect, not blindly to the owner. Haste/untap riders (Act of Treason) are composed as separate effects on the card. `tapWhenControlLost=true` (Magus of the Unseen "When you lose control of the artifact, tap it") records the target in `GameData.permanentsToTapWhenControlLost` at resolution; `TurnCleanupService.applyCleanupResets` taps those permanents as the END_OF_TURN control effect expires and clears the set |
| `AttachTargetToSourcePermanentEffect` | `()` | attach the targeted permanent to the source permanent (e.g. steal Equipment and equip it � combine with `GainControlOfTargetEffect(END_OF_TURN)`) |
| `GainControlOfAllPermanentsTargetPlayerControlsEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate filter)` | gain permanent control of every permanent matching `filter` that the target player controls at resolution (player-targeting spec, Gilt-Leaf Archdruid = `PermanentIsLandPredicate`). Also usable on `ON_COMBAT_DAMAGE_TO_PLAYER` — it is a `CombatDamageTriggerContextEffect` reporting `DAMAGED_PLAYER`, so the damaged player is baked in as `targetId` with no `target(...)` on the card (Hellkite Tyrant = `PermanentIsArtifactPredicate`). Applies one per-permanent `GainControlOfTargetEffect(PERMANENT)` floating `L2_CONTROL` effect via `CreatureControlService.applyControlEffect` � reuses the standard control machinery, adds no new layer classification |
| `GainControlOfAllPermanentsMatchingEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate)` / `(PermanentPredicate, ControlDuration)` | non-targeted mass steal: at resolution gain permanent control of every permanent (any controller) matching the predicate that you don't already control (Karrthus, Tyrant of Jund � `PermanentHasSubtypePredicate(DRAGON)`). Collects matches first (control-gain moves permanents between battlefield lists), then applies one per-permanent `GainControlOfTargetEffect(PERMANENT)` floating `L2_CONTROL` effect via `CreatureControlService.applyControlEffect` � same machinery as `GainControlOfAllPermanentsTargetPlayerControlsEffect`, selected by predicate instead of target player, adds no new layer classification |
| `JuxtaposeEffect` | `()` | Juxtapose: `SPELL`, self-declares a single player target (player-targeting spec, read from `entry.getTargetId()`). The controller and target player exchange control of the creature they each control with the greatest mana value, then exchange artifacts the same way. Driven by `JuxtaposeSupport`: one type at a time (creatures first, then artifacts on the updated board, so an artifact creature can move in both steps); each type resolves the controller's participant then the target's; a tie for greatest MV prompts that permanent's controller via `PermanentChoiceContext.JuxtaposeTieBreak`; if either player controls no permanent of the current type that exchange is skipped. Swaps controllers permanently via two `GainControlOfTargetEffect(PERMANENT)` floating effects (same swap mechanic as `ExchangeControlOfTargetPermanentsEffect`) |
| `GainControlOfAllPermanentsTargetPlayerControlsEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate filter)` | gain permanent control of every permanent matching `filter` that the target player controls at resolution (`canTargetPlayer`, Gilt-Leaf Archdruid = `PermanentIsLandPredicate`; Hellkite Tyrant = `PermanentIsArtifactPredicate` on `ON_COMBAT_DAMAGE_TO_PLAYER`). Applies one per-permanent `GainControlOfTargetEffect(PERMANENT)` floating `L2_CONTROL` effect via `CreatureControlService.applyControlEffect` � reuses the standard control machinery, adds no new layer classification |
| `GainControlOfCombatOpponentAtEndOfCombatEffect` | `(ControlDuration duration)` or `()` (defaults to `WHILE_SOURCE_ON_BATTLEFIELD`) | The Wretched's "At end of combat, gain control of all creatures blocking this creature for as long as you control this creature". Implements `ControlStealingEffect` (`controlDuration()` = `WHILE_SOURCE_ON_BATTLEFIELD`). Placed on `ON_BECOMES_BLOCKED` with `TriggerMode.PER_BLOCKER` (blockers only � not creatures this permanent blocks). Resolution (handler) carries the blocker as `entry.getTargetId()` and the source as `entry.getSourcePermanentId()`, and queues a `GainControlOfPermanentAtEndOfCombat` delayed action. Drained in `CombatService.processEndOfCombatControlGains()`, which for a source-linked duration re-checks the source still exists and is still controlled by the gaining player, then applies a floating `L2_CONTROL` `GainControlOfTargetEffect` of that duration keyed to the source via `CreatureControlService.applyControlEffect`. `ControlDuration.PERMANENT` is the durationless "gain control of that creature at end of combat" (Tolarian Entrancer) — no source re-check, so it works even if the source died in combat |
| `JuxtaposeEffect` | `()` | Juxtapose: `SPELL`, self-declares a single player target (`canTargetPlayer()`, read from `entry.getTargetId()`). The controller and target player exchange control of the creature they each control with the greatest mana value, then exchange artifacts the same way. Driven by `JuxtaposeSupport`: one type at a time (creatures first, then artifacts on the updated board, so an artifact creature can move in both steps); each type resolves the controller's participant then the target's; a tie for greatest MV prompts that permanent's controller via `PermanentChoiceContext.JuxtaposeTieBreak`; if either player controls no permanent of the current type that exchange is skipped. Swaps controllers permanently via two `GainControlOfTargetEffect(PERMANENT)` floating effects (same swap mechanic as `ExchangeControlOfTargetPermanentsEffect`) |
| `ExchangeControlOfTargetPermanentsEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate targetPredicate, boolean requireOpponentManaValueNotGreater[, boolean requireFirstTargetControlledByController])` | generic two-target control exchange; `targetPredicate` is the shape both targets must still match at resolution and `requireOpponentManaValueNotGreater` adds the "equal or lesser mana value" restriction. Legerdemain (`anyOf(artifact, creature), false, false, false, true`): `SPELL`, two same-filter `target(...)` groups plus `setMultiTargetConstraint(MultiTargetConstraint.SHARE_ARTIFACT_OR_CREATURE_TYPE)`; the fifth flag `requireSharedArtifactOrCreatureType` re-checks `GameQueryService.sharesArtifactOrCreatureType` at resolution (a shared land type alone does not satisfy it). `requireFirstTargetControlledByController` defaults to `true` (2-arg constructor) for wordings that pin target `[0]` to the ability's controller; pass `false` for plain "two target creatures" (Switcheroo � `PermanentIsCreaturePredicate(), false, false` with two `target(TargetFilters.creature())` groups, either slot controlled by anyone, exchange only when the controllers differ per CR 701.12b). Political Trickery (`PermanentIsLandPredicate(), false`): `SPELL` with two `target(...)` groups � `[0]` a land you control (`ControlledPermanentPredicateTargetFilter`), `[1]` a land an opponent controls. Puca's Mischief (`PermanentNotPredicate(PermanentIsLandPredicate()), true`): exchange control of the two `targetIds` � `[0]` a nonland permanent you control, `[1]` a nonland permanent an opponent controls with mana value ? target [0]. `UPKEEP_TRIGGERED`, wrapped in `MayEffect` (resolution-time "may", like Axis of Mortality). The two interdependent targets are chosen at trigger time by a bespoke two-step permanent choice (`StepTriggerService.processNextPucasMischiefTarget` � `PermanentChoiceContext.PucasMischiefOwnTarget`/`PucasMischiefOpponentTarget`, patterned on Capricious Efreet). At resolution re-checks legality (both still on the battlefield, control roles unchanged, MV restriction still holds; CR 701.12a) and, if legal, swaps controllers permanently via two `GainControlOfTargetEffect(PERMANENT)` floating `L2_CONTROL` effects |
| `ExchangeControlOfSharedTypeTargetsAndDestroyAurasEffect` | `()` | Gauntlets of Chaos: exchange control of the two `targetIds` � `[0]` an artifact/creature/land you control, `[1]` a permanent an opponent controls sharing one of those types. Multi-target activated ability (`{5}` + `SacrificeSelfCost`). The interdependent "shares one of those types" restriction is enforced at announcement via `ActivatedAbility.withMultiTargetConstraint(MultiTargetConstraint.SHARE_ARTIFACT_CREATURE_OR_LAND_TYPE)` (checked in `TargetLegalityService.validateMultiTargetConstraint` using `GameQueryService.sharesArtifactCreatureOrLandType`); per-position filter [1] is just "artifact/creature/land an opponent controls". At resolution re-checks legality (control roles unchanged, still share a type; CR 701.10), swaps controllers permanently via two `GainControlOfTargetEffect(PERMANENT)` floating `L2_CONTROL` effects, then destroys every Aura attached to either permanent (snapshotted before the swap; `DestructionSupport.tryDestroyAndLog`) |
| `ExchangeControlOfTargetPermanentsEffect.forTriggeringPermanent` | `(PermanentPredicate targetPredicate)` | trigger-time exchange where the entering permanent is the first exchange participant and its controller chooses the other target; source-relative predicates receive that entering permanent as `FilterContext.sourcePermanentSnapshot` |
| `GainControlOfEnchantedTargetEffect` | `()` | gain control of enchanted permanent (static, Control Magic-style) |
| `GainControlOfEnchantedPermanentEffect` | `(ControlDuration duration)` | non-targeting: gain control of the permanent the **source Aura** is attached to for `duration`. Re-derives the host at resolution from the Aura's `attachedTo` (via `entry.getSourcePermanentId()`), so it works on slots that carry no target � `ON_ENTER_BATTLEFIELD` and `UPKEEP_TRIGGERED` on an Aura (Wellspring, "gain control of enchanted land until end of turn"). Fizzles silently if the Aura left the battlefield or is unattached. `ControlStealingEffect`. Distinct from `GainControlOfEnchantedTargetEffect`, the activated-ability variant that reads the entry's target and holds control for as long as it remains enchanted (Rootwater Matriarch) |
| `TriggeringObjectControllerGainsControlOfEnchantedPermanentEffect` | `(ControlDuration duration)` | `ON_BECOMES_TARGET_OF_SPELL_OR_ABILITY`: the controller of the triggering spell or activated ability gains control of the permanent enchanted by the source Aura. The trigger carries the triggering object in the `STACK` zone and the Aura as `sourcePermanentId`; the host is re-derived from `attachedTo` at resolution (Fractured Loyalty) |
| `GainControlOfPermanentDefendingPlayerControlsAndAssignNoCombatDamageEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate filter, ControlDuration duration, String choiceNoun)` | Orcish Squatters (`PermanentIsLandPredicate`, `WHILE_SOURCE_ON_BATTLEFIELD`, "land"), Kukemssa Pirates (`PermanentIsArtifactPredicate`, `PERMANENT`, "artifact"). `ControlStealingEffect` (`controlDuration()` = `duration`). Wrap in `MayEffect` on `ON_ATTACKS_UNBLOCKED` (`targetId`=defender, `sourcePermanentId`=attacker). Handler presents a max-1 choice among the defender's permanents matching `filter`; completion in `MultiPermanentChoiceHandlerService.handleGainControlOfPermanentAndAssignNoCombatDamage` takes control via a wrapped `GainControlOfTargetEffect(duration)` and, only when one is taken, adds the attacker to `creaturesPreventedFromDealingCombatDamage`. A source-linked `duration` (`ControlDuration.isSourceLinked()`) additionally requires the source to still be on the battlefield and controlled by the effect's controller |
| `DestroyPermanentDefendingPlayerControlsAndAssignNoCombatDamageEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate filter, String choiceNoun)` | Destroy counterpart of the gain-control effect above (Goblin Vandal, `PermanentIsArtifactPredicate`, "artifact"). `RemovalEffect` (`DESTROY`). Designed for `ON_ATTACKS_UNBLOCKED` (`targetId`=defender, `sourcePermanentId`=attacker); wrap in `MayPayManaEffect("{R}", ...)` for "you may pay {R}. If you do, ...". Handler presents a max-1 choice among the defender's permanents matching `filter`; completion in `MultiPermanentChoiceHandlerService.handleDestroyPermanentDefendingPlayerControlsAndAssignNoCombatDamage` destroys it and — only when one is chosen — adds the attacker to `creaturesPreventedFromDealingCombatDamage` |
| `GainControlOfTargetAuraEffect` | `()` | gain control of target aura |
| `GainControlOfTargetSpellEffect` | `()` | gain control of target noncreature spell on the stack; preserves the spell owner and offers the new controller a retarget choice (Commandeer) |
| `GainControlIfSubtypesDealtCombatDamageEffect` | `(CardSubtype subtype, int threshold)` | end-step trigger: gain control of target nonland permanent controlled by a player dealt combat damage by `threshold`+ creatures of `subtype` this turn. Intervening-if + targeting handled by StepTriggerService; resolves via `GainControlOfTargetEffect(PERMANENT)` |
| `ControlEnchantedCreatureEffect` | `()` | control enchanted creature (static) |
| `ClashForControlOfEnchantedCreatureEffect` | `()` | Captivating Glance. Non-targeting `CONTROLLER_END_STEP_TRIGGERED` effect on an Aura: clashes with an opponent for the aura's controller, then gives control of the enchanted creature to the clash winner � the controller on a win, otherwise the clash opponent (a tie counts as "otherwise"). Uses `entry.getSourcePermanentId()` � aura's `attachedTo` to find the creature; delegates to `performClash` + `CreatureControlService.applyControlEffect` (PERMANENT floating control effect) |
| `SacrificeEnchantedPermanentAndReattachSourceAuraEffect` | `()` | Nettlevine Blight. `ENCHANTED_PERMANENT_CONTROLLER_END_STEP_TRIGGERED` Aura effect (fires on the enchanted permanent's controller's end step; slot handled in `StepTriggerService.handleEndStepTriggers`, keyed on `findPermanentController(aura.attachedTo) == activePlayer`). Resolution: that player sacrifices the enchanted permanent, then moves the Aura (via `Permanent.setAttachedTo`, keeping its controller) onto another creature/land they control. Uses `entry.getSourcePermanentId()` for the Aura. Auto-attaches with 0/1 destination; prompts (`PermanentChoiceContext.ReattachSourceAuraAfterSacrifice`, completed in `PermanentChoiceBattlefieldHandlerService`) with 2+, deferring the sacrifice so the Aura isn't orphaned mid-choice. No destination � Aura left unattached, removed by `removeOrphanedAuras` SBA |
| `GrantSupertypeToEnchantedPermanentEffect` | `(CardSupertype supertype)` | enchanted permanent gains the specified supertype (static). E.g. In Bolas's Clutches � "Enchanted permanent is legendary." Integrates with legend rule |
| `GrantSupertypeUntilEndOfTurnEffect` | `(CardSupertype supertype, GrantScope scope[, boolean gained])` | one-shot layer-4 supertype grant or removal that lasts until end of turn. `SELF` targets the resolving ability's source permanent; `TARGET` uses the ability target. The two-argument constructor grants; `gained=false` removes. Stored as a floating continuous effect so `GameQueryService.hasEffectiveSupertype` and the legend rule see it |
| `GrantSupertypeToPermanentsWithCountersEffect` | `(CounterType counterType, CardSupertype supertype)` | global STATIC layer-4 grant: every permanent with one or more counters of `counterType` has `supertype`; Rimefeather Owl uses `(ICE, SNOW)`. Handler: `GrantSupertypeToPermanentsWithCountersEffectHandler` |
| `EnchantedCreatureDealsDamageToItsOwnerEffect` | `(int damage)` | enchanted creature deals N damage to its owner (the original owner, not current controller). Use on `UPKEEP_TRIGGERED` slot for auras that steal + ping owner |
| `EnchantedCreatureDealsDamageEqualToDealtDamageToControllerEffect` | `()` / `(boolean auraIsSource)` | deals xValue damage to the enchanted creature's controller. Use on `ON_ENCHANTED_CREATURE_DEALT_DAMAGE` (Spiteful Shadows � damage the creature *was dealt*) or `ON_ENCHANTED_CREATURE_DEALS_DAMAGE_TO_YOU` (Backfire � damage the creature *dealt to* the Aura's controller). `auraIsSource=true` makes the Aura the damage source instead of the enchanted creature ("this Aura deals that much damage to that creature's controller" � Binding Agony) |

## Prevention / protection / redirection

`PreventDamageEffect.allToControlledCreatures()` — SPELL: "Prevent all damage that would be dealt this turn to creatures you control" (Divine Light). Adds a turn-scoped flag for the caster and checks the current controller of each creature when damage is dealt.

| `FlipCoinForEachBlockingCreatureEffect` | `()` | Fighting Chance. At resolution, collects the blocking creatures currently on the battlefield, flips independently for each, and adds each winning blocker to `GameData.creaturesPreventedFromDealingCombatDamage` for the rest of the turn |

| `PreventNextDamageToTargetAndAddPlusOnePlusOneCountersEffect` | `(DynamicAmount amount)` | "Prevent the next X damage that would be dealt to target creature this turn. For each 1 damage prevented this way, put a +1/+1 counter on that creature" (Temper). Benign CREATURE target; X is evaluated on resolution. Its dedicated shield is consumed by `DamagePreventionService.applyCreaturePreventionShield`, which immediately adds one +1/+1 counter per prevented damage, for both combat and noncombat damage; cleared at turn cleanup |

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `PreventDamageEffect` | static factories: `nextToAny(int)` (Samite Healer), `nextToController(int)` (Esper Battlemage), `nextToSelf(int)` (Ethereal Champion), `nextToEnchanted(int)` (Fylgja � shields the Aura's attached permanent), `nextToTarget(int)` / `nextToTarget(DynamicAmount)` (Healing Salve; `new XValue()` for Alabaster Potion), `allCombat()` (Fog, Holy Day), `allCombatByAttackingCreatures()` (Harmless Assault), `allToCreatures()` (Blinding Fog), `allToTargetCreatures()` (Wellgabber Apothecary, Redeem multi-target), `allCombatToTargetCreatures()` (Foxfire), `allByTargetCreatures()` (Soul Parry, Inquisitor's Snare), `allCombatByTargetCreatures()` (Resistance Fighter; Foxfire pairs to-and-by), `allToSelf()` (Gideon of the Trials 0 � no target, shields the source and stops planeswalker loyalty loss), `allCombatToSelf()` (Oketra's Avenger) / `allCombatBySelf()` (Goblin Snowman � no target, prevents all combat damage the source would deal; pair the two for "to and by it"), `allByTargetPermanentUntilNextTurn()` (Gideon of the Trials +1 � benign PERMANENT target; stored in `permanentsPreventedFromDealingDamageUntilNextTurn` and expires at the controller's next turn, read via `GameData.isPreventedFromDealingDamage`), `allToControllerAndCreatures()` (Safe Passage, Endure), `allToController()` (Riot Control — the player only, via `playersWithAllPlayerDamagePrevented`), `allToControllerFromAttackers()` (Deep Wood, Heavy Fog � pair with `setSpellCastTimingRestriction(DECLARE_ATTACKERS_IF_ATTACKED)`), `fromColors(Set<CardColor>)` (Luminesce), `allCombatExcept(PermanentPredicate)` (Moonmist `PermanentHasAnySubtypePredicate(Set.of(WEREWOLF, WOLF))`), `allCombatExceptTargetCreature()` (Terrifying Presence � benign CREATURE target; the exemption predicate is built at resolution from the chosen target via `PermanentIsSpecificPermanentPredicate`) | **collapsed one-shot shield family.** Every "prevent the next N damage to <victim>" and "prevent all [combat] damage to/by <victim> this turn" wording is this record with a `PreventionScope` � never a new effect class. One `PreventDamageEffectHandler` writes the scope's shield-state slot (global/player/attacking-source flags, creature amount shields, until-end-of-turn flags, color set, combat-exempt predicate); consumption stays in `DamagePreventionService` and shields clear at turn cleanup. `NEXT_TO_TARGET` targets any target (benign ANY_TARGET spec); the two target-creature scopes target creatures (benign CREATURE spec, multi-target via the effect's target group); everything else takes no target. Chosen-source shields (CoP cycle, Sanctum Guardian, Healing Grace), `PreventDividedDamageEffect`, `PreventNextColorDamageToControllerEffect`, and the static always-on markers with riders remain separate records |
| `PreventDividedDamageEffect` | `(DynamicAmount amount)` plus an `int` convenience constructor | "prevent the next N damage this turn to any number of targets, divided as you choose" (Remedy, Serra's Hymn). No `target()` call � per-target shield amounts ride on the cast-time or activation-time `damageAssignments` map (must sum to N; N caps target count). Each target gets a "next X damage" shield. Reuses the divided-damage cast flow (`EffectResolution.needsDamageDistribution`); resolved by `PreventDividedDamageEffectHandler`. Shields cleared at turn cleanup |
| `PreventDamageEffect.allToPlayersFromMatchingSources(PermanentPredicate)` | `()` | SPELL: prevents all damage that would be dealt to players this turn by matching sources (Chameleon Blur). Stores the source predicate for every player and re-evaluates it for combat and noncombat player damage; damage to creatures and planeswalkers is unaffected |
| `PreventAllCombatDamageToAndByEnchantedCreatureEffect` | `()` | prevent all combat damage to and dealt by enchanted creature (non-combat damage still applies) |
| `PreventAllCombatDamageToSelfEffect` | `()` | static: prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to the source permanent itself (Seraph of the Sword). Checked in `DamagePreventionService.applyCreaturePreventionShield`. The creature still deals its own combat damage; noncombat damage unaffected |
| `PreventAllCombatDamageBySelfEffect` | `()` | static: prevent all combat damage the source permanent would deal, without preventing combat damage dealt to it (Woolly Razorback). Conditional wrappers are resolved by `GameQueryService` when checking combat damage sources |
