Stores an unlimited `CreatureDamageRedirectShield` (protected creature + chosen source + `UNLIMITED` amount + redirect target) in `gameData.creatureDamageRedirectShields`, checked via `DamagePreventionService.applyCreatureRedirectShields` in both the combat (`CombatDamageService.applyCombatCreatureDamage`) and noncombat (`DamageSupport.dealCreatureDamage`) creature-damage paths. Unlike Harm's Way, protects one specific creature (not a player's permanents) with no amount limit; reuses `pendingSourceRedirectDamage`/`processSourceRedirectDamage` to deal the redirected damage. Cleared at turn cleanup |
| `RedirectTargetCreatureNextDamageFromChosenSourceToControllerEffect` | `()` | activated-ability redirect: the next single damage event a chosen source would deal to the target creature this turn is dealt to the ability's controller (you) instead (Jade Monolith). permanent-targeting spec � the ability targets the protected creature; the source is chosen on resolution (prompts a battlefield permanent choice). Stores a next-event `CreatureDamageRedirectShield` (protected creature + chosen source + `NEXT_EVENT` amount + `redirectTargetId` = controller player) which `applyCreatureRedirectShields` redirects in full then consumes, over both combat and noncombat creature-damage paths. Like Oracle's Attendants' `RedirectTargetCreatureDamageFromChosenSourceToSelfEffect` but redirects to the controller (a player) and only for the next single event. Cleared at turn cleanup |
| `RedirectNextCombatDamageFromTargetAttackingCreatureToSelfEffect` | `()` | activated-ability redirect: the next combat damage the target attacking creature would deal to the ability's source creature this turn is dealt to that attacker instead (Shield Dancer). The target is benign because it is the damage source; stores a source-specific, combat-only next-event `CreatureDamageRedirectShield` with the attacker as the redirect destination. Noncombat damage from that attacker does not consume the shield |
| `RedirectNextDamageEffect` | `(RedirectRole protectedRole, RedirectRole destinationRole, DynamicAmount amount, TargetPredicate declaredTarget[, PermanentPredicate targetPredicate])` | "The next `amount` damage that would be dealt to X this turn is dealt to Y instead", from ANY source (combat or noncombat), consumed once `amount` damage has been redirected. `RedirectNextDamageEffect.nextEvent(...)` is the next-event variant: it redirects the entire first damage event and then consumes the shield (Mirrorwood Treefolk). `RedirectRole` is `SOURCE_PERMANENT` / `TARGET` / `CONTROLLER` / `ENCHANTED_PERMANENT` (the permanent the Aura source is attached to) and fills both ends: `protectedRole` is whose damage is diverted, `destinationRole` who receives it. Installs an amount-limited or next-event `CreatureDamageRedirectShield` (`damageSourceId=null`) when the protected object is a permanent, or a `PlayerNextDamageRedirectShield` when it is a player (Martyrdom's any-target grant) — the former consumed by `DamagePreventionService.applyCreatureRedirectShields` in both the combat (`CombatDamageService.applyCombatCreatureDamage`) and noncombat (`DamageSupport.dealCreatureDamage`) creature-damage paths, the latter by `applyPlayerNextDamageRedirectShields` in the two player-damage paths. Both cleared at turn cleanup. `targetSpec()` is `harmful` exactly when `destinationRole == TARGET` (the target is the object that takes the damage, so CR 702.16b protection applies) and `benign` when the target is the one being shielded; `null` yields `TargetSpec.NONE`. An `int` convenience ctor wraps `Fixed`. Cards: Mirrorwood Treefolk (next event), Zhalfirin Crusader `(SOURCE_PERMANENT, TARGET, 1, ANY_TARGET)`, Zealous Inquisitor `(SOURCE_PERMANENT, TARGET, 1, CREATURE)`, Personal Incarnation `(SOURCE_PERMANENT, CONTROLLER, 1, NONE)`, Martyrdom `(TARGET, SOURCE_PERMANENT, 1, ANY_TARGET)`, Daughter of Autumn / Hazduhr the Abbot `(TARGET, SOURCE_PERMANENT, Fixed(1)/XValue(), CREATURE, whiteCreature)`, Vassal's Duty `(TARGET, CONTROLLER, Fixed(1), CREATURE)`, Ward of Piety `(ENCHANTED_PERMANENT, TARGET, 1, ANY_TARGET)` |
| `RedirectNextInstantOrSorceryDamageToControllerEffect` | `()` | activated ability: "the next time an instant or sorcery spell would deal damage to you this turn, that spell deals that damage to its controller instead" (Aegis of Honor). The normal-effect handler installs one shield keyed by the activating player; `DamageSupport.dealDamageToPlayer` consumes it only for direct `INSTANT_SPELL`/`SORCERY_SPELL` damage, changing the recipient to `StackEntry.controllerId`. Combat and permanent ability damage do not match. Cleared at turn cleanup and copied with `GameData` for AI simulation. |
| `RedirectNextCombatDamageToOpponentEffect` | `()` | activated ability (target creature): "The next time this creature would deal combat damage to an opponent this turn, it deals that damage to target creature instead" (Soltari Guerrillas). Keyed on the damage **source**, not the damaged object - installs a one-shot `SourceNextCombatDamageToOpponentRedirectShield(sourcePermanentId, destinationPermanentId)` in `gameData.sourceNextCombatDamageToOpponentRedirectShields`, consumed by `DamagePreventionService.applySourceNextCombatDamageToOpponentRedirect` from `CombatDamageService.accumulatePlayerDamageInternal` only when the damaged player is an opponent of the source's controller. Combat damage to a planeswalker or to a blocking creature is untouched. Redirected damage is queued in `pendingSourceRedirectDamage`. Skipped (shield kept) while the destination is no longer a creature on the battlefield. Harmful `CREATURE` spec. Cleared at turn cleanup |
| `GrantControllerKeywordEffect` | `(Keyword keyword)` | STATIC marker: the source's controller - the player, not the permanent - has `keyword`. No handler bean; read by `GameQueryService.playerHasShroud` / `playerHasHexproof`, which scan that player's battlefield for a matching grant. Only `SHROUD` (can't be targeted at all) and `HEXPROOF` (can't be targeted by opponents) are accepted; the compact ctor rejects any other keyword, since nothing would consult it. Used by True Believer and Ivory Mask (SHROUD), Leyline of Sanctity, Witchbane Orb, Shalai and Spirit of the Hearth (HEXPROOF) |
| `GrantControllerKeywordUntilEndOfTurnEffect` | `(Keyword keyword)` | one-shot effect: the controller has `SHROUD` or `HEXPROOF` until end of turn; stored in `GameData.playerKeywordsUntilEndOfTurn` and cleared during turn cleanup. Used with `GrantKeywordEffect(HEXPROOF, OWN_PERMANENTS)` for "you and permanents you control gain hexproof" |
| `IgnoreOpponentCreatureHexproofEffect` | `()` | STATIC marker: creatures the controller's **opponents** control with hexproof can be targeted by the controller's spells and abilities as though they didn't have hexproof (Glaring Spotlight). No handler — read at targeting time via `GameQueryService.ignoresOpponentCreatureHexproof(gameData, controllerId)` (scans the controller's battlefield) and consulted by the hexproof gates in `ValidTargetService.isBlockedByHexproofOrGrantedEffect` and `TargetLegalityService.untargetableReason`. Lifts both the `HEXPROOF` keyword and granted `TargetingRestrictionEffect.hexproof()`; shroud and protection are untouched, and only creatures are affected |
| `IgnoreOpponentHexproofEffect` | `()` | STATIC marker: the controller's opponents and any permanents they control with hexproof can be targeted by the controller's spells and abilities as though they didn't have hexproof (Kaya, Bane of the Dead). No handler — read at targeting time via `GameQueryService.ignoresOpponentPermanentHexproof(gameData, controllerId)` and `ignoresOpponentPlayerHexproof(gameData, controllerId)`; shroud and protection are untouched |
| `IgnoreOpponentHexproofUntilEndOfTurnEffect` | `()` | activated ability effect: creates a floating until-end-of-turn exemption allowing the controller's spells and abilities to target the controller's opponents and their creatures with hexproof as though they didn't have hexproof (Detection Tower). Resolved by `IgnoreOpponentHexproofUntilEndOfTurnEffectHandler`; targeting-time queries read the controller-scoped floating effect. Shroud and protection are untouched |
| `AllowTargetPlayerToTargetSourceIgnoringShroudEffect` | `()` | until end of turn, the source permanent can be the target of spells and abilities controlled by **target player** as though it didn't have shroud (Autumn Willow). Records the player on `Permanent.shroudIgnoredByPlayersUntilEndOfTurn` (`allowShroudIgnoredBy` / `ignoresShroudFor`), consulted by the shroud gates in `TargetLegalityService.untargetableReason` and `ValidTargetService.isBlockedByHexproofOrGrantedEffect`. Per player � every other player is still locked out � and cleared by `resetModifiers()`. Player-targeting spec (`TargetSpec.benign(PLAYER)`) |
| `CantBeEnchantedByOtherAurasEffect` | `()` | static marker: the permanent can't be enchanted by other Auras (Anti-Magic Aura). No handler � read at Aura-spell targeting time by `GameQueryService.cantBeEnchantedByOtherAuras`, enforced in `TargetLegalityService.checkSpellProtection` guarded by `card.isAura()`. Only ever used wrapped in `GrantEffectEffect` (e.g. scoped to `ENCHANTED_CREATURE`) |
| `CantBeEquippedEffect` | `()` | static marker: the permanent can't have an Equipment attached to it (Goblin Brawler). No handler � read by the equipment attachment legality checks |
| `GrantControllerSpellsCantBeCounteredByColorsEffect` | `(Set<CardColor> colors)` | controller's spells can't be countered by spells of specified colors this turn (one-shot, cleared at end of turn) |
| `GrantControllerSpellsCantBeCounteredThisTurnEffect` | `()` | controller's spells can't be countered this turn (one-shot, cleared at end of turn) |
| `GrantControllerCreatureSpellsCantBeCounteredThisTurnEffect` | `()` | controller's creature spells can't be countered this turn (one-shot, cleared at end of turn) |
| `GrantControllerCreaturesCantBeTargetedByColorsEffect` | `(Set<CardColor> colors)` | controller's creatures can't be targeted by spells of specified colors this turn (one-shot, cleared at end of turn) |
| `GrantControllerAndPermanentsHexproofFromColorsEffect` | `(Set<CardColor> colors)` | controller and permanents they control can't be targeted by spells or abilities of specified colors controlled by opponents until end of turn; targeting-only (one-shot, cleared at end of turn) |

| `PreventDamageFromTargetSpellEffect` | `(boolean gainLife, boolean instantSorceryOnly)` | targeted resolution effect: marks a spell in `GameData` so all damage dealt by that spell is prevented until turn cleanup. The no-arg form is instant/sorcery-only (Hidden Retreat); `withLifeGain()` targets any spell and has its controller gain life for each damage prevented (Hallow). Benign `SPELL_ON_STACK` target spec; Hidden Retreat further narrows its target with `StackEntryPredicateTargetFilter` |
| `TargetedSpellDamagePreventionEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate condition())` | capability for a static effect that prevents damage to its permanent from spells that target it; the optional condition is evaluated against the protected permanent at damage time |
| `PreventDamageToSelfFromTargetingSpellsEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate condition)` / `()` | STATIC marker: prevents all damage dealt to the source permanent by a spell that targets it. The optional condition is dynamic; Bronze Horse uses `PermanentControllerControlsPermanentPredicate(PermanentIsCreaturePredicate, true)` for "as long as you control another creature". Applied in `DamageSupport.dealCreatureDamage`, so damage from abilities or spells not targeting the permanent is unaffected |
| `PreventAllDamageToSelfFromCreaturesItBlocksEffect` | `()` | STATIC marker: prevents all combat and noncombat damage dealt to the source creature by creatures it is currently blocking; the damage services evaluate the source permanent's blocking assignments. Used by Wall of Vapor |
| `ReturnEnchantedCreatureToOwnerHandOnDeathEffect` | `(UUID dyingCreatureCardId)` or `(String followUpManaCost, String followUpPrompt)` | `ON_ENCHANTED_PERMANENT_PUT_INTO_GRAVEYARD`: returns the enchanted creature card from its owner's graveyard to its owner's hand. The card-definition constructor leaves the UUID null; `DeathTriggerCollectorService` bakes the dying card ID at trigger time. The optional follow-up payment is offered only after the creature was actually returned and, if paid, returns the source Aura from its owner's graveyard to its hand. Used by Demonic Vigor and Puppet Master. |
| `RedirectAllDamageToTargetCreatureToControllerEffect` | `()` | SPELL (benign creature target): all damage that would be dealt to the target creature this turn is dealt to the spell's controller instead (Sivvi's Valor). Stores an unlimited any-source `CreatureDamageRedirectShield` with `redirectTargetId` set to the controller player, so both combat and noncombat creature damage are redirected through `pendingSourceRedirectDamage`. Cleared at turn cleanup |
| `RedirectAllDamageToEnchantedCreatureControllerEffect` | `()` | STATIC Aura marker: all damage that would be dealt to the enchanted creature is dealt to its current controller instead (Treacherous Link). The creature-damage paths query the attached Aura dynamically, so the replacement follows control changes and stops when the Aura is unattached or ignored |
| `RedirectAllDamageFromTargetAttackingCreatureToSelfEffect` | `()` | activated ability (benign attacking-creature target): all damage that would be dealt to the ability's controller this turn by the target attacking creature is dealt to the ability's source creature instead (Shimian Night Stalker). Uses a source-specific turn redirect shield, so it covers combat and noncombat damage to the controller only |
| `RedirectAllCreatureDamageToControllerEffect` | `()` | SPELL: damage that would be dealt to any creature this turn is dealt to the spell's controller instead (Blood of the Martyr). Registers the controller in `GameData.playersRedirectingAllCreatureDamage`; both combat and noncombat creature-damage paths route the replacement through `pendingSourceRedirectDamage`. Cleared at turn cleanup |

| `WallOnlyTargetingRestrictionEffect` | `()` | static marker: the permanent cannot be targeted by a spell or ability whose legal targets are restricted to Walls. Enforced by the targeting services from announcement through resolution; modal spells use the union of their modes |

## Mana

`AddManaWhenLandOfSubtypeTappedForManaEffect` also accepts `controllerOnly=true` to watch only
matching lands tapped by the source's controller (Crypt Ghast); the two-argument form remains
symmetric (Vernal Bloom).

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `AddManaWhenCreatureTappedForManaEffect` | `(ManaColor color)` | ON_CONTROLLER_TAPS_CREATURE_FOR_MANA trigger: whenever the source's controller taps a creature they control for mana, they add one additional mana of `color`. This triggered mana ability pays directly into the controller's mana pool. Used by Leyline of Abundance |
| `AwardManaEffect` | `(ManaColor color, DynamicAmount amount)`, `(ManaColor color, int amount)`, or `(ManaColor color)` (defaults amount to 1) | add mana of the specified color; the quantity is a `DynamicAmount` (see "Dynamic amounts"). Flat: `(color)`/`(color, N)`. "for each X you control": `PermanentCount(filter, CountScope.CONTROLLER)`. "for each charge counter on it": `CountersOnSource(CounterType.CHARGE)` (Shrine of Boundless Growth). "equal to its power": `SourcePower()` (Marwyn, the Nurturer; Molten-Core Maestro). Implements `ManaProducingEffect`. Resolves inline for mana abilities (from the source permanent) and on the stack via `AwardManaEffectHandler` for triggered/loyalty mana (needs the stack entry's `sourcePermanentId`); dynamic amounts produce no mana when they evaluate to ? 0 and track creature mana when the source is a creature |
| `AwardManaToChosenPlayerEffect` | `(ManaColor color, int amount)` | "Choose a player. That player adds N mana of `color`." A mana ability (CR 605.1a) whose recipient may be any player � choosing a player is NOT targeting, so it resolves inline: `doResolveManaAbility` begins a `PermanentChoice` (validPlayerIds = all players) and `PermanentChoiceBattlefieldHandlerService.handleManaAbilityAddToChosenPlayer` routes the mana into the chosen player's pool (tracking creature mana when the source is a creature; Mana Reflection multiplier applied). Used by Valleymaker (`GREEN, 3`) |
| `AwardManaToActivePlayerEffect` | `(ManaColor color, int amount)` | "that player adds N mana of `color`" on a trigger that fires on every player's turn. The recipient is the stack entry's `targetId` (the active player recorded when the trigger was pushed), falling back to the entry controller. NOT a `ManaProducingEffect` — a beginning-of-step trigger uses the stack (CR 605.1b), not a mana ability. Used by Eladamri's Vineyard (`GREEN, 2`) with `EACH_PRECOMBAT_MAIN_TRIGGERED` |
| `AwardManaToCastingPlayerEffect` | `(ManaColor color[, int amount])` | adds mana of `color` to the player who cast the spell that caused the trigger. The casting player is carried by the triggered ability's `targetId` without being a chosen target. Used by Tangleroot (`GREEN, 1`) with `ON_ANY_PLAYER_CASTS_SPELL` |
| `AwardAnyColorManaEffect` | `(DynamicAmount amount, ManaSpendRestriction restriction, CardSubtype subtype)` — sugar: `()`, `(int)`, `(DynamicAmount)`, `(int, ManaSpendRestriction)`, `(int, ManaSpendRestriction, CardSubtype)` | add N mana of any color (player chooses). Targeted stack abilities distinguish `targetsPlayer` (the effect needs a player target) from `manaRecipientIsTargetPlayer` (that target receives the mana), allowing Carpet of Flowers to count a targeted opponent while awarding mana to its controller and Radiant Lotus to award mana to its target. `restriction` is the CR 106.6 rider on that mana and also decides whether one pick colours the whole batch ("any one color") or the controller picks a colour per mana ("any combination of colors"): `NONE` = ordinary pool; `INSTANT_SORCERY_COPY` = ordinary pool plus a delayed one-shot trigger copying the next instant/sorcery the mana is spent on, tracked in `GameData.pendingNextInstantSorceryCopyCount` and cleared when pools drain (Primal Wellspring); `INSTANT_SORCERY_ONLY` → `ManaPool.instantSorceryOnlyColored` (Resonating Lute, granted to lands); `ARTIFACT_SPELLS_OR_ABILITIES` → per-color `ManaPool.artifactOnlyMana`, usable to cast artifact spells or activate abilities of artifacts (Vedalken Engineer); `FLASHBACK_ONLY` → `ManaPool.flashbackOnlyMana`, read by `ManaCost.canPayFlashback/payFlashback`, colour per mana (Altar of the Lost); `GRAVEYARD_SPELL_ONLY` → `ManaPool.graveyardOnlyMana`, temporarily promoted by `ManaCost.canPayFromGraveyard/payFromGraveyard` (Rootcoil Creeper); `CREATURE_SPELL_ONLY` → `ManaPool.creatureSpellOnlyMana`, read via the `creatureSpellOnlyContext` flag `SpellCastingService`/`GameActionAvailabilityService` set to `card.hasType(CREATURE)`; cannot pay ability costs (Ancient Ziggurat 1, Somberwald Sage 3); `CHOSEN_SUBTYPE_CREATURE` → `ManaPool.subtypeCreatureMana` keyed by the source's `ChooseSubtypeOnEnterEffect` type, read via `Set<CardSubtype> subtypeCreatureContext`; adds nothing when no type was chosen (Pillar of Origins, Unclaimed Territory); `CHOSEN_SUBTYPE_CREATURE_UNCOUNTERABLE` = the same, also recorded in `ManaPool.uncounterableSubtypeCreatureMana` (a marker subset never counted in totals) so spending it produces a `GameData.spellsMadeUncounterable` entry (Cavern of Souls); `SUBTYPE_SPELL` → the same `ManaPool.subtypeCreatureMana` bucket for the effect's own `subtype`, so it cannot pay abilities either; the type is printed on the card rather than chosen as the source entered (Sliver Hive `(1, SUBTYPE_SPELL, SLIVER)`); `SUBTYPE_SPELL_OR_ABILITY` → `ManaPool.subtypeSpellOrAbilityMana` for the effect's own `subtype`, read via `Set<CardSubtype> subtypeSpellOrAbilityContext` (spells **and** activated abilities), colour per mana (Smokebraider `(2, SUBTYPE_SPELL_OR_ABILITY, ELEMENTAL)`). `subtype` is set only for the two printed-subtype restrictions. Implements `ManaProducingEffect`; only the unrestricted Fixed-amount shape reports `estimatedCountsAllColors()`. Resolves inline as a mana ability (`ActivatedAbilityExecutionService.doResolveManaAbility`) and on the stack via `AwardAnyColorManaEffectHandler`; both go through `AnyColorManaChoiceSupport.beginColorChoice` |
| `AwardAnyColorManaEffect.ofDifferentColors(int)` | unrestricted mana with a separate color choice for each mana; each subsequent choice excludes colors already chosen | Firemind Vessel |
| `AwardAnyColorManaEffect` restriction `PARTY_SPELL_OR_ABILITY` | `(int, ManaSpendRestriction)` | any-color mana spendable only for Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, or Wizard spells and activated abilities; uses the shared `ManaPool.partySpellOrAbilityMana` bucket. Base Camp |
| `AwardAnyColorManaEffect` restriction `SPELL_ONLY` | `(int, ManaSpendRestriction, boolean anyColorCombination)` | any-color mana with one color choice per mana, tagged in the regular pool so it can be spent only while casting spells; cannot pay activated ability costs. Leyline Immersion (MAT) |
| `AwardAnyColorManaEffect` restriction `SUBTYPE_CREATURE_SPELL` | `(int, ManaSpendRestriction, CardSubtype)` | any-color mana spendable only to cast creature spells of the effect's printed subtype; uses `ManaPool.subtypeCreatureMana` and cannot pay noncreature spells or abilities. ## Copy / clone

- `CopyPermanentOnEnterEffect(PermanentPredicate, String, CardSupertype, boolean)` â€” copy exception overload that removes the given supertype and adds a +1/+1 counter to copied creatures and a loyalty counter to copied planeswalkers (Spark Double).

| `MakeTargetCreaturesCopiesOfChosenCreatureUntilEndOfTurnEffect` | `()` | the controller chooses a creature on the battlefield, then any number of target creatures they control become copies of it until end of turn (Polymorphous Rush). Place in SPELL with `target(TargetFilters.creatureYouControl(), 0, 99)`; the handler pauses for the creature choice and registers a temporary-copy floating effect for each surviving target |

| `CopyPermanentOnEnterEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate filter, String typeLabel)` or `(PermanentPredicate filter, String typeLabel, DynamicAmount additionalPlusOnePlusOneCounters)` or `(PermanentPredicate filter, String typeLabel, Integer powerOverride, Integer toughnessOverride)` or `(PermanentPredicate filter, String typeLabel, Integer powerOverride, Integer toughnessOverride, Set<CardType> additionalTypesOverride)` or `(PermanentPredicate filter, String typeLabel, Set<CardType> additionalTypesOverride, boolean copyPowerToughnessFromSource)` or `(PermanentPredicate filter, String typeLabel, Integer powerOverride, Integer toughnessOverride, Set<CardType> additionalTypesOverride, List<ActivatedAbility> additionalActivatedAbilities)` | enter as copy of permanent matching filter (Clone-style). Optional `additionalTypesOverride` for "copy except it's also an [type]" (e.g. Phyrexian Metamorph is always an artifact). Optional `additionalActivatedAbilities` for "copy except it has [ability]" (e.g. Evil Twin's destroy same-name ability). Optional `additionalPlusOnePlusOneCounters` for "except it enters with X additional +1/+1 counters" (Altered Ego) � applied only when the controller chooses to copy; declining leaves a 0/0 with no counters from this effect. ## Turn / phase

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `TimesifterEffect` | `()` | each upkeep, exiles the top card of every contender's library, repeats among tied greatest mana values, and grants the remaining player an extra turn |
| `ControllerExtraTurnEffect` | `(int count)` / `(int count, boolean skipUntapStep)` | controller takes N extra turns (no targeting); `skipUntapStep=true` skips each granted turn's untap step (permanents stay tapped, summoning sickness still clears) � Savor the Moment |
| `RegisterLoseGameAtEndStepEffect` | `()` | schedules a `LoseGameAtEndStep` delayed action (tagged with the resolving turn number) � "at the beginning of your next end step, you lose the game" (Last Chance, Glorious End). Drained in `StepTriggerService.handleEndStepTriggers` only once the turn has advanced **and** the scheduling player is the active player, so it skips both the scheduling turn's own end step and every opponent's end step, firing at the controller's own next end step (Last Chance's extra turn; Glorious End's next turn after the ended one). Pushes `TargetPlayerLosesGameEffect` onto the stack, so it respects can't-lose (Platinum Angel). SPELL, non-targeting |
| `ExtraTurnEffect` | `(int count)` | target player takes N extra turns |
| `AdditionalCombatMainPhaseEffect` | `(int count[, CardEffect additionalCombatBeginningEffect])` | get N additional combat + main phases (Relentless Assault). Increments `additionalCombatMainPhasePairs`; consumed at POSTCOMBAT_MAIN. The optional effect is queued as a delayed trigger for each added combat's beginning (World at War) |
| `AdditionalCombatPhaseEffect` | `(int count)` | get N additional combat phases with NO additional main phase (Finest Hour). Increments `additionalCombatPhasesOnly`; consumed when leaving END_OF_COMBAT so the extra combat follows directly with no main phase between |
| `AdditionalCombatPhasesAfterMainEffect` | `(int count)` | insert N additional combat phases after the resolving main phase, with no main phase between them (Full Throttle). The turn engine resumes the normal next phase afterward |
| `RegisterDelayedAttackUntapEffect` | `()` | registers a one-shot delayed trigger that fires when the controller next attacks with one or more creatures this turn, then untaps each creature they control (All-Out Assault) |
| `UntapAttackedCreaturesEachCombatThisTurnEffect` | `()` | registers one delayed trigger per combat for the rest of the turn, untapping all creatures that attacked this turn (Full Throttle) |
| `EndTurnEffect` | `()` | end the turn |
| `ControlTargetPlayerNextTurnEffect` | `()` / `(boolean grantExtraTurnAfter)` | control target player during their next turn (Mindslaver). `grantExtraTurnAfter=true` (Emrakul, the Promised End) also grants that player an extra turn after the controlled turn � flagged in `GameData.pendingTurnControlExtraTurn` and scheduled in `TurnProgressionService` only when control actually activates |
| `PermanentsEnterTappedThisTurnEffect` | `()` | all permanents enter tapped this turn (Due Respect) |

## Animate / transform

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `AddCardTypeToOwnPermanentsUntilEndOfTurnEffect` | `(CardType cardType, PermanentPredicate filter)` | one-shot temporary card-type grant to matching permanents controlled by the effect's controller; preserves each permanent's existing power and toughness (Push the Limit) |
| `SetCardTypesUntilEndOfTurnEffect` | `(Set<CardType> cardTypes, GrantScope scope)` | one-shot layer-4 replacement: the affected permanent has exactly the listed card types until cleanup; use with self-animation when another printed card type must be removed (Sarkhan, the Dragonspeaker) |
| `SetCardTypesUntilYourNextTurnEffect` | `(Set<CardType> cardTypes)` | one-shot self-only layer-4 replacement: the source has exactly the listed card types until its controller's next turn; use for temporary land conversion that survives cleanup |
| `AnimatePermanentsEffect` | `(DynamicAmount power, DynamicAmount toughness, List<CardSubtype> grantedSubtypes, Set<Keyword> grantedKeywords, CardColor animatedColor, Set<CardType> grantedCardTypes, GrantScope scope, EffectDuration duration, PermanentPredicate filter)` � canonical; plus int-P/T sugar ctors: `(int,int,subtypes,keywords,color)` (manland SELF/UEOT), `(�,color,cardTypes)` (Inkmoth), `(int,int,subtypes,keywords)` (self, no colour � Glint Hawk/Rusted Relic/Warden), `(int,int,subtypes,keywords,color,cardTypes,scope,duration)` (Sylvan Awakening OWN_LANDS, Awakener Druid TARGET/WHILE_SOURCE, Tezzeret/Waker TARGET/PERMANENT); `AnimatePermanentsEffect.crew()` = printed-P/T self+CREATURE (Vehicles). One or more permanents become creatures with the given P/T. **Scope** (`GrantScope`): `SELF` (source, UEOT � manlands/Crew/Chimeric/Warden; `targetSpec().selfTargeting()=true`), `TARGET` (permanent-targeting spec; PERMANENT=Tezzeret/Waker, WHILE_SOURCE_ON_BATTLEFIELD=Awakener Druid with `sourceLinkedAnimations` tracking + source-left fizzle), `OWN_LANDS` (all lands you control � Sylvan Awakening, supports UNTIL_YOUR_NEXT_TURN), `OWN_PERMANENTS`+`filter` (mass, +CREATURE type, Equipment unattach � The Antiquities War III). **Duration** (`EffectDuration`): UNTIL_END_OF_TURN (`animatedUntilEndOfTurn`), UNTIL_END_OF_COMBAT (`animatedUntilEndOfCombat`, SELF scope � Jade Statue; reverts when combat ends via `Permanent.clearCombatState()`), UNTIL_YOUR_NEXT_TURN (`animatedUntilNextTurn`, own-lands), PERMANENT/WHILE_SOURCE_ON_BATTLEFIELD (`permanentlyAnimated`; PERMANENT also writes `grantedCardTypes` into `persistentGrantedCardTypes` so an added type survives turn cleanup — Stalking Stones' 3/3 Elemental **artifact** creature). P/T `DynamicAmount`: `Fixed`, `XValue()` (Chimeric Staff), `CountersOnSource(CHARGE)` (Chimeric Mass); a **null** P/T means "use the source's printed value" (Crew). `animatedColor` null for OWN_LANDS; for WHILE_SOURCE it's added to `grantedColors`. A SELF-scope animation queued from a **triggered** ability carries the source only as `sourcePermanentId` (no target), and `AnimationSupport.animateSingle` falls back to it � Jade Idol's "whenever you cast a Spirit or Arcane spell, this artifact becomes a 4/4 Spirit artifact creature until end of turn". |
| `AnimatePermanentsEffect` | `(DynamicAmount power, DynamicAmount toughness, List<CardSubtype> grantedSubtypes, Set<Keyword> grantedKeywords, CardColor animatedColor, Set<CardType> grantedCardTypes, GrantScope scope, EffectDuration duration, PermanentPredicate filter)` � canonical; plus int-P/T sugar ctors: `(int,int,subtypes,keywords,color)` (manland SELF/UEOT), `(�,color,cardTypes)` (Inkmoth), `(int,int,subtypes,keywords)` (self, no colour � Glint Hawk/Rusted Relic/Warden), `(int,int,subtypes,keywords,color,cardTypes,scope,duration)` (Sylvan Awakening OWN_LANDS, Awakener Druid TARGET/WHILE_SOURCE, Tezzeret/Waker TARGET/PERMANENT); `AnimatePermanentsEffect.crew()` = printed-P/T self+CREATURE (Vehicles). | `AnimateNoncreatureArtifactsEffect` | `([boolean losesAllAbilities])` | animate all noncreature artifacts into creatures with P/T = mana value (March of the Machines-style). `losesAllAbilities=true` also strips their abilities in layer 6 (Titania's Song); classifies into L4+L7B, plus L6 when the flag is set. |
| `AnimateControlledEnchantmentsEffect` | `(int minEnchantments)` | while you control at least `minEnchantments` enchantments, each other non-Aura enchantment you control is a creature with base P/T = its mana value (Starfield of Nyx, `5`). Classifies into L4+L7B. |
| `AnimateNonAuraEnchantmentsEffect` | `()` | each other non-Aura enchantment on the battlefield is a creature with base P/T = its mana value, while retaining its other types and abilities (Opalescence). Classifies into L4+L7B. |
| `PlaneswalkersWithLoyaltyBecomeCreaturesEffect` | `()` | STATIC global: planeswalkers with one or more loyalty counters become only creatures, lose all abilities, and have base P/T equal to their current loyalty. The layered pass re-evaluates both eligibility and P/T as loyalty changes (Spark Rupture). |
| `AllPermanentsUpkeepSacrificeUnlessPayEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate filter, String manaCost[, int lifeAmount, boolean excludeSource])` | STATIC global marker (Energy Flux artifacts/{2}, Pendrell Mists creatures/{1}, Aura Flux other enchantments/{2}): grants every matching permanent "At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice this permanent unless you pay {N}." Read by `StepTriggerService.handleGrantedArtifactSacrificeTriggers` (has no `LayerClassifier` entry, so the board ignores it): during each upkeep, for every matching permanent the active player controls it pushes a `ForcedCostOrElseEffect(PayManaCost(manaCost), [SacrificeSelfEffect()], true)` trigger sourced at that permanent (so the pay prompt and the sacrifice both act on the individual permanent). Global - fires regardless of who controls the enchantment; multiple grants each push their own trigger. When `excludeSource` is true, the permanent carrying the grant is skipped. |
| `AddCounterThenPayCountersOrTapAndDamageEffect` | `(CounterType counterType)` | single UPKEEP_TRIGGERED effect (Primordial Ooze): "put a `counterType` counter on this, then you may pay {X} (X = that counter type's count on it); if you don't, tap this and it deals X damage to you." Handler places the counter via `PermanentCounterSupport`, reads X, then builds a `ForcedCostOrElseEffect(PayManaCost("{X}"), [TapPermanentsEffect(SELF), DealDamageToPlayersEffect(X, CONTROLLER)], true)` and delegates to `ForcedCostOrElseEffectHandler`. Modelled as one effect (not counter+punish separately) because both halves are one ability and X depends on the counter added first. |
| `AllLandsAreCreaturesEffect` | `(int power, int toughness[, CardSubtype requiredSubtype[, CardColor color]])` | STATIC global: lands on the battlefield (all players) become fixed-P/T creatures that are still lands. No `requiredSubtype` = every land (Nature's Revolt = 2/2); a land subtype animates only lands carrying it (Living Lands = Forest � 1/1; Kormus Bell = Swamp � 1/1). A land is colorless (CR 202.2 � no mana cost), so pass `color` whenever the oracle text names one and leave it out otherwise: Kormus Bell says "1/1 **black** creatures" and needs `CardColor.BLACK`, while Living Lands and Nature's Revolt say only "1/1 creatures" and animate colorless ones. Layer-4 pass adds the CREATURE type; `AllLandsAreCreaturesEffectHandler` fills the base P/T + creature-ness + the layer-5 color (replacing the land's colors, CR 105.3); `GameQueryService.matchesAnimateLand`/`isCreature` and `StaticEffectSupport.isEffectivelyCreature` recognise animated lands (so anthems/lords see them). Manlands keep their own self-animation P/T. |
| `TransformSelfEffect` | `()` | Transforms the source permanent to its back face (or back to front if already transformed). Used by double-faced cards with Transform |
| `ON_ALLY_PERMANENT_TRANSFORMS` | _trigger slot_ | Non-targeting trigger for each permanent controlled by the source's controller that transforms in either direction. `TriggeringCardConditionalEffect` evaluates the destination face; Cult of the Waxing Moon gates on creature + not Human and creates a Wolf token |
| `ON_DAY_NIGHT_CHANGE` | _trigger slot_ | Non-targeting trigger whenever the game changes between day and night |
| `TransformAllEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate filter)` | Transforms all permanents on the battlefield matching the given predicate. Each matching permanent flips to its back face (or back to front if already transformed). Used by Moonmist with `PermanentHasSubtypePredicate(HUMAN)` |
| `TransformAnyNumberOfPermanentsEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate filter)` | During resolution, the controller chooses zero or more matching permanents they control; each chosen permanent transforms. Uses the shared multi-permanent choice interaction |
| `TapPermanentsEffect(SELF)` + `TransformSelfEffect` | _compose, no dedicated effect_ | "tap this, then transform it": `SequenceEffect.of(new TapPermanentsEffect(TapUntapScope.SELF), new TransformSelfEffect())`, typically under `ConditionalEffect(new DidntAttack(), ...)` for back-face end-step triggers (e.g. Homicidal Brute) |
| `PreventTransformEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate filter)` | STATIC restriction: permanents controlled by the source's controller that match `filter` (evaluated against their current face) can't transform. Consulted by `GameQueryService.isTransformPrevented` in all transform resolution paths (`TransformSelfEffect`, `TransformAllEffect`). Used by Immerwolf with a non-Human Werewolf filter (`PermanentAllOfPredicate(WEREWOLF, NOT HUMAN)`) for "Non-Human Werewolves you control can't transform". Aura "enchanted creature can't transform" is the separate marker `EnchantedCreatureCantTransformEffect` |
| `DrawDiscardTransformIfCreatureDiscardedEffect` | `()` | Draw 1, discard 1; if creature discarded, untap + transform source. Loot with conditional transform (e.g. Civilized Scholar) |
| `TargetPlayerDrawsThenDiscardsUntapSelfIfCardTypeEffect` | `(CardType untapIfType)` | Target player draws 1, then discards 1; if the discarded card matches the type, untap the source permanent. Uses a pending discard hook for the interactive choice (e.g. Lumengrid Augur) |
| `DrawDiscardBoostSelfByDiscardedManaValueEffect` | `()` | Draw 1, discard 1; source then gets +X/+0 until end of turn where X = discarded card's mana value. The boost is applied via a pending hook (`pendingBoostSourceByDiscardedManaValue`) once the player picks the discard, so it works with the interactive discard choice (e.g. Spellbound Dragon on `ON_ATTACK`). Non-targeting |
| `DrawDiscardAndConniveEffect` | `()` or `(boolean targetPermanent)` | Draw 1, discard 1; put a +1/+1 counter on the source if the discarded card is nonland. With `(true)`, apply the same sequence to the targeted creature. The counter is applied via a pending hook once the player picks the discard. Used by Doc Ock's Henchmen on `ON_ATTACK` and Unstable Experiment |
| `DiscardAnyNumberEffect` | `()` or `(boolean random)` | controller chooses zero through their hand size to discard; the chosen count is stored as the stack entry event value for a following effect that refers to cards discarded this way (Sacred Rites). With `random=true`, the controller chooses only the number and those cards are discarded at random (Rites of Initiation) |
| `AddCardTypeToTargetPermanentEffect` | `(CardType cardType)` or `(CardType cardType, boolean persistent)` | target permanent becomes the given card type in addition to its other types. When persistent=false (default, 1-arg constructor), stored in `grantedCardTypes` and cleared at end of turn (e.g. Liquimetal Coating). When persistent=true, stored in `persistentGrantedCardTypes` and survives turn resets (e.g. Phyrexian Scriptures chapter I making a creature an artifact permanently) |
| `GrantCardTypeToOwnPermanentsUntilEndOfTurnEffect` | `(CardType cardType[, PermanentPredicate filter])` | on resolution, additively grants the card type until end of turn to matching permanents the controller controls; the affected set is fixed at resolution (e.g. Start Your Engines) |
| `RemoveCardTypeFromTargetPermanentEffect` | `(CardType cardType)` | target permanent loses the given card type until end of turn. The handler installs a timestamped layer-4 floating effect, allowing later type-changing effects to interact with it in timestamp order. |

When `replacing == false` (default): adds the type "in addition to its other types" + grants that type's mana ability; UNTIL_END_OF_TURN uses transient subtypes + temporary abilities, CONTINUOUS uses granted subtypes + permanent abilities. When `replacing == true`: the land **becomes** the chosen type (UNTIL_END_OF_TURN only), losing its other land types/mana ability per rule 305.7 � stored in `Permanent.transientLandTypeOverride`, applied by the layered pass as the last layer-4 land-type override (legacy precedence: after all static setters) and read by `getOverriddenLandManaColor` (tap produces the new color), cleared by `resetModifiers()`. With `fixedSubtype == null`, prompts controller to choose (AddBasicLandTypeChoice, carrying the `replacing` flag); with a fixed subtype, applies directly. permanent-targeting spec. Used by Navigator's Compass (prompt, add, UNTIL_END_OF_TURN), Aquitect's Will (fixed ISLAND, add, CONTINUOUS), Tideshaper Mystic (prompt, replacing, UNTIL_END_OF_TURN) |
| `GrantBasicLandTypeToTargetEffect` | `(EffectDuration duration)`, `(EffectDuration duration, CardSubtype fixedSubtype)`, or `(EffectDuration duration, CardSubtype fixedSubtype, boolean replacing)` | changes a target land's basic land type. When `replacing == false` (default): adds the type "in addition to its other types" + grants that type's mana ability; UNTIL_END_OF_TURN uses transient subtypes + temporary abilities, CONTINUOUS uses granted subtypes + permanent abilities. When `replacing == true`: the land **becomes** the chosen type, losing its other land types/mana ability per rule 305.7 � applied by the layered pass as the last layer-4 land-type override (legacy precedence: after all static setters) and read by `getOverriddenLandManaColor` (tap produces the new color). UNTIL_END_OF_TURN stores it in `Permanent.transientLandTypeOverride` (cleared by `resetModifiers()`); UNTIL_CONTROLLERS_NEXT_UNTAP_STEP stores it in `Permanent.untilNextTurnLandTypeOverride` (survives end-of-turn cleanup, cleared at the land controller's next turn by `clearUntilNextTurnEffects()`). Both read via `Permanent.getEffectiveLandTypeOverride()`. With `fixedSubtype == null`, prompts controller to choose (AddBasicLandTypeChoice, carrying the `replacing` flag); with a fixed subtype, applies directly. canTargetPermanent=true. Used by Navigator's Compass (prompt, add, UNTIL_END_OF_TURN), Aquitect's Will (fixed ISLAND, add, CONTINUOUS), Tideshaper Mystic (prompt, replacing, UNTIL_END_OF_TURN), Orcish Farmer (fixed SWAMP, replacing, UNTIL_CONTROLLERS_NEXT_UNTAP_STEP) |
| `TargetLandBecomesBasicLandTypeUntilSourceLeavesEffect` | `(CardSubtype subtype)` | resolution-time target land change that remains active through the source permanent's STATIC companion until that source leaves the battlefield; the land becomes the fixed basic land type and reverts automatically afterward. Benign LAND target. Used by Gaea's Liege and Graceful Antelope |
| `TrackedLandsBecomeBasicLandTypeEffect` | `(CardSubtype subtype)` | STATIC companion for `TargetLandBecomesBasicLandTypeUntilSourceLeavesEffect`; applies the fixed type in layer 4 to every land recorded by the source permanent. Used by Gaea's Liege and Graceful Antelope |
| `GrantEquipByManaValueEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate filter)` | grants matching permanents an equip ability with cost {X} and boosts equipped creatures +X/+0, where X = permanent's mana value (static) |

## Enchantment-specific

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `PutAuraFromHandOntoSelfEffect` | `()` | put an aura from hand onto this creature (ETB) |
| `PutAuraFromHandOntoSelfWithinXManaValueOrExileEffect` | `()` | Evershrike: "You may put an Aura card with mana value X or less from your hand onto the battlefield attached to this creature. If you don't, exile this creature." The mana-value cap is the ability's paid X (`entry.getXValue()`); only Aura cards with `getManaValue() <= X` are offered. Declining, or having no eligible Aura, exiles the source (via the `exileSourceIfDeclinedId` field on `PendingInteraction.TargetedHandCardChoice`). Pair after a self-return-to-battlefield `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect` in a graveyard activated ability |
| `GainControlOfTargetAuraEffect` | `()` | gain control of target aura |
| `ChangeColorTextEffect` | `(boolean colorWordsAllowed, boolean landTypesAllowed, boolean canTargetSpell[, boolean untilEndOfTurn])` | change color words (when `colorWordsAllowed`) and/or basic land type words (when `landTypesAllowed`) in target permanent's text (Mind Bend = `(true, true, false)` / Sleight of Mind-style; Magical Hack = `(false, true, true)`, land types only). When `canTargetSpell` the target may instead be a spell on the stack (Glamerdye = `(true, false, true)`, color words only): the change is recorded in `gameData.spellTextReplacements` keyed by the spell's card id and carried onto the permanent it resolves into by `BattlefieldEntryService` (CR 613.7); on an instant/sorcery it is an inert no-op. Resolution writes a `TextReplacement` into `Permanent.textReplacements` � a CR 613 layer-3 text change: `TextChangeTransformer` rewrites the words of every effect instance the permanent contributes before layers 4�7 apply them, and its own printed protection/basic land types are seeded rewritten. Persists indefinitely (survives `resetModifiers()`), NOT copiable (CR 707.2). Pass `untilEndOfTurn = true` (Whim of Volrath = `(true, true, false, true)`) to make the `TextReplacement` wear off at cleanup instead — `resetModifiers()` drops it and reverts any `chosenColor` the rename had swapped. A "spell or permanent" single target is routed by zone inference in `SpellCastingService` (hand + retrace paths) via `TargetLegalityService.isSpellOnStack`. See `agent-docs/LAYER_SYSTEM.md` step 9 for the covered effect types |

## Equipment

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `EquipEffect` | `()` | equip to target creature. Prefer using `EquipActivatedAbility(manaCost)` which wraps this effect with sorcery-speed timing and "creature you control" filter |
| `EquipAbilitiesCanBeActivatedAtInstantSpeedEffect` | `()` | STATIC controller-scoped permission: the controller may activate equip abilities of Equipment they control at instant speed. Queried by `GameQueryService`; used by Leonin Shikari |
| `StaticBoostEffect` | `(int powerBoost, int toughnessBoost, GrantScope.EQUIPPED_CREATURE)` | equipped creature gets +X/+Y (static). See Boost Effects section for full constructor signatures |
| `AttachedBoostEffect` | `(DynamicAmount powerBoost, DynamicAmount toughnessBoost, GrantScope.EQUIPPED_CREATURE)` | equipped creature gets +X/+Y where the amounts are `DynamicAmount`s (static). Collapsed the `BoostCreaturePer*` family; amounts evaluate against the Equipment's controller (see Boost Effects section). Bonehoard/Runechanter's Pike (`CardsInGraveyard`), Blackblade Reforged (`PermanentCount(PermanentIsLandPredicate, CONTROLLER)`), Lashwrithe (`PermanentCount(PermanentHasSubtypePredicate(SWAMP), CONTROLLER)`), Strata Scythe (`LandsMatchingImprintedName()`) |
| `SacrificeOnUnattachEffect` | `()` | whenever this equipment becomes unattached, sacrifice the previously-equipped creature (static marker) |
| `AttachSourceEquipmentToTargetCreatureEffect` | `()` | attach source equipment to target creature. Reads targetId as creature; finds equipment via sourcePermanentId (ETB path) or by card ID fallback (death trigger path). Used by equipment with "When this Equipment enters, attach it to target creature you control" (ON_ENTER_BATTLEFIELD) or "Whenever equipped creature dies, attach this Equipment to target creature you control" (ON_EQUIPPED_CREATURE_DIES). |
| `AttachTriggeringEquipmentToTargetCreatureEffect` | `()` | attach the Equipment that caused an ally-Equipment-enter trigger to its target creature; reads `triggeringPermanentId` as the Equipment and `targetId` as the creature. |
| `AttachSourceEquipmentToEnteringCreatureEffect` | `(boolean optional)`; no-arg = `true` | `ON_ANY_OTHER_CREATURE_ENTERS_BATTLEFIELD` or `ON_ALLY_CREATURE_ENTERS_BATTLEFIELD` trigger-materialising marker for attaching this Equipment to the creature that entered. `optional=true` queues the existing `MayEffect(AttachSourceEquipmentToTargetCreatureEffect)` flow; `optional=false` queues a mandatory non-targeting attachment. The source permanent and entering permanent are preserved for resolution. Used by Cloak and Dagger (optional, Rogue) and Ronin Warclub (mandatory, ally creature). |
| `AttachSourceAuraToTargetCreatureEffect` | `()` | move the source Aura (already on the battlefield) onto target creature. Reads targetId as creature, sourcePermanentId as the Aura; reattaches and gives a new timestamp (CR 613.7e). Queued by the enter collector for Prison Term. |
| `AttachAllAurasToAnotherPermanentEffect` | `()` | targeted ETB (targets any permanent): move **all** Auras enchanting the targeted permanent onto another permanent controlled by the same player that every one of those Auras can legally enchant. On resolution collects the Auras, computes valid recipients (same controller, passes every Aura's enchant filter), and prompts the controller via `PermanentChoiceContext.AttachAllAurasToAnotherPermanent`; each Aura gets a new timestamp (CR 613.7e) and control is recomputed. No Auras, or no legal recipient � nothing moves. Used by Glamer Spinners. |
| `CreateTokenAndAttachTriggeringAuraEffect` | `(CreateTokenEffect token)` | Ajani's Chosen: "create a 2/2 white Cat creature token. If that enchantment is an Aura, you may attach it to the token." `ON_ALLY_ENCHANTMENT_ENTERS_BATTLEFIELD`, non-targeting. Creates the blueprint's token, then reads `StackEntry.triggeringCardId` (set by `TriggerCollectionService.checkAllyEnchantmentEntersTriggers`) to find the entering enchantment's permanent; when it is an Aura still on the battlefield that `AuraAttachmentService.canEnchant` accepts for the token (CR 701.3a), it raises the shared attachment prompt (`InteractionState.setPendingEquipmentAttach` + a `PendingMayAbility`, the same flow Auriok Survivors uses), which reattaches with a fresh timestamp (CR 613.7e). Implements `TokenCreatingEffect` by delegating to the blueprint |
| `AttachAurasToSourceEffect` | `()` | non-targeting: the controller picks any number of Auras out of one pool � every Aura permanent on the battlefield (any controller) plus every Aura card in the controller's graveyard and hand � and each pick is attached to the source permanent; graveyard/hand cards enter the battlefield already attached. Only Auras that could legally enchant the source are offered (CR 701.3a) and Auras already on it are skipped (CR 701.3b), so no pick can fail to move. One `PendingInteraction.AttachAurasChoice` prompt (mixed-zone `MultiCardPick`, ids are *card* ids). Battlefield Auras get a new timestamp (CR 613.7e) and control is recomputed after any move. Put on `ON_ATTACK` + `ON_BLOCK` for "whenever this creature attacks or blocks". Used by Bruna, Light of Alabaster. |
| `AttachSourceAuraToEnteringCreatureEffect` | `()` | `ON_OPPONENT_CREATURE_ENTERS_BATTLEFIELD` trigger-materialising marker: "you may attach this Aura to that creature" (the creature an opponent controls that just entered � non-targeting). The enter collector resolves the entering permanent and queues `MayEffect(AttachSourceAuraToTargetCreatureEffect)` with targetId = entering creature, sourcePermanentId = this Aura, so the Aura's controller chooses whether to move it. Used by Prison Term. |
| `AttachTargetEquipmentToTargetCreatureEffect` | `()` | attach target Equipment to target creature (multi-target; reads targetIds[0] as equipment, [1] as creature) |
| `AttachTargetEquipmentToTriggeringPermanentEffect` | `()` | attach the targeted Equipment to the permanent that caused the current enter trigger; reads targetId as the Equipment and triggeringPermanentId as the entering permanent. Used by Kemba, Kha Enduring |
| `AttachTargetAuraToTargetCreatureEffect` | `()` | move a target Aura (already on the battlefield) onto target creature (multi-target; reads targetIds[0] as the Aura, [1] as the creature; expires floating effects for the old host and gives a new timestamp per CR 613.7e). Aura variant of `AttachTargetEquipmentToTargetCreatureEffect`. Pair the aura target with `PermanentIsAuraAttachedToCreaturePredicate`. Used by Crown of the Ages ("{4}, {T}: Attach target Aura attached to a creature to another creature") |
| `SacrificeSourceEquipmentCost` | `()` | cost effect that sacrifices the equipment granting this ability (not the equipped creature). Used for equipment-granted abilities like Blazing Torch's "{T}, Sacrifice Blazing Torch: ..." where the creature activates the ability but the equipment is sacrificed. The source equipment is identified via `ActivatedAbility.grantSourcePermanentId`, which is set automatically by the static bonus system |
| `TapGrantingEquipmentCost` | `()` | cost effect that taps the Equipment granting an activated ability, identified via `ActivatedAbility.grantSourcePermanentId`; pair with the activating creature's normal tap cost when both permanents must be tapped (Fishing Pole) |
| `UnattachSourceEquipmentCost` | `()` | cost effect that unattaches the equipment granting this ability. Used for equipment-granted abilities like Blinding Powder's "Unattach Blinding Powder: ..."; the source equipment is identified via `ActivatedAbility.grantSourcePermanentId` and remains on the battlefield unattached |

## Static restrictions / taxes

`GrantNoMaximumHandSizeEffect(duration)` is the one-shot hand-size grant for the resolving
controller, `REST_OF_GAME` or `UNTIL_NEXT_TURN`. It is distinct from `NoMaximumHandSizeEffect`,
which is a static permanent effect lasting only while its permanent is on the battlefield.

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `CantCastSpellsWithSameNameAsExiledCardEffect` | `()` or `(boolean opponentsOnly)` | prevents casting spells with the same name as a card exiled with or imprinted on the source permanent. When `opponentsOnly=false` (default), restricts all players (Exclusion Ritual); when `opponentsOnly=true`, only opponents of the source's controller are restricted (Ixalan's Binding, Godsend) |
| `SpellsWithChosenNameCantBeCastEffect` | `()` or `(boolean opponentsOnly)` | spells with the chosen name on the source permanent can't be cast (static). Default (`opponentsOnly=false`) restricts every player, incl. the controller (Nevermore); `true` restricts only the controller's opponents (Gideon's Intervention). Enforced in `CastingPermissionService.getForbiddenCardNames` |
| `SpellsAndLandsWithChosenNamesCantBePlayedEffect` | `()` | static, symmetric: spells with either name chosen on the source permanent (`chosenName` / `secondChosenName`) can't be cast **and** lands with those names can't be played, by any player incl. the controller (Null Chamber). Fixed reductions use `Fixed(N)`; "for each �" reductions use a counting amount � Ghoultree `CardsInGraveyard(CardTypePredicate(CREATURE), CONTROLLER)`, Blasphemous Act `PermanentCount(PermanentIsCreaturePredicate, ANY_PLAYER)`. **Conditional reductions ("costs {N} less to cast if �") wrap this in `ConditionalEffect(condition, ReduceOwnCastCostEffect(Fixed(N)))`** � e.g. Academy Journeymage `ControlsPermanent(PermanentHasSubtypePredicate(WIZARD))`, Stoic Rebuttal `Metalcraft()`, Avatar of Might `OpponentControlsMoreCreatures(4)`, Wilt in the Heat `CardsLeftGraveyardThisTurn()`. **Do NOT add per-variant `ReduceOwnCastCostIf*`/`ReduceOwnCastCostPer*` records** � see `COST_MODIFICATION_HANDLERS.md` |

When `sourceZone` is non-null, only spells cast from that zone qualify. The amount is evaluated **against the source permanent**, so source-relative amounts express "for each �" wordings � Herald of War: `CountersOnSource(PLUS_ONE_PLUS_ONE)` for "cost {1} less for each +1/+1 counter on this creature" |

## Choose / name
| `ReduceActivationCostEffect` | `(DynamicAmount amount)` | `CostEffect` for an activated ability; reduces its generic mana cost by the amount evaluated at activation time. Use `CardsInGraveyard`, `CountersOnSource`, or another amount for "This ability costs {N} less to activate for each …" |
| `IncreaseActivationCostEffect` | `(DynamicAmount amount)` | `CostEffect` for an activated ability; increases its generic mana cost by the amount evaluated at activation time. Use for an ability whose printed `{X}` is defined by a current game-state amount, such as Bargaining Table's opponent-hand-size cost |

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `ChooseCardNameOnEnterEffect` | `()` or `(List<CardType> excludedTypes)` or `(List<CardType> excludedTypes, HandAccess handAccess)` or `(..., boolean nonbasicLandOnly)` | choose a card name as the permanent enters (implements the `ChooseCardNameEffect` replacement marker, so it is never queued as an ETB trigger). No-arg allows any name (Pithing Needle); with excludedTypes filters the name list (e.g. `List.of(LAND)` for Phyrexian Revoker); `nonbasicLandOnly=true` restricts the offered names to nonbasic land cards (Alpine Moon). `HandAccess.LOOK_AT_OPPONENT_HAND` shows the opponent's hand but still allows any name (Sorcerous Spyglass); `HandAccess.REVEAL_OPPONENT_HAND` reveals each opponent's hand to everyone and restricts the choice to the names revealed this way (Alhammarret, High Arbiter) — if no revealed card passes `excludedTypes`, the permanent just enters with no chosen name |
| `ChooseCardTypeOnEnterEffect` | `(List<CardType> excludedTypes, boolean lookAtOpponentHand)` | as-enters card-type choice; optionally looks at an opponent's hand first, then stores the selected type on `Permanent.chosenCardType` |
| `YouAndOpponentChooseCardNamesOnEnterEffect` | `()` | "as this enters, you and an opponent each choose a card name other than a basic land card name" (Null Chamber). The controller names first, then the opponent; the two names land on the permanent as `chosenName` and `secondChosenName`, and only then does it enter (CR 614.1c). Handled inline in `StackResolutionService`'s enchantment branch � `PlayerInputService.beginDualCardNameChoice` � `ChoiceHandlerService.handleDualCardNameChosen` (`ChoiceContext.DualCardNameChoice`), not by a normal effect handler. Basic land names are filtered out of the offered list |
| `ActivatedAbilitiesOfChosenNameCantBeActivatedEffect` | `()` or `(boolean blocksManaAbilities)` | activated abilities of chosen name can't be activated (static). No-arg (false) excludes mana abilities (Pithing Needle); `true` also blocks mana abilities (Phyrexian Revoker) |
| `ActivatedAbilitiesOfMatchingPermanentsCantBeActivatedEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate predicate)` or `(PermanentPredicate predicate, boolean blocksManaAbilities)` | activated abilities of permanents matching the predicate can't be activated (static); the one-argument form blocks mana abilities too, while `false` preserves mana abilities (Damping Matrix uses `anyOf(artifact, creature)`). Used by Stony Silence with `PermanentIsArtifactPredicate` |
| `ChooseColorOnEnterEffect` | `()`, `(int choicesRequired)` or `(CardColor... allowedColors)` | choose one or more colors as ETB (implements `ChooseColorEffect` marker). The no-arg form offers all five colors; pass a narrower varargs list for cards that restrict the pick (`new ChooseColorOnEnterEffect(CardColor.BLACK, CardColor.RED)` � Mangara's Equity's "choose black or red"), or an `int` for cards that collect several **distinct** colors (`new ChooseColorOnEnterEffect(2)` � Tablet of the Guilds; each prompt excludes the earlier picks, and the results land in `Permanent.chosenColors`). Both axes come from `ChooseColorEffect.choicesRequired()` / `allowedColors()` and are threaded into `PlayerInputService.beginColorChoice` by the three ETB call sites (`BattlefieldEntryService`, `StackResolutionService` aura + enchantment) |
| `ChooseColorForSourceEffect` | `()` | resolution-time sibling of `ChooseColorOnEnterEffect`: the controller chooses a color and it replaces the source permanent's `chosenColor`. For abilities that re-choose ("�and choose a color", Chromatic Armor). Handled by `ChooseColorForSourceEffectHandler`, which routes through `PlayerInputService.beginColorChoice` with the source permanent id; put it **last** in an ability's effect list, since it pauses resolution for input |
| `BecomeChosenColorEffect` | `()` | STATIC self-scoped layer-5 color setter: the source permanent becomes its chosen color, replacing its other colors. Pair with `ChooseColorForSourceEffect` when a permanent chooses its color on resolution (Puca's Eye) |
| `ChooseSubtypeOnEnterEffect` | `()` | choose a creature type as ETB. Detected by `StackResolutionService.resolveEnchantmentSpell()` to prompt `beginSubtypeChoice`. Stores result in `Permanent.chosenSubtype` |
| `ChooseBasicLandTypeOnEnterEffect` | `()` / `(int choicesRequired)` / `(List<CardSubtype> allowedTypes)` / `(int choicesRequired, List<CardSubtype> allowedTypes)` | choose one (default) or two basic land types as ETB. Detected by the permanent-entry and land-entry paths to prompt `beginBasicLandTypeChoice`. First result � `Permanent.chosenSubtype`; when `choicesRequired=2`, second pick chains into `secondChosenSubtype`. `allowedTypes` narrows the offered options (empty = all five) for cards that restrict the choice � "choose Island or Swamp" (Roots of Life); the list rides on `ChoiceContext.BasicLandTypeChoice` so a chained second pick offers the same set. Used by Convincing Mirage (1) / Illusionary Terrain (2) / Roots of Life (ISLAND, SWAMP) / Multiversal Passage (land) |
| `ChooseAnotherCreatureOnEnterEffect` | `()` | "As this creature enters, choose another creature you control." Replacement effect (CR 614.1c) � not suppressed by Torpor Orb. Detected by `BattlefieldEntryService.handleCreatureEnteredBattlefield()`. Prompts permanent choice, stores result in `Permanent.chosenPermanentId`. If no other creatures exist, enters with no choice. Used by Dauntless Bodyguard |
| `ChooseCreatureOnEnterEffect` | `()` | "As this Aura enters, choose a creature." Like `ChooseAnotherCreatureOnEnterEffect` but the choice spans EVERY creature on the battlefield (any controller, including the enchanted one) and is supported for Auras, which are not creatures themselves. Owned by `AuraCopyService.beginChooseCreatureOnEnter`, begun from the Aura branch of `StackResolutionService`; the result lands in `Permanent.chosenPermanentId` via the shared `PermanentChoiceContext.ChooseCreatureAsEnter` handler. Used by Metamorphic Alteration |
| `EnchantedCreatureIsCopyOfChosenCreatureEffect` | `()` | "Enchanted creature is a copy of the chosen creature." STATIC slot; pair with `ChooseCreatureOnEnterEffect` in ON_ENTER_BATTLEFIELD. A layer-1 copy (CR 613.2a) with a WHILE-ATTACHED duration: `AuraCopyService.applyChosenCreatureCopy` swaps the enchanted permanent's card via `PermanentCopierService.applyCloneCopy` (storing `Permanent.whileAttachedPreCopyCard`) and registers a `WHILE_ATTACHED` floating effect keyed to the Aura; when the Aura leaves, `PermanentRemovalService` feeds the expired effects to `AuraCopyService.revertExpiredCopies`, which calls `Permanent.revertWhileAttachedCopy()`. Used by Metamorphic Alteration |
| `ExileAnyNumberOfCreatureCardsFromGraveyardOnEnterEffect` | `()` | "As this creature enters, exile any number of creature cards from your graveyard." Replacement effect (CR 614.1c) handled in `BattlefieldEntryService.handleCreatureEnteredBattlefield()` before ETB triggers: prompts a `MultiGraveyardChoice` over the controller's own creature cards and exiles the picks **tracked with the entering permanent**, so `TotalPowerOfCardsExiledWithSource` / `TotalToughnessOfCardsExiledWithSource` can define its P/T. Empty graveyard ? no prompt. Resumed by `GraveyardChoiceHandlerService.handleMultipleCardsChosen`. Used by Sutured Ghoul |
| `ExileUpToXCreatureCardsFromGraveyardOnEnterWithCountersEffect` | `(int countersPerCard)` | as-enters choice over up to paid X creature cards in the controller's graveyard; exiles the picks tracked with the entering permanent, then adds `countersPerCard` +1/+1 counters per card. Resumed by `GraveyardChoiceHandlerService.handleMultipleCardsChosen` |
| `SacrificeAnyNumberOfCreaturesSetPowerToughnessOnEnterEffect` | `()` | "As this creature enters, sacrifice any number of creatures. This creature's power becomes the total power of those creatures and its toughness becomes their total toughness." Replacement effect (CR 614.1c) handled in `BattlefieldEntryService.handleCreatureEnteredBattlefield` before ETB triggers: prompts a `MultiPermanentChoiceContext.SacrificeCreaturesSetEnteringPowerToughness` multi-permanent choice over the controller's **other** creatures (0 to all, resumed by `MultiPermanentChoiceHandlerService`), sacrifices the picks and reads their effective power/toughness first (last known information), then stamps the totals on the entering permanent as a durable base-P/T override (`permanentBasePowerOverride`/`permanentBaseToughnessOverride` with fresh timestamps, layer 7b) — so no companion STATIC/CDA effect is needed and counters or boosts apply on top. No other creatures ⇒ no prompt; empty pick ⇒ 0/0, dies to SBA. Dracoplasm |
| `SacrificeAllPermanentsAsEntersEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate filter)` | As the permanent enters, sacrifice every permanent the controller controls matching `filter` before the entering permanent is placed on the battlefield. The entering permanent is excluded because it has not entered yet. Overlaid Terrain uses a land filter |
| `GrantChosenSubtypeToOwnCreaturesEffect` | `(boolean affectsAllZones[, GrantScope scope])` / `GrantChosenSubtypeToOwnCreaturesEffect.toSelf()` | static effect: the permanents in `scope` (`OWN_CREATURES` default, or `SELF`) are the chosen type in addition to their other types. Reads `chosenSubtype` from source permanent. No-arg constructor defaults to `affectsAllZones=false` (battlefield only, e.g. Xenograft). When `affectsAllZones=true`, also applies to creature spells on the stack and creature cards you own in hand/graveyard/library/exile (e.g. Arcane Adaptation). `toSelf()` = `GrantScope.SELF`, only the source itself becomes the chosen type � "this creature is the chosen type in addition to its other types" (Adaptive Automaton). Engine checks via `GameQueryService.cardHasSubtype()` and `computeGrantedSubtypesForOwnedCreatureCard()` |
| `AllColorWordsBecomeChosenColorEffect` | `()` | global text-changing static (CR 612.1, applied in layer 3 per CR 613.1c): every color word in the text of every spell and permanent becomes the source's chosen color word. Pair with `ChooseColorOnEnterEffect`; the choice is read back from `Permanent.getChosenColor()`. Unlike the targeted one-shot `ChangeColorTextEffect` it records NO `TextReplacement` on any object — the substitution is derived from the battlefield on every text-change query, so it starts and stops applying as this permanent enters and leaves. Consumed directly by `TextChangeTransformer`; it therefore has no static handler. Swirl the Mists |

| `GrantChosenSubtypeToOwnGraveyardCreatureCardsEffect` | `()` | static effect: creature cards in the source controller's graveyard are the chosen type in addition to their other types. Reads `chosenSubtype` from the source permanent and is queried through `GraveyardSubtypeGrantingEffect`; paired with `ChooseSubtypeOnEnterEffect()`. Used by Ashes of the Fallen |

## Put onto battlefield

`ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.returnToHandAtEndStep` schedules a permanent returned to the battlefield for return to its owner's hand at the beginning of the next end step (Cauldron Dance).

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `PutCardFromHandToBattlefieldWithArtifactCountersEffect` | `(CardPredicate predicate, String label, int counterCount)` | activated-ability effect: choose a matching card from hand to put onto the battlefield; if the entered permanent is an artifact, place `counterCount` +1/+1 counters on it. Wrap in `MayEffect` for optional wording. Oviya, Automech Artisan |
| `PutCardToBattlefieldEffect` | `(CardPredicate predicate, String label)` or `(�, boolean enterTapped)` or `(�, boolean enterTapped, boolean maxManaValueBoundedByX)` or `(�, boolean enterTapped, boolean maxManaValueBoundedByX, boolean grantHaste, boolean sacrificeAtEndStep)` | you may put a card matching predicate from hand onto battlefield (wrap in MayEffect for one-shot). `label` is used in prompt text. `grantHaste`/`sacrificeAtEndStep` for Soulstoke. Call `returningToHandAtEndStep()` for the next-end-step owner-hand return rider (Surprise Deployment). Call `returningExiledSourceIfSacrificed()` for Shifty Doppelganger's source-return rider. `tappedAndAttacking(predicate, label)` = Preeminent Captain. `tappedDrawAndRepeat(predicate, label)` = Cultivator Colossus (put tapped, draw, re-offer until decline; do **not** wrap in MayEffect � the HandCardChoice is the "you may"). `tappedAnyNumber(predicate, label)` = Wrenn and Seven (put tapped, re-offer until decline, no draw). `anyNumber(predicate, label)` = Myojin of Life's Web (same, but entering untapped). E.g. `new PutCardToBattlefieldEffect(new CardTypePredicate(CardType.CREATURE), "creature")`, `new PutCardToBattlefieldEffect(new CardAllOfPredicate(List.of(new CardIsHistoricPredicate(), new CardIsPermanentPredicate())), "historic permanent")` |
| `PutCreatureFromHandThenSacrificeUnlessPayReducedEffect` | `(int genericReduction)` | SPELL: "you may put a creature card from your hand onto the battlefield. If you do, sacrifice it unless you pay its mana cost reduced by {genericReduction}." Reuses the declinable hand-to-battlefield card choice; after the creature enters, a resolution-time pay-or-sacrifice may ability (a `ForcedCostOrElseEffect(new PayManaCost(reducedCost), List.of(new SacrificeSelfEffect()), true)` built in `CardChoiceHandlerService`) charges the reduced cost or sacrifices the creature. Only the generic portion is reduced (floored at 0). Flash (`2`) |

## Card-specific / one-off

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `AjaniUltimateEffect` | `()` | Ajani's ultimate: put 100 counters (planeswalker-specific) |
| `CreateEmblemWithChosenSubtypeEffect` | `(int powerBoost, int toughnessBoost, Set<Keyword> grantedKeywords, String reminderText)` | prompts the controller to choose a creature type, then creates a controller emblem carrying a filtered `StaticBoostEffect` for that type; uses the shared resolution-time creature-type choice and `PermanentHasSubtypePredicate`, so Changeling permanents match |
| `CreateEmblemEffect` | `(List<CardEffect> staticEffects, String reminderText)` / `(…, EmblemRecipient recipient)` | **the** "you get an emblem with …" effect — every planeswalker ultimate emblem goes through it. Adds an `Emblem` carrying `staticEffects` **verbatim** under the recipient's control and logs `<player> gets an emblem with "<reminderText>".` (pass `reminderText` unquoted). `staticEffects` is a pass-through payload the handler never resolves: each element is a static/marker effect read later by whichever service owns that behaviour — the CR 613 layered pass for `GrantKeywordEffect` / `GrantActivatedAbilityEffect` / `StaticBoostEffect`, `CombatAttackService` for `BoostAttackingCreatureOnAttacksYouEffect`, `TriggerCollectionService` / `DrawService` / `GraveyardService` for the trigger markers, `CastingPermissionService` for `EmblemGrantsFlashbackEffect`, `DamagePreventionService` for `PreventAllButOneDamageToControllerAndPlaneswalkersEffect`, `GameQueryService.canPlayerLoseGame` for a `ConditionalEffect(…, CantLoseGameEffect)`. `recipient` defaults to `EmblemRecipient.CONTROLLER`; `TARGET_PLAYER` (Garruk, Apex Predator −8) creates the emblem under the **targeted** player's control and switches `targetSpec()` to `TargetSpec.benign(PLAYER)` — pair it with a `PlayerPredicateTargetFilter(OPPONENT)`. `EACH_PLAYER_DEALT_DAMAGE_THIS_WAY` ("each player dealt damage this way gets an emblem", Chandra, Roaring Flame −7) creates one emblem per player the **same stack entry** already dealt damage to, read from `StackEntry.playersDealtDamageThisResolution` — put the damage effect earlier in the ability's effect list, and a player whose damage was fully prevented correctly gets no emblem. Emblems are never removed once created |
| `EmblemStepTriggerEffect` | `(EmblemTriggerStep step, List<CardEffect> effects, String reminderText)` | marker payload for an emblem whose text starts "At the beginning of your upkeep/end step, …" or "At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, …". It has **no handler** and is never resolved: it lives inside a `CreateEmblemEffect`'s `staticEffects` list, and `StepTriggerService#collectEmblemStepTriggers` scans all emblems at the beginning of that step, applies the controller/opponent relation, and pushes `effects` onto the stack as a triggered ability of the emblem (controller = the emblem's controller, source card = the planeswalker that made it). Effects that declare a permanent target use trigger-time target selection. Chandra, Roaring Flame's emblem wraps `DealDamageToPlayersEffect(3, DamageRecipient.CONTROLLER)` (UPKEEP); Ajani, Adversary of Tyrants' wraps `CreateTokenEffect(3, Cat 1/1 lifelink)` (END_STEP); Sorin, Solemn Visitor's wraps active-player `SacrificePermanentsEffect` (OPPONENT_UPKEEP) |
| `DrawCardOnAllyLandEntersEffect` | (capability interface; use `.Marker()`) | Emblem static-effect marker for "Whenever a land you control enters, you may draw a card." `TriggerCollectionService` queues a resolution-time `MayEffect(DrawCardEffect(1))` for the emblem controller when their land enters |
| `DealDamageToAnyTargetOnAllyLandEntersEffect` | `(CardSubtype landSubtype, int damage)` | Emblem static-effect marker for "Whenever a [subtype] you control enters, this emblem deals N damage to any target." `TriggerCollectionService` queues the existing any-target damage choice for each trigger |
| `DealDamageEqualToManaSpentToCastToAnyTargetEffect` | `(CardPredicate spellFilter)` | whenever controller casts a matching spell, deal damage equal to mana spent to cast it to any target. Works in `ON_CONTROLLER_CASTS_SPELL` (CollectsTrigger) or as an emblem staticEffect |
| `BoostAttackingCreatureOnAttacksYouEffect` | `(int powerBoost, int toughnessBoost, Set<Keyword> keywords)` | emblem-only marker for "Whenever a creature attacks you, it gets +N/+N and gains <keywords> until end of turn." `CombatAttackService.declareAttackers` scans the emblems of the player attacked **directly** (no planeswalker clause, unlike the `ON_CREATURE_ATTACKS_YOU` slot) and pushes one non-targeting trigger per attacker carrying `BoostTargetCreatureEffect` + `GrantKeywordEffect(keywords, TARGET, END_OF_TURN)` |
| `CounterOpponentFirstSpellEachTurnEffect` | (capability interface; use `.Marker()`) | Emblem or permanent trigger marker for Jace Unraveler's / Erayo's first-spell counter. Recognition is capability-style rather than a concrete-effect `instanceof`; permanent use belongs in `ON_OPPONENT_CASTS_SPELL`. Rulings: any turn, once per opponent per turn; a failed counter still consumes the "first spell" slot |
| `ReturnCardPutIntoGraveyardToHandEffect` | `()` | Marker effect stored in `Emblem.staticEffects`: "Whenever a card is put into your graveyard from anywhere, you may return it to your hand." Recognised in `GraveyardService.collectEmblemPutIntoGraveyardTriggers` (the single from-anywhere choke point), which pushes a `TRIGGERED_ABILITY` entry whose **card is the newly-arrived graveyard card** carrying `MayEffect(ReturnSourceCardFromGraveyardToOwnerHandEffect())` - so the resolution-time prompt and the by-id return both act on that exact card.
